files: the realm as it was walked

records.name: Rogue
records.about: The rogue relies on his speed to deal damage at medium range while avoiding attacks.

records.name: Archer
records.about: The archer has a long-range attack and can acquire very powerful weapons.

records.name: Wizard
records.about: The wizard deals damage from a long distance and blasts enemies with powerful spells.

records.name: Priest
records.about: The priest attacks at long range and can heal himself and his allies.

records.name: Warrior
records.about: The warrior wears strong armor and uses his magic helmet to inspire his allies in battle.

records.name: Knight
records.about: The knight fights at close range, wears very heavy armor, and uses his shield to stun enemies.

records.name: Paladin
records.about: The paladin can deal damage at close range, wear armor and heal himself and his allies.

records.name: Assassin
records.about: The assassin fights from medium range and uses poison to damage his enemies over time.

records.name: Necromancer
records.about: The necromancer drains life from his enemies to heal himself and his allies.

records.name: Huntress
records.about: The huntress uses arrows and traps to defeat her enemies.

records.name: Mystic
records.about: The mystic fights with a staff and uses her crystal orb to bind enemies to a distant plane.

records.name: Trickster
records.about: The trickster fights with a dagger while using her magical prism to distract enemies.

records.name: Sorcerer
records.about: The sorcerer uses his scepter to fire blasts of chain lightning at his enemies.

records.name: Ninja
records.about: The ninja relies on speed and skill, using katanas and ninja stars to deal big damage.

records.name: Samurai
records.about: The samurai fights with a katana and uses his wakizashi sidearm to expose enemy weak points.

records.name: Bard
records.about: The bard uses his lute to inspire allies and enhance their combat capabilities.

records.name: Summoner
records.about: The summoner spawns monsters to fight for her and boost her damage output.

records.name: Kensei
records.about: The kensei dashes and slashes enemies at close range to bolster his combat effectiveness.

records.name: Druid
records.about: The druid shapeshifts between forms to adapt to any battle.

records.name: Sphere of Ice
records.about: An unnaturally cold ball of ice that may provide a glimpse into Esben's past.

records.name: Trick Mace
records.about: A wicked mace constructed by Dr. Terrible to impose the Mad God's will. It stands as one of Oryx's greatest attempts at merging magic and technology.

records.name: Trick Sheath
records.about: A standard, lightweight sheath fit for enabling quick draws in a forward dash.

records.name: Trick Star
records.about: A beautifully crafted shuriken.

records.name: Trick Poison
records.about: Exposure to this ferocious concoction is so intensely lethal that it acts instantaneously. Its deceptively small vial allows for easy use.

records.name: Trick Lute
records.about: A magical lute with multiple modes.

records.name: Test Seasonal Apple
records.about: It's healthy!\nMaxes any class to 8/8 and adds a Backpack. It cannot be transferred to a regular character until the end of the season

records.about: The souls of legendary heroes live on in this vibrant elderwood staff. It represents the ancient druidic pact to protect the domains of Fey across the Realm.

records.name: Enchantment Orb
records.about: The crystalline glass in this orb seals away an ancient flora said to rejuvenate the spirit and unleash one's force of will against those who threaten the wild.

records.name: Woodland Robe
records.about: The evergreen plant fibers woven into this robe pulse with an unusual vibrance. Consecrated in the magic of the forest, this garment lifts your steps and emboldens your mind.

records.name: Fairy Ring
records.about: The magical drop of resin fixed atop this ring is a precious keepsake of the Fey. Those who possess it are protected by an old pact formed by the keepers of the forest.

records.name: Abomination's Wrath
records.about: Although destroyed, the beast's brute strength remains deeply embedded in this odd wand. Its rage possesses you, and lends you its force.

records.name: Grotesque Scepter
records.about: A scepter that can be evoked to unleash overwhelmingly powerful blasts upon others. Even the most crazed scientists wouldn't use this scepter without taking note of its side effects.

records.name: Garment of the Beast
records.about: A rigid hide, chemically engineered by Dr. Terrible and reinforced with rough scales. Though torn apart during battle, it remains powerful.

records.name: Horrific Claws
records.about: Fetid claws imbued with dangerous chemicals, pulled from the Horrific Creation.

records.about: This taco is spicy!

records.name: Cerveza
records.about: A refreshing beverage that temporarily boosts your stats. Goes well with lime!

records.name: Symbiotic Ripper
records.about: The melding of these creatures and their host is one of pain and suffering.

records.name: Parasitic Concoction
records.about: Swarming cells fill this jar, prepared to bind to whatever may foolishly approach them.

records.name: Rags of the Host
records.about: The parasites wait until the most opportune time, then strike at their targets. They become hosts to a greater evil.

records.name: Hivemind Circlet
records.about: The parasites are not individual beings; they share a single consciousness.

records.about: Temporarily transform players around you to Deca mini Djinjas!

records.about: This strange weapon sometimes affects the size of surrounding creatures.

records.name: Krathana
records.about: Omae wa...

records.name: Silex's Hammer
records.about: When you have this hammer, you don't need a reason to use it.

records.name: Jade Storm
records.about: A grand scroll capable of summoning sharpened emerald shards, slicing through even the most durable opponent.

records.name: Cloak of the Mad God
records.about: A pitch black cloak enhanced with the defensive strength of Oryx's own signature armor.
in: item:Cloak of the Mad God#Cloak of the Mad God Shiny

records.name: Shield of Flowing Clarity
records.about: This shimmering shield allows knights to enhance their concentration on targets, giving them more time to think about their next move in battle.
in: item:Shield of Flowing Clarity#Shield of Flowing Clarity Shiny

records.name: Kazekiri
records.about: A Katana made to harness the energy of the Wind.

records.name: Kamishimo
records.about: While being made of soft fabric, this outfit is mysteriously sturdy.

records.name: Akuma's Tear
records.about: The first and last teardrop of the ominous fiery demon.

records.name: Ryu's Blade
records.about: Calls upon old energy to unleash a swarm of dragon like energy spirits.

records.name: Tezcacoatl's Tail
records.about: Adult male basilisks are apex predators, and at full maturity their tails gain the unique ability to release piercing acid from the tip.

records.name: Sealed Crystal Skull
records.about: An undamaged version of a well known archaeological artifact, radiating a potent dark energy. This rare find is coveted by many explorers.
in: item:Sealed Crystal Skull#Sealed Crystal Skull Shiny

records.name: Tlatoani's Shroud
records.about: The Tlatoani used this robe to aid them in casting their most powerful magic spells. Like their other ceremonial garbs, it rarely saw much combat application.

records.name: Penetrating Blast Spell
records.about: This spell's destructive power is so notorious that casting it was banned for many generations.
in: item:Penetrating Blast Spell#Penetrating Blast Spell Shiny

records.name: Mystery Reward
records.about: What's in the box?

records.name: Mercy's Bane
records.about: Skuld enchanted this signature armor by channeling Oryx's relentless rage into its metal plates. This aura of anger now grants the strength of unbridled fury to anyone reckless enough to wear it themselves.

records.name: Bloodstone Ring
records.about: It is believed that Oryx siphons a drop of blood from each hero he slays for use in this intimidating crimson ring.

records.name: Champion's Bastion
records.about: This almighty shield was specially designed to protect its owner from a bombardment of attacks in all directions. Although feared today, it once stood as a reminder of Oryx's glory in an era long forgotten.

records.name: Oryx's Greatsword
records.about: Forged eons ago in the fires of Shaitan's domain, this infamous blade has cut down countless mighty heroes throughout the ages.

records.name: Suspicious Milk Bottle
records.about: "Very rich in calcium!" - Dr. Terrible.

records.name: Trap of the Blood Spirit
records.about: This artifact is the result of a forbidden spell. It is made of crystalized blood.

records.name: Orb of Terror
records.about: This orb has been imbued by Skuld with the energy of the lost souls wandering her Cemetery.

records.name: Glazed Apple
records.about: A delicious way to celebrate the holiday!

records.name: Christmas Turkey Leg
records.about: Ha! No more wandering around!

records.name: Christmas Tree Cupcake
records.about: With chocolate filling!

records.name: Gingerbread House
records.about: Is this snow or powdered sugar? I could eat both!

records.name: Peppermint Wakizashi
records.about: A wakizashi fashioned from perennial ice. Its innocent, festive appearance belies its lethal edge.\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron

records.name: Tome of Holy Furor
records.about: This tome was carried to battle by the members of a forgotten order.

records.name: Helm of the Immortal
records.about: This helm was worn by the elite guardians of a long lost empire.

records.name: Seal of Divine Focus
records.about: The Paladins of Lira-Tin used this seal to reach high level of focus during their training.

records.name: Server Heart
records.about: The still-beating heart of a mysterious Server. It could be supremely powerful if it were a little more stable, and perhaps less starchy.

records.name: Brilliance Bow
records.about: A revered bow hidden away for many years by those wise enough to recognize the danger of its devastating might. Its strength is unmatched throughout the universe.

records.name: Quintessential Quiver
records.about: Royal alchemy techniques have enabled this quiver to sharpen the gilded tips held within. Arrows loosed from the case are recognized as some of the sharpest objects known to man.

records.name: Luxurious Leather
records.about: An illustrious lineage of acclaimed bowmen have passed down this famed attire. It boasts such immense defensive power that its wearer is considered invincible.

records.name: Regal Ring
records.about: A legendary citrine ring said to grant unfathomable amounts of dexterity to those who possess it.

records.name: K.I.D.D. Force
records.about: A highly unstable staff engineered to expel forceful bolts of an energy component known as K.I.D.D. (Knee-deep In Dungeon Design). It's not great now, but allegedly the second version will be better.

records.name: MMace MMurderer
records.about: A heavy mace that abides only by the power of repetition.

records.name: Mister Mango
records.about: Displaying this malformed mango in public is said to awaken the rage of a long-dormant entity from beyond.

records.name: Butter Bow
records.about: Crispy, buttered, wheat or rye. In toast it lives, in toast it dies.

records.name: Caduceus of Current Craziness
records.about: The harbinger of past pandemonium, current craziness, and future fatuity. It just can't seem to stay focused.

records.name: Blade of Ages
records.about: A katana once belonging to a royal sorcerer known for great ambition, but slow delivery. His treasured blade was prophesied to produce something wonderful... eventually.

records.name: Mirror Cloak
records.about: A brilliant cloak that utilizes the complex process of light reflection to perfectly conceal its user by creating an exact replica, mimicking the wearer.

records.name: Archerang
records.about: A quiver once treasured by a highly sentimental archer who just couldn't bear to part with her arrows forever. They've become rather dull after so much recycling.

records.name: Spelling Spell
records.about: An instructional spell used as an education tool for the training of young wizards. Before they run, they must learn to talk.

records.name: Tome of Moral Support
records.about: The deepest wounds are not physical, but psychological. Only the wisest healers are savvy enough to apply the advanced treatment this tome enables, guaranteed to revitalize allies in their times of need.

records.name: Challenger Helm
records.about: It's not easy being the best. Some wish for more, a way to inflict difficulties on themselves so that they may once again experience what it's like to not be insultingly overpowered. At last, there is a way.

records.name: Shield of Pogmur
records.about: As the heavy armor worn by most knights typically conceals their faces with a stoic expression, they require other ways to convey emotions of shock or excitement.

records.name: Seal of Eternal Life
records.about: The fruit of over a decade of research, this blessed seal at long last overcomes all limitations on its usage and never allows its user to run out of strength. A slight concession had to be made by devoting one hundred percent of its magic resources back into magic.

records.name: Lightning in a Bottle
records.about: A misguided attempt by Xolotl to grant a form of his power to followers among the Secluded Thicket, with the glaring weakness that it can only be utilized in large, open areas with direct access to the clouds.

records.name: Epiphany Skull
records.about: The skull of an enlightened philosopher who understood the true potential of necromancers to be summoners. Tragically, his overwhelmingly high IQ got the best of him.

records.name: Helium Trap
records.about: A devastating trap with some major hang time. It's full of hot air and not actually that useful, which is surely a metaphor for something.

records.name: Karma Orb
records.about: What goes around comes around.

records.name: Titan's Heart
records.about: A spirit filled vessel that lies at the core of the Sandstone Titan.

records.name: Fool's Prism
records.about: All that glitters is not gold. Beware, tricksters who choose this dastardly prism must be committed to their cruel prank.

records.name: Honey Scepter Supreme
records.about: After years of the truth being rejected by the masses, this version of the fabled Honey Scepter is automatically enhanced with the full potential it had all along.

records.name: Unshuriken
records.about: A star with high potential, but curses the user with a crippling lack of decisiveness.

records.name: NSFWakizashi
records.about: A double-edged wakizashi that exposes in more ways than one.

records.name: Omni-Impotence Ring
records.about: An unfathomable lack of strength is found in this ring. Only the most unreasonable mortals would ever consider voluntarily handicapping themselves so aggressively.

records.name: Reikoku
records.about: First summer storm cloud\nInflicting a thousand cuts\nBrilliance, then ash.

records.name: Daybreak Chakram
records.about: Circle of sunlight\nEmpowers a fragile bloom\nAnd scours the world.

records.name: Hirejou Tenne
records.about: Scarf held to the breeze\nCommanding a storm's vengeance\nHoping for silence.

records.name: Heavenly Magatama
records.about: Spiraling treasure\nPrayer beads for the downpour\nCoiled in grateful hands.

records.name: Deathless Crossbow
records.about: Distinguished archers are permitted to take their prized bow with them to the afterlife. It conjures ethereal arrows when drawn, penetrating the very souls of living beings.

records.name: Quiver of Shrieking Specters
records.about: A quiver not meant for the corporeal realm. When used by a mortal, it creates a momentary rift between death and life, briefly releasing the chilling screams of the lost.

records.name: Wraith's Brigandine
records.about: An enduring garment of spectral steel worn by the shades of the shadows.

records.name: Revenant Ring
records.about: An otherworldly gemstone is set in this oddly tight ring. It does not seem designed for human fingers.

records.name: Sakura Wakizashi
records.about: A whimsical wakizashi of Eastern origin; it has a pleasant aroma of cherry blossoms.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Necronomicon
records.about: A tattered tome possessing the forbidden knowledge of pagan priests of old. It speaks of casting terrible curses upon opponents, but such impure power comes at a cost.

records.name: Scholar's Seal
records.about: A symbolic seal gifted to the most renowned philosophers of ancient times.

records.name: Ronin's Wakizashi
records.about: An artifact once wielded by a wandering samurai with no master to serve. It was preserved in the Cursed Library for historical purposes, but it remains just as deadly despite its age.

records.name: Corruption Cutter
records.about: A fragment of Lord Ruthven's curse manifest itself into this pulsating dagger. Its formless state allows it to cut in ways no other weapon could.

records.name: Amethyst Gem
records.about: Collect Amethyst Gem, Sapphire Gem and Topaz Gem and bring them to the Tinkerer to complete his quest.

records.name: Apple of Extreme Maxening
records.about: It's healthy!\nMaxes any class to 8/8 and adds a Backpack.

records.name: Locked Reactor
records.about: Though sealed tight, a quiet hum can be heard coming from the energy within.

records.name: Mystery ST Skin
records.about: Grants a random ST Skin when used!\n\nSprite Credits: Toastrz

records.name: Pixie-Enchanted Sword
records.about: Pixies are often a more aggressive fae. It makes great sense that they would provide heroes with swords as fine as this.

records.name: Seal of the Enchanted Forest
records.about: Protect the helpless, embolden the heroic, slow the progress of evil. - Inscription, in Fae.

records.name: Fairy Plate
records.about: This colorful platemail is enchanted with special protections, a gift from the kind fairies that dwell in the Realm.

records.name: Ring of Pure Wishes
records.about: Many do not realize how powerful a kind wish is.

records.name: Loaded Core
records.about: An odd device with four power cores slotted inside. It loudly buzzes with energy, eager to direct its strength somewhere.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Loaded Core
records.about: The different kind of neo energy are harmonized together in this core. The end result is a core that can generate almost limitless energy.

records.name: Entropy Reactor
records.about: A device used by alien researchers to stabilize power cores as a means of safely extracting their power.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Entropy Reactor
records.about: Once pure neo energy is added in an incomprehensible reaction occurs one that approaches the limit of time and space as we know it. One could power any technology they could think of using this reactor.

records.name: Neo Reality Reactor
records.about: This reactor no longer obeys the rules of the world. It is capable of even restarting the universe itself, creating a new reality in the owners' image. Technology has surpassed the realm of the divine.

records.name: Fitted Protective Matrix
records.about: Standard issue armor for Commander Calbrik's fleet. It stores energy to power a defensive shield when its wearer needs it most.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Fitted Protective Matrix
records.about: Specially commissioned armor used by the Calbrik Guard, the most elite soldiers from Commander Calbrik's fleet. It is enhanced by incorporating neo energy in its shield system providing better durability.

records.name: Neo Alien Core: Dark Matter
records.about: This core enhanced by the neo energy found on Untaris improves otherworldly gear.

records.name: Foramite Staff
records.about: A rod composed of solid foramite, the only known material in the galaxy capable of withstanding the corrosive effects of Foraxian acid.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Foramite Staff
records.about: The increased intensity of acid rains has weakened even the highly resistant foramite. This weakness allows for more acid to flow increasing the lethality of this staff.

records.name: Comet of Calamity
records.about: An irregular fragment of a fiery comet that once passed over Malogia. Intergalactic legends know it as the herald of the great alien lord Nizos.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient
in: item:Comet of Calamity#Comet of Calamity Shiny

records.name: Neo Comet of Calamity
records.about: Upon the coronation of King Suesogian I, a meteor shower was ushered with the power of this staff. Many on Malogia consider the king to be the fabled Nizos as if it were a mere prophecy. The truth is that the great lord Nizos vanished when Malogia needed it the most.

records.name: Gaseous Glaive
records.about: One of the most unusual feats of Katalonian engineering. This barely tangible sword hurls puffs of toxic gas, if you can manage to firmly grasp it.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Gaseous Glaive
records.about: The gas tank attached to this weapon has been redesigned using the renovated factory on Katalund. It can now store even more potent toxic gas.

records.name: Acidic Slasher
records.about: Steeped in the acid rainwater of Forax, the chemical coating has transformed this already mighty blade into a heavy-hitting weapon of war.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Acidic Slasher
records.about: Modified with even more rainwater this weapon has become too heavy to wield for most. Its strikes are now reminiscent of the earthquakes that have been plaguing Forax ever since Neo Energy was infused into the planet.

records.name: Fire Blade
records.about: Though rather unremarkable as far as alien weapons go, Malogian clans swear by this weapon as a good luck charm. Some things never change.

records.name: Neo Fire Blade
records.about: While Malogia has evolved technologically, there are still many who refuse to give up on their prized lucky blades preferring to repair and improve them instead.

records.name: Moonbeam Blade
records.about: The frigid landscape of Untaris is chilled by the moonlight reflected from a planet of astral frost.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient

records.name: Neo Moonbeam Blade
records.about: This dual-bladed version reflects additional moonlight when spinning the blade creating a stronger beam. This was the original theory behind this weapon. In practice simply throwing it to directly cut targets is more effective.

records.name: Blazon Bow
records.about: A stunning bow forged in the heat of a massive star many lightyears beyond the realm.

records.name: Neo Blazon Bow
records.about: Reinforced with katalonian laser technology this bow is now brighter than the star that birthed it. Any who lay eyes upon it run the risk of going blind.

records.name: Sun's Judgement
records.about: The abnormal alignment of Malogia's moons block direct light from its sun during most of its revolution. The brief periods of visibility are ferociously hot.\n\nSprite Credits: Artauris

records.name: Neo Sun's Judgement
records.about: Malogians turned their sun into the symbol of their rebellion against the Vylar Empire. This bow forged to honor the sun was one of the many weapons used in the battle.

records.name: Corrosion Cutter
records.about: Interestingly, freezing the acid of Forax into a solid material retains its burning properties. Crafty alien mercenaries have used this to create brutal assassination weapons such as this.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Corrosion Cutter
records.about: An easy way to create an acid blade is to pour acid in a hunger's hollow fang. Once frozen its edge will be both sharp and corrosive. This technique is even more effective when using a starvation's fang.

records.name: Dueling Daggers
records.about: A set of daggers given partial sentience by alien technology. They fiercely compete to claim more kills than the other.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Dueling Daggers
records.about: These sentient daggers share some similarities with Bubblars such as their way to duplicate themselves. With three daggers in hand it becomes trivial to be influenced by them and start slashing friends and foes alike.

records.name: Warlord Wand
records.about: An accomplished alien conqueror brandished this wand as a show of might, topping it with a gemstone from each planet he overthrew.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Warlord Wand
records.about: Katalund once had its own intelligent organic life, they ravaged the planet with constant battles over territory. It is unknown how their civilization came to an end but it can be certain they once used wands like this one to take over the world.

records.name: Snowblind Wand
records.about: A wand held together by an ice crystal extracted from the depths of Untaris. Each shot possesses the concentrated force of a blizzard.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Neo Snowblind Wand
records.about: Every bit of Untaris has been taken over by Tarul, even the frozen crystal that enamors this very wand. All it's good for now is expanding the cosmic parasite's vision of the universe.

records.name: Neutralized Acid
records.about: The acid water found on the shores of Forax is quite dangerous but with the right chemical reactions it can be turned into a powerful tonic.

records.name: Katalonian Battery
records.about: A battery salvaged from one of Katalund's inhabitants. It still has some juice in it.

records.name: Horned Fruit
records.about: The inhabitants of Malogia used to eat these with the horns until they developed a way to remove them without destroying the nutrional value.

records.name: Bubblolecule
records.about: The second smallest form of bubblarion next to bubblatoms. It is surprisingly durable for what appears to be a tiny bubble.

records.name: Miniature Alien Generator
records.about: The power of the stars in the palm of your hand. Its power output is quite unstable.

records.name: Laser Rifle
records.about: One of the many feats of alien technology in Calbrik's arsenal. It comes equipped with an automatic missile launcher.

records.name: Neo Laser Rifle
records.about: Rebuilt using blueprints and materials found through-out the galaxy, this modified Laser Rifle is outlawed by most galactic regulations due to its catastrophic destructive prowess. It is considered a doomsday device by most of the universe.

records.name: Alien Quest Chest
records.about: An unidentifiable chest object otherwise known as UCO. It contains items out of this world.

records.name: Forax Weapon Cache
records.about: Contains a random weapon from Forax with minimum Uncommon Rarity.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Katalund Weapon Cache
records.about: Contains a random weapon from Katalund with minimum Uncommon Rarity.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Untaris Weapon Cache
records.about: Contains a random weapon from Untaris with minimum Uncommon Rarity.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Malogia Weapon Cache
records.about: Contains a random weapon from Malogia with minimum Uncommon Rarity.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Alien Weapon Cache
records.about: Contains a random alien weapon with minimum Uncommon Rarity.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Draconis Potion
records.about: An aged stone vessel containing a fragment of an elemental power. Unlike modern glass bottles, this opaque container means that the contents cannot be seen until the potion is opened.

records.name: Glowing Green Goo
records.about: Imagine someone leaving that on your kitchen table.\n\nSprite Credits: Artauris

records.name: Oryx Cookie
records.about: Aliens have turned Oryx into a chocolate-filled cookie! But mmm... it's delicious!\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Chaos Cake
records.about: That's why you don't task aliens to prepare your birthday cake....\n\nSprite Credits: Artauris

records.name: Solar Energy Drink
records.about: Raises your energy levels to the moon and back!\n\nSprite Credits: Artauris

records.name: Mystery Summer Skin
records.about: Grants a Summer Skin when used!

records.name: Tome of the Mushroom Tribes
records.about: A long-lost druid's tome that catalogs medicinal mushrooms. It also has many pocket spaces that contain spore samples, which can be made fully grown through incantations.
in: item:Tome of the Mushroom Tribes#Tome of the Mushroom Tribes Shiny

records.name: Sporous Spray Spell
records.about: An ancient druidic spell that invokes earth spirits into furnishing the soil with a noxious, deadly skullshroom colony.
in: item:Sporous Spray Spell#Sporous Spray Spell Shiny

records.name: Fungal Breastplate
records.about: The fungus covering this armor has eaten away all the metal. While offering little protection, its restorative powers make this armor unique.

records.name: Echoes Prism
records.about: A fragmented prism that is constantly mending its cracks and refracturing. When agitated, it ejects volatile shards towards the source until each fragment spirals back into equilibrium.

records.name: Crystal Shield
records.about: An ornately decorated buckler made from an array of crystalline stone. It is too frail to swing around, but it can somehow grow and mantle its wielder in a heavy crystal armor that releases shards upon receiving trauma.

records.name: Crystallised Fang's Venom
records.about: Even in small amounts, this potent venom is capable of corroding the armor of its victims.

records.name: Crystallised Mist
records.about: This strange trinket creates a cloud of crystaline particles rendering anyone inside invisible.

records.name: Cave Dweller Trap
records.about: A ceremonial trap used by the elite members of the Mushroom Tribes to ensnare those who trespass their sacred sanctum.
in: item:Cave Dweller Trap#Cave Dweller Trap Shiny

records.name: Cloak of Refraction
records.about: This heavy cloak cleverly conceals its user not by magic, but by channeling the light around them as camouflage. Tampering with this light briefly projects a false mirror image of oneself.

records.name: Fractured Gemstone Wakizashi
records.about: Carved from the unblemished minerals deep beneath the realm, this unconventional wakizashi fractures itself when swung to release a strange supernatural energy.
in: item:Fractured Gemstone Wakizashi#Fractured Gemstone Wakizashi Shiny

records.name: Star of Enlightenment
records.about: A perfectly cut crystal encasing light from the oldest stars in the universe. All who hold it are filled with a sense of peace and concentration.
in: item:Star of Enlightenment#Star of Enlightenment Shiny

records.name: Golden Lucky Clover
records.about: An even luckier shamrock that will make enemies drop more and better loot! Lasts 60 minutes.

records.name: Bronze Reward Chest
records.about: Exchange this Bronze Chest for a good reward of choice at the Tinkerer!

records.name: Silver Reward Chest
records.about: Exchange this Silver Chest for an amazing reward of choice at the Tinkerer!

records.name: Gold Reward Chest
records.about: Exchange this Gold Chest for a mind-blowing reward of choice at the Tinkerer!

records.name: Platinum Reward Chest
records.about: Exchange this Platinum Chest for an out-of-this-world reward of choice at the Tinkerer!

records.name: Keychain Cutlass
records.about: A magical chain of infinite keys capable of unlocking the secrets of the universe, though your mileage may vary. Not to be confused with a different key-related blade.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Crystal Key
records.about: A mysterious key bestowed upon the Keyper by the Crystal Entity, imbued with an aura of forbidden magic. It fits no locks, yet it can open anything.\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient

records.name: Crystal Key Proc
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Mimicry Trap
records.about: A crystal trap with a built-in luring mechanism. The perimeter of the trap reflects light toward the center to create an illusionary mimic.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Prismimic
records.about: The perfectly cut head of a Prismimic, dastardly agents of the Crystal Entity. Its copying abilities are unprecedented.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Henchman's Claymore
records.about: A brutally heavy sword designed to make those at the other end of its blade know their place.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Tyrant's Wand
records.about: Granted only to the highest ranking mages of Oryx's legion, this wand conjures pagan magic forbidden by most practitioners.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Predator Bow
records.about: Not one for long distance combat himself, Oryx leaves archery training in the hands of former realm heroes who defected to his side.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Bounty Hunter's Dagger
records.about: The Mad God knows the value of cloak and dagger operations, despite his personal inclination toward more overt tactics. Oryx's minions consider it a great honor to be gifted this dagger.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Oppressor's Staff
records.about: Initially built solely for Oryx's reckless use, the construction of this staff proved potent enough to mass produce for Oryx's champions.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Blade of the Assailant
records.about: Though Oryx is only known to deploy his assassin units in times of personal need, the deliberately cruel craftsmanship of their katanas is no less remarkable.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Maize Machete
records.about: Using real corn as a weapon proved to be counterintuitive, so it was substituted with candy corn. Surprisingly, this only worsened the crow problem.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Pumpkin Prism
records.about: The innards of a pumpkin were molded into this pile that vaguely resembles a prism. Used only by the laziest scarecrows who feel the need to outsource their job.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Withered Poncho
records.about: Once worn by a remarkably ineffective scarecrow who was regularly swarmed by the very thing it swore to destroy.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Burlap Hat
records.about: A humble hat with some dirt and straw stuck between the cloth. Being a scarecrow ain't much, but it's honest work.\n\nSprite Credits: Bonk, Aurum

records.name: Bone Bow
records.about: A rib strung together by a tendon, sure to send shivers down your enemy's spines.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Spinal Quiver
records.about: The sternum of a long deceased adventurer. It releases a shriek when fired, making enemies shake and shudder in surprise.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Torso Tunic
records.about: A rather bare bones armor affording more protection than one would expect. This bag of bones seems so unsafe.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Collarbone Collar
records.about: There's a certain irony to this macabre amulet. It's not very comfortable to wear and will seldom let you snooze.\n\nSprite Credits: Tero, Aurum

records.name: Hellfire Broadsword
records.about: A merciless blade forged in the intense fires of the realm's core, designed for use by great demon lords.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Sacrilege Seal
records.about: Paladins must take an oath of righteousness to obtain their titles. Those who defect are considered deeply cursed.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Tormentor's Chainmail
records.about: A cruel armor stitched from the victims of demonic killers, a symbol of one's ruthlessness.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Horned Ring
records.about: The severed head of an imp grew horns posthumously, an eerie piece of natural decor.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Stygian Torch
records.about: A blued wooden staff lit with an undying flame. Only an extraordinarily skilled sorceress can wield the fire without this attachment.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Orb of the Sabbath
records.about: A crystal ball known to be able to summon magically constructed bats, but this technique has only been mastered by Totalia's kind.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Robe of the Enchantress
records.about: Totalia's garbs are specially fitted to be flexible enough to ride brooms. The cloth is also flame retardant, a quality which proved essential after more than one incident.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Witch's Brooch
records.about: The true source of Totalia's powers. This ornament contains a small amount of liquid freely moving inside. It's cold-hot-fresh!\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Greaterhosen
records.about: A necessary component for any beer-drinking or sausage-eating in the month of October.\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron

records.name: Mighty Stein
records.about: A mighty mug for a mighty drink! Be merry!\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron

records.name: Demon Pumpkin
records.about: Grants one item from the Halloween Trickster or Paladin Set when used!\n\nSprite Credits: Lily

records.name: Witch's Skull
records.about: Grants one item from the Halloween Mystic or Archer Set when used!\n\nSprite Credits: Lily

records.name: Supernatural Staff
records.about: While working in a lab late one night, a wizard beheld an eerie sight.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Spectral Spell
records.about: The ghouls all came from their humble abodes to get a jolt from his electrodes.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Immortal Mantle
records.about: The scene was rocking, all were digging the sounds. Igor on chains, backed by his baying hounds.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Phantom Pendant
records.about: Everything was cool, Ruthven's a part of the band. And his monster mash was the hit of the land.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Caramel Apple
records.about: A rich caramel coating on a tart Granny Smith apple.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Candy Apple
records.about: If the candy didn't rot your teeth, this sure will!\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Sugar Gummy Worm
records.about: A sugar-coated gummy delight! Except for when somebody replaces it with an actual worm.\n\nSprite Credits: Lily

records.name: Rainbow Gummy Worm
records.about: Taste the Rainbow Gummy Worm... feel the Rainbow Gummy Worm!\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Eyecicle
records.about: What an eyesore!\n\nSprite Credits: Lily

records.name: Chocolate Bar
records.about: People afraid of tricks will usually give this to you. It's delicious!\n\nSprite Credits: Trensient

records.about: A short lived dirk which saw little use in the hands of a quickly slain adventurer, too lucky for their own good. Knowing its purpose was left unfulfilled, it seeks to eliminate the evil chicken menace from beyond the grave.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Theurgy Wand
records.about: Oryx's so-called priests use cruel wands like this to inflict suffering on their recipients. They themselves must endure this pain to begin the path to consecration.

records.name: Ceremonial Merlot
records.about: Those who wish to be hallowed among Oryx's legion are required to drink the wretched concoction within this chalice, a mix between the Mad God's poorly kept wine and his own sentient bile.

records.name: Anointed Robe
records.about: Knowing they are to serve a more aggressive purpose on the front lines, Oryx's chosen messengers utilize a plated robe, complete with a crimson cape.

records.name: Ring of Pagan Favor
records.about: When the arduous path to anointment is complete, the priest is decorated with this symbolic ring of servitude, modeled after Oryx's famed warriors.

records.name: Bergenia Bow
records.about: Decorated with the finest flora of the realm's toughest forests, this bow uses the sharp cymes of plant life as arrows against would-be vandalizers.

records.name: Lifebringing Lotus
records.about: Sprouted and plucked from an ancient, enchanted riverbank, this flower's spores weaken the roots of evil and strengthen righteous hearts.

records.name: Hollyhock Hide
records.about: A lightweight floral coat fitted with the molted shell of a colossal insect. The energy of its evolution still pulses through, reacting upon blows.

records.name: Chrysanthemum Corsage
records.about: Expertly carved from ancient trees and fitted together with their sap, this ring's flowers have absorbed magical energy over many years, storing it within its fruit.

records.name: Cannon Cluster Proc
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Swashbuckler's Sickle
records.about: A clumsy yet vicious weapon favored by marauders from coast to coast. Only an experienced pirate king can perform the techniques required to unlock its full potential.

records.name: Tricorne of the High Seas
records.about: Pirate captains wear extravagant cocked hats to both inspire their men and intimidate their foes.

records.name: Naval Uniform
records.about: The buccaneers that raided the realm before Oryx's rule famously wore such attire. Its opulence does not make for the most practical choice when sailing, but it was valued as a status symbol.

records.name: First Mate's Hook
records.about: Less prominent pirates use personal hooks to signify their rank. Though it is almost entirely symbolic on its own, no true pirate is complete without one.

records.name: War STory Chest
records.about: A chest recovered from the battlegrounds of the realm. Bring it to the Tinkerer for a Mystery Class Crate of choice! Choose wisely!

records.name: Buccaneer Top Hat
records.about: A dapper silk hat, suspiciously owned by a band of pirates with no interest in such class.

records.name: Serpentine Top Hat
records.about: A dapper silk hat, said to be worn as a crown by the numerous snakes in Stheno's hair.

records.name: Demonic Top Hat
records.about: A dapper silk hat, taken to the abyssal depths by wealthy aristocrat who thought himself too noble to die.

records.name: Sunken Top Hat
records.about: A dapper silk hat, once belonging to a captive of Davy's crew who went down with the vessel.

records.name: Aquatic Top Hat
records.about: A dapper silk hat, donned by a childlike man in his grand voyage to the corner of the globe. It was a real trip.

records.name: Jungle Carrot
records.about: A slightly unripe carrot that could make for a suitable nose. This one was grown in the depths of a jungle.

records.name: Spriteful Carrot
records.about: A slightly unripe carrot that could make for a suitable nose. Believe it or not, the dimension of sprites is home to a booming agriculture industry.

records.name: Holy Carrot
records.about: A slightly unripe carrot that could make for a suitable nose. This one was steeped in holy water, though the benefit of blessing a carrot is questionable.

records.name: Frosty Carrot
records.about: A slightly unripe carrot that could make for a suitable nose. This is perhaps the only snowman accessory that makes any real sense.

records.name: Sandy Carrot
records.about: A slightly unripe carrot that could make for a suitable nose. It's a miracle that any kind of farming could be achieved in a soil-deficient environment so hostile toward crops.

records.name: Arachnid Coal
records.about: Two lumps of coal, or two crude eyes with some imagination. It's unclear what use spiders would have for coal in the first place.

records.name: Phantom Coal
records.about: Two lumps of coal, or two crude eyes with some imagination. Even the cold, unfeeling undead need something to keep a fire burning.

records.name: Zombified Coal
records.about: Two lumps of coal, or two crude eyes with some imagination. Skuld's simple-minded minions find this entertaining enough to be a toy.

records.name: Parasitic Coal
records.about: Two lumps of coal, or two crude eyes with some imagination. The fleshy texture calls into question how much of this is actually coal.

records.name: Mad God's Coal
records.about: Two lumps of coal, or two crude eyes with some imagination. Oryx's reluctant agreement with Limon prevents him from burning fossil fuels, making this coal of little value to him.

records.name: Esben's Shaman Attire
records.about: A glacial robe worn by the witch doctors of a bygone ice tribe during their sacred burial ceremonies. The passage of time has encased the cloth in a layer of permafrost, chilling those who fracture its coat.
in: item:Esben's Shaman Attire#Esben's Shaman Attire Shiny

records.name: Esben's Wedding Ring
records.about: A memento of a life long gone. You can still feel the warmth from years past through the frigid ice that has taken over.

records.name: Snowman Body
records.about: A pile of snow, not yet fully decorated. Nature's blank canvas, though any would-be artists should be cautious of getting too carried away.

records.name: Oryxmas Ornament: Energized
records.about: A blue ornament taken from Oryx's magical Oryxmas Tree. Inside, it contains the secrets to the past, which can be unleashed to gift its holder with the power of infinite possibilities.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Oryxmas Ornament: Weak
records.about: A yellow ornament taken from Oryx's magical Oryxmas Tree. The aura it emits fills even the bitterest of hearts with pure joy, causing their blows to land with less force than before.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Oryxmas Ornament: Exposed
records.about: A red ornament taken from Oryx's magical Oryxmas Tree. It radiates with pure winter energy that highlights the weak spots of even the bulkiest of foes.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Ornaments of Unity
records.about: A majestic chain of ornaments, each holding astounding powers. If paired with enough essence of Oryxmas, it will gift the most righteous of hearts the absolute power of the winter.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Oryxmas Mystery Armor
records.about: Merry Oryxmas! Open the box to receive a random Oryxmas Tier 12 Armor!

records.name: Guild Present
records.about: A present to share with friends during the Oryxmas Holidays!

records.name: Aegis Armor
records.about: Onyx armor forged for use by Oryx's famed champions, giving them a sample of Oryx's furious strength.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Squadron Sheathing
records.about: Oryx's assassins use this flexible armor to remain agile as they harness the Mad God's power.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Judge's Robe
records.about: The designated members of Oryx's court are fitted with this honorary robe, symbolizing their status among his legion.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Jade Beetle
records.about: A glorious block of solid jade, sculpted to resemble a sacred scarab beetle from the time of the ancients. This extraordinarily rare relic was granted to mortal athletes by Bes, Nut, and Geb themselves in recognition of great swiftness.

records.name: Ring of the Inferno
records.about: With the enchantress reduced to ash, the stone burst, scattering the relics of the mystic into the realm's lava fissures. They have since awaited a daring hero to recover the pieces from the clutches of demons.

records.name: Molten Mantle
records.about: A suffocating black smoke began to pour out, consuming the young enchantress. As her soul and mind burned to dust, the fibers of this robe were strangely unscathed.

records.name: Scorchium Stone
records.about: A young enchantress used a rare flame-absorbing stone to capture the lava spirits.

records.name: Staff of Eruption
records.about: In the primal era of the realm, the volcanic mountains were overrun with rampant lava spirits, spiteful creatures who sought to burn all they could touch.

records.name: Radiant Heart
records.about: What serves as the life support for all of the artificial creatures constructed by the Crystal Entity is also capable of bestowing strength and energy to organic life.

records.name: Luminous Armor
records.about: A devastating fracture in the center of this breathtaking armor tarnished its raw defensive abilities, but the dubious blessing of the Crystal Entity still allows it to aid the wearer in other ways.

records.name: Crystalline Kunai

records.about: A cursed gemstone imbued with numerous plagues. While unfavorable to one's stamina, it proves itself useful with the associated resistances.

records.name: Acidic Armor
records.about: A specially coated armor designed with the intent of nullifying illnesses. It is most beneficial when used in tandem with equipment of similar attributes.

records.name: Virulent Venom
records.about: Exposure to this ferocious concoction is so intensely lethal that it acts instantaneously. Its deceptively small vial allows for easy use.

records.name: Toxin Tooth
records.about: An appalling dagger with a blade forged of a highly resilient metal, one of the very few materials that can withstand the corrosive properties surrounding it.

records.name: Kiritsukeru
records.about: A heavy iron blade set in a handle crafted from tough wood from the eastern tundras. Each slash carries immense amounts of force.

records.name: Watarimono
records.about: A blade made from iron stuck in firm dark oak. The raw power of each strike compensates for the blunt edge.

records.name: Reinforced Root Armor
records.about: A breastplate crafted from sturdy plantlife and shards of iron. The plants seem to react when hit heavily.

records.name: Traveler's Trinket
records.about: A handy compass that reminds travelers of the homes they will someday return to.

records.name: Tideturner Trident
records.about: A decorated forked weapon which can influence and control water, sending torrential downpours of calamity at aggressors.

records.name: Slurpian Sea Scroll
records.about: An enchanted parchment, written in the Slurpian dialect. Its magic commands the tides, allowing one to propel their own movement.

records.name: Oceanic Apparel
records.about: Woven together from the silk of the oceanic Deepstriders, this robe is completely resistant to the tides of the ocean. Such garments are commonplace for royal Slurp attire.

records.name: Imperial Keepsake
records.about: As a memento of their kingdom, royal slurps are given one of these sacred pearls when adventuring out into the world.

records.name: Magic Wand
records.about: The classic kit of a magician, built to both dazzle and destroy one's enemies.

records.name: Lightshow Scepter
records.about: This enchanted cane adds pizzazz to any battle! The cleverly engineered lighting effects inside become stronger for a bigger audience.

records.name: Magician's Robe
records.about: Filled with all the necessary tools of showmanship, this dapper robe is a must-have for any true magician.

records.name: Performer's Hat
records.about: A classy top hat known to have all manner of surprises in store, including rabbits, of course.

records.name: Burning Retribution Spell
records.about: A catastrophic spell of holy destruction, concocted in secrecy by the Liturgical Ones in their quest to learn a single letter of the divine language.

records.name: Quiver of the Autumn King
records.about: A sun iron quiver passed through a royal elven lineage, whose legendary skills in archery have protected the forest kingdoms for millennia.

records.name: Cloak of Nightmares
records.about: A moonwoven cloak worn by slayer cults who spill the blood of emperors in their abhorrent mission to create a new order.

records.name: Helm of the Tribune
records.about: An ashen helm of regal grandeur, whose wearers have upraised the greatest legions and inspired total domination.

records.name: Shield of Orcish Regalia
records.about: A mighty shield smithed in the burning rivers of the demonic realms to grant the right of sovereignty over the brutal Orclands.

records.name: Seal of Invocation
records.about: A jubilant seal of celebration, granted to the most righteous crusaders as they challenge the evergrowing threat of demonic legions.

records.name: Necrofish Poison
records.about: The oceanic Necrofish's highly noxious poisons, secreted from its spines to befoul entire swaths of the seas.

records.name: Depthchaser Trap
records.about: An explosive ocean trap constructed to tear open the ironhide of the abyssal deepworm.

records.name: Dimensiongate Orb
records.about: An anomalous orb utilized by the astralmancers to banish demons who rose against them into a timeless void.

records.name: Prism of Reveries
records.about: A scintillating prism of duplicity, infiltrating the deepest corners of the mind to awaken phantasmic entities that embody hatred and fear.

records.name: Scepter of the Firmament
records.about: An azure scepter of elemental dominion, wielded by the sky charioteers to command the natural order of the overlands and the orchestration of astral bodies.

records.name: Dynastic Star
records.about: A heraldic shuriken of the ancient royal family, revered for its astonishingly lethal edge after generations of use by a mighty eastern empire.

records.name: Virtuous Wakizashi
records.about: A pristine wakizashi exalted by the archangels themselves and awarded to combatants with the most pure hearts.

records.name: Spell of Galactic Creation
records.about: A sacred spell of both order and annihilation, accumulating ancient energies to fabricate a macrocosmic system and destroy it in the blink of an eye.

records.name: Quiver of Gaia
records.about: A treasured arboreal quiver wielded by heralds of the Earth Goddess. It fires arrows of sacred life energy which smite corruption and darkness.

records.name: Cloak of Emptiness
records.about: An ancient duskcloak that shifts in and out of existence, swaddling its wearer in an all-consuming nothingness.

records.name: Helm of Imperial Right
records.about: A direhelm worn by the champions of men in their steadfast conquest of realms beyond even death.

records.name: Shield of Belligerence
records.about: An indestructible shield crafted by the earthgiants, bearing a long history of destruction and strife by entire nations who wish to claim it.

records.name: Seal of Righteous Victory
records.about: A crimson seal that is granted phenomenal power through the spilled blood of martyrs who fought for the welfare of all mankind.

records.name: Grimhydra Poison
records.about: Horrific toxins taken from the fangs of the plutonian Grimhydra, diluted with lesser poisons to make it possible for mortals to handle.

records.name: Mantlecrusher Trap
records.about: An enormously dangerous trap engineered by blastsmith dwarves to annihilate the magma dragons that threaten their underkingdoms.

records.name: Realitylapse Orb
records.about: An unstable darkquartz orb used by reality-bending warlocks to tear open holes in existence and lock away enemies of the gods.

records.name: Prism of Mindscapes
records.about: A brilliant moonjade prism cut from a forsaken jewel that corrupts the consciousness and imprints psychopathic monsters in the feebleminded.

records.name: Scepter of Luminous Winds
records.about: A vermillion scepter of the heavenly sovereign, utilized in the formation of the mortal realms by cleaving the infinite aether into a tremendous starstorm.

records.name: Circle of Unity
records.about: A marvelous treasure and destructive weapon that embodies the cardinal duality of light and dark.

records.name: Paragon Wakizashi
records.about: A flawless diamond gifted as a symbol of gratitude from the shogunate and regarded among the finest blades ever constructed.

records.name: Novice's Lute
records.about: A magical lute that inspires allies.

records.name: Oakwood Lute
records.about: A sturdy lute made of finely cut oakwood.

records.name: Iron Lute
records.about: A special lute given to apprentice musicians to compose their finest ballads.

records.name: Silver Lute
records.about: A polished lute built for combat against undead menaces.

records.name: Battle Lute
records.about: A lightweight lute designed to project strong sounds across the chaos of battlefields.

records.name: Regal Lute
records.about: An immaculate lute granted to the appointed bards of wealthy rulers as their travel companions.

records.name: Skyward Lute
records.about: A misty lute created by the exalted songweavers in their task to awaken the wind deity Shu.

records.name: Nebular Lute
records.about: A mysterious lute of dark matter, capable of playing joyous songs even in the oppressive sound void of space.

records.name: Nether Lute
records.about: A fiery lute consumed in scorching heat, whose sounds inspire hope among grief for the anguished souls bound to eternal perdition.

records.name: Harmonious Harp
records.about: A delightful instrument played among the serene choirs of saintly singers in the hallowed realms above.

records.name: Angel's Fanfare
records.about: A resplendent trumpet used to signify the coming of the end times, prophesied to sound their most glorious note at the opening of the seventh seal.

records.name: Wings of Sanctity
records.about: A breathtaking pair of delicate white wings used by the empyrean seraphim to reach the highest peaks of the heavens.

records.name: Heavenly Halo
records.about: A ring of light bestowed upon the virtuous as a divine symbol of their consecration.

records.name: Wavecrest Concertina
records.about: A rather peculiar instrument played by the sailors of the seven seas. Its music has the unique property of attracting parrots that will obey the musician's every command.

records.name: Snake Charmer Pungi
records.about: A ceremonial pungi that contains the spirits of fifteen snakes, guiding the righteous through their many paths ahead.
in: item:Snake Charmer Pungi#Snake Charmer Pungi Shiny

records.name: Pharaoh's Requiem
records.about: An unusually crafted lute with an ancient style of construction, meant to produce soothing sounds of deep sleep and keep wrathful gods dormant.

records.name: Abyssal Trophy
records.about: An imposing golden trophy smelted from the crumbled remains of a demonic idol and personally molded by Archdemon Malphas. The few who are capable of holding it for themselves are said to be filled with immense vigor.

records.name: Siege Scepter
records.about: First assembled as a combat modification to Treasurer Gemsbok's gilded scepter, this artifact consumes substantial magical energy to detonate a chaotic blast.

records.name: AoOScepterProc
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Rage Claws
records.about: Oryx's unseen strikers wield these serrated claws for precise and deadly slashes to make an example out of the Mad God's most hated adversaries.

records.name: AoOStarProc
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Cursed Spire Spell
records.about: All but Chancellor Dammah's own mages shun this blasphemous spell, channeling the dark energies of the earth to construct an explosive spike.

records.name: Amaterasu
records.about: A sacred blade forged by the ancient worshippers of the sun god. Though now corrupted under Oryx's rule, its unique craftsmanship still showcases its ability to focus a strike upon a single point.

records.name: Blacklight Artifice
records.about: An alluring entanglement forged with razor-like black iron. Oryx's most adept hunters use this device to severely wound their prey before executing them.

records.name: Demon Lord's Skull
records.about: The charred remains of an ancient demon ruler once killed by the Mad God. Oryx's wicked spellcasters have cursed it with the ability to resurrect and control demons.

records.name: Prism of Shattered Light
records.about: This prism's light-storing ability makes it essential equipment for Oryx's recon squad, granting them unmatched efficiency in any scenario.

records.name: Tome of the Tarnished Gods
records.about: An accursed collection of religious texts detailing the Mad God's rise to power, granted to Oryx's high priests by Archbishop Leucoryx as a symbol of utmost trust.

records.name: Cloak of the Darkened Sun
records.about: A firm cloak worn by Oryx's stealth agents to assist in quiet takedowns. It doubles as protection for any compromised situation.

records.name: Orb of Conquest
records.about: Oryx's sentries use these cursed orbs as their watchful eyes, maintaining and enforcing the Mad God's constant rule across the realm.

records.name: Chief's War Horn
records.about: Chief Beisa personally made this decorated horn to produce a deep, booming sound, rallying troops and sending signals to coordinate unrelenting assaults.

records.name: Seal of the Battle God
records.about: Given to Oryx's most esteemed gladiators, this twisted artifact is capable of focusing all of the wearer's strength into a single blow, mirroring the Mad God's own fighting style.

records.name: Helm of Exalted Might
records.about: A helm forged in the deepest depths of Oryx's realm. Those who wear it are said to feel a dark power coursing through their veins.

records.name: Brutal Buckler
records.about: In contrast to Oryx's personal equipment, this lightweight shield is too small to stagger an opponent. It is instead covered in jagged metal to shred targets.

records.name: AoO Shield Proc
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Mad Javelin
records.about: Oryx's most versatile bowmen receive javelin training, requiring a steady hand and perfect focus to inflict devastating damage.

records.name: Tyrant's Toxin
records.about: Oryx demanded his alchemists make a poison capable of killing more rapidly to satisfy his impatience. The resulting brew proved rather explosive.

records.name: Droplet of Ambrosia
records.about: A glistening droplet of the god's nectar.\n\nSprite Credits: Aurum

records.name: Vial of Pure Ambrosia
records.about: Your secret weapon against the monsters in the realm.\n\nSprite Credits: Seelpit

records.name: Chalice of Ambrosia
records.about: A sip of this will make you feel like a real god.

records.name: Avarice
records.about: The pride of Treasurer Gemsbok, this gilded knife has backstabbed countless traders in shady dealings.

records.name: Gambler's Fate
records.about: A coin pilfered from the endless vault of Gemsbok's hoarded wealth. Only the most daring would stake their lives on the equal odds of a coin flip.

records.name: Turncoat Cape
records.about: This covering is assigned to Oryx's negotiators to conceal weaponry and get away with stolen fortunes.

records.name: Collector's Monocle
records.about: Treasurer Gemsbok had this monocle custom made to enhance his perception in stealth strikes.

records.name: Lumiaire
records.about: This ceremonial mace controls the forces of light and darkness. Archbishop Leucoryx uses it for distinguished offerings in the name of his god.

records.name: Chaotic Scripture
records.about: The sacred writings of Leucoryx and his disciples, compiled as a tribute to Oryx to lend false credence to the teachings of his twisted followers.

records.name: Vesture of Duality
records.about: This cursed robe overwhelms the wearer with conflicting thoughts of good and evil, shattering the will of the weak-minded.
in: item:Vesture of Duality#Vesture of Duality Shiny

records.name: Divine Coronation
records.about: A majestic crown of the venerated, bestowed upon Archbishop Leucoryx to solidify his position in Oryx's legion.

records.name: Superior
records.about: This aptly named staff is the manifestation of Chancellor Dammah's assertions of grandeur. Although he seldom uses it for actual combat purposes, it is no less potent as a legitimate weapon.

records.name: Genesis Spell
records.about: Dammah's powers of summoning portals stem from this profane spell. Most may use it to call attacks from primitive dimensions of untapped energy, but Oryx's greatest thaumaturges can create stable gateways to the realm and beyond.

records.name: Diplomatic Robe
records.about: The diplomacy of Chancellor Dammah goes as far as his limited patience. The true purpose of this robe is its deeply woven enchantment to bolster arcane powers.

records.name: Chancellor's Cranium
records.about: The warped mind of Oryx's appointed chancellor. This cursed object thrives in the presence of demented energies.

records.name: Summoning Mace
records.about: An enchanted mace that summons allies.

records.name: Ritual Mace
records.about: A mace which materializes mystical creatures to support in combat.

records.name: Disciple Mace
records.about: A gleaming mace capable of powerful summons for those who are experienced in the magical arts.

records.name: Specialist Mace
records.about: A decorated mace of high status, signifying achievement in advanced summoning styles.

records.name: Adept Mace
records.about: An imposing mace built specifically for battle application, staggering foes with its intimidating design.

records.name: Monarch Mace
records.about: A majestically grand mace used in royal courts as a show of formidable might.

records.name: Sovereign Mace
records.about: An opulent mace built of dense nightmatter and enchanted to harness the power of the infinite void for unspeakably powerful summoning.

records.name: Grandmaster Mace
records.about: A supremely dominant mace of faultless design, capable of manifesting entire armies in the astral wars.

records.name: Overlord Mace
records.about: A consummate mace present since the formative era of the universe, believed to have created life itself in the hand of a long forgotten deity.

records.name: Mace of the Celestial Forest
records.about: Limon's power of nature restoration are infused into this mace for her children to wield, traversing the realm and planting seeds of new life in the wake of wanton destruction.
in: item:Mace of the Celestial Forest#Mace of the Celestial Forest Shiny

records.name: Mace of the Depths
records.about: This formerly ordinary mace was twisted by Arachna's son after plucking it from a hapless victim. Though he has no reason to use it himself, some believe the Son of Arancha keeps it as reminder to his kin to not cross him as he did his mother.
in: item:Mace of the Depths#Mace of the Depths Shiny

records.name: Hivemind Mace
records.about: The guiding power of the realm's pollinating drones. Even when stolen from their proper queen, it can still briefly influence their minds to service.

records.name: Incubation Mace
records.about: Easter celebrations call for eggs, but Oryx's strict regulations on anything that might be a chicken makes eggs risky. This mace mimics the functions of an egg to summon pre-grown rabbits, with exactly the personality you'd expect from an animal raised by a weapon.

records.name: Minotaur Mace
records.about: Labyrinth guarding calls for beasts, but Oryx's strict regulations on anything that might be a cow makes bulls risky. This mace mimics the functions of a maze to summon pre-grown minotaurs, with exactly the personality you'd expect from a monster raised by a weapon.

records.name: Big Berdtha
records.about: A mace capable of channeling the skills of one of Bilgewater's most prolific gunslingers.

records.name: C.L.A.W.
records.about: A highly versatile tool modified from what was once just a vial holder. It can extend and retract, tighten for wrench functions, and shoot energy blasts. All the usual tools of science!

records.name: B.O.O.M.
records.about: Development of this compact M.E.R.V. took an explosive turn.

records.name: A.R.M.O.R.
records.about: Not to be confused with a more traditional lab coat, this robe is steeped in chemicals to protect from radiation. This same substance surrounds the labratory's protective A.E.G.I.S. system.

records.name: C.O.N.T.R.O.L.L.E.R.
records.about: This feat of technology enables approved users to control all primary functions of the lab facility and access otherwise encrypted data.

records.name: Mechanical Mace
records.about: A wicked mace constructed by Dr. Terrible to impose the Mad God's will. It stands as one of Oryx's greatest attempts at merging magic and technology.

records.name: Crystal Mace
records.about: Small particles of energy visibly buzz around inside the glistening crystals of this mace.

records.name: Recursion Mace
records.about: A self-obsessed summoner's failed attempt at creating infinite armies.

records.name: Mace of the North Pole
records.about: The bitter cold of the realm's most frigid point is encased in this mace's handle, channeling the temperature to summon a creature hardy enough to endure such conditions.

records.name: Lullaby
records.about: A soothing crescent-shaped instrument known to relax one's body and mind when played, lowering their guard and making oneself drowsy. Only its player can hear the quiet melodies, sure to have them counting sheep in no time.

records.name: Carrot Cake
records.about: Biff asked the Appetizer for it many times. In the end, he didn't like it.\n\nSprite Credits: Maggiemagi

records.name: Solar Potato
records.about: An old tale speaks of an ancient alchemist named Mortimer, it is said that he only ate potatoes and only drank energy drinks. He slowly went mad and started worshiping potatoes. Eventually he sought to combine the two items he consumed and created this. The potato is surprisingly potent, despite being a bit....soggy.\n\nSprite Credits: Sues

records.name: Hot Cross Buns
records.about: There is nothing quite like fresh pastry.\n\nSprite Credits: Maggiemagi

records.name: Roast Biff
