records.name: Abyssal Insignia
records.about: A mystifying sigil from an otherwordly domain. The power sealed within causes it to faintly pull at its surroundings, attempting to draw them into the void.

records.name: Vortex Plating
records.about: The individual plates of this armor shift constantly in and out of realms under the Void's influence. The few mortals that have found, let alone are able to wear this cursed armor become entranced in protective and destructive forces.

records.name: Eye of the Void
records.about: Though lacking physical form, this trinket grants a sense of sight that allows beings from the realm of shadow to peer into the worlds bathed in light.

records.name: Archangel's Judgement
records.about: The eldest of Daeva warriors crafted this sacred weapon to smite all that dare oppose the forces of the light.

records.name: Daevite Progenitor
records.about: A glorious artifact, bestowed upon mortals from Daeva warriors. Emulating their altruistic goals, this prism can forge countless fighters from the pure lights of the heavens.

records.name: Seraphim's Guard
records.about: These garments have been meticulously crafted over the millennia to serve the Daeva, helping them ward off and fight against the ever burning forces of darkness.

records.name: Flames of Genesis
records.about: A mere flame from the legendary forgefire used by Daeva master crafters, this trinket grants awe-inspiring powers to those deemed worthy.

records.name: Mystery Paladin ST Crate
records.about:
An otherworldly crate whose contents appear formless, only manifesting when pried open. Open it to get one of the following:

*Fallen One's Blade
*Abyssal Insignia
*Vortex Plating
*Eye of the Void
*Mini Corrupted Paladin Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover

records.name: Mystery Trickster ST Crate
records.about:
A holy crate assembled by an elusive angelic race seen with greater frequency in recent times. Open it to get one of the following:

*Archangel's Judgement
*Daevite Progenitor
*Seraphim's Guard
*Flames of Genesis
*Mini Daeva Trickster Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover

records.name: Dagger of Eternal Chaos
records.about: A vile weapon ablaze with the Void's malevolent intent.

records.name: Bow of the Sky's Glory
records.about: A celestial bow that strikes as true as its wielder's heart is.

records.name: Staff of Silver Wings
records.about: A staff that can only be wielded by those embodying both justice and power.

records.name: Wand of the Summoned One
records.about: Brought forth by an intruder from the Void, this wand has a mind of its own.

records.name: Sword of the Unending Chaos
records.about: A heavy blade wielded by the monstrous warriors of the Void.

records.name: Skybound Blade
records.about: An instrument of justice, enchanted in the clouds.

records.name: Shadowbeast Hide
records.about: Crafted from the hide of an unspeakable horror.

records.name: Robe of Dark Summoning
records.about: Said to give power over the forces of the Void, at a price higher than most are willing to pay.

records.name: Armor of Heavenly Light
records.about: The shining armor worn by the winged Daeva warriors.

records.name: Ember of the Void
records.about: A burning shard hailing from the Void itself; the concentrated torment of lost souls.

records.name: Ember of the Daeva
records.about: A small yet potent flame brought down from the heavens. It burns bright with the power of life.

records.name: Broccoli
records.about: A healthy, tree-shaped snack. Guaranteed to contain zero tree!

records.name: French Toast
records.about: Cholesterol won't be an issue. Promise!

records.name: Banana
records.about: Full of potassium and only a little radioactive!

records.name: Ripe Pumpkin
records.about: It is orange, round and full of nutrients.

records.name: Ice Cream
records.about: Refreshing, but may give your pet brain freeze.

records.name: Solar Cupcake
records.about: With the caloric power of a thousand suns!

records.name: Dark Ambrosia
records.about: A twisted concoction, created after imbuing the golden nectar of the gods with the power of the Void.

records.name: Sanctified Ambrosia
records.about: The very lifeblood of holiness.

records.name: Mead
records.about: Straight from the heavens, this drink may give your pet abilities in poetry.

records.name: Space Jam
records.about: Do not be alarmed by its toxic green color - Calbrik's grandma actually whipped it together from common herbs.

records.name: Deadly Dapperling
records.about: Definitely not poisonous. Actually mimics a poisonous mushroom. Trust it!

records.name: Protein Shake
records.about: Yeah, it does taste a bit weird. Worth it, though!

records.name: Void Venom
records.about: A solution of the Void's concentrated power, this potent elixir may kill you... or make you stronger.

records.name: Daeva Elixir
records.about: With its fresh, herbal taste, this sparkling potion invokes a feeling of euphoria and overwhelming confidence.

records.name: Grapes of Heaven
records.about: Grown in the clouds and fermented to make Ambrosia.

records.name: Peacekeeper
records.about: A veritable artifact from the forgotten splendor of a kingdom none wish to remember. No matter the craftsmanship of its gilded design, this unwelcome sight is now only a sobering reminder of a mistake without regret.

records.name: Vanguard's Visage
records.about: A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.

records.name: Noble Mandolin
records.about: Endless melodies from this fine instrument once filled the halls of the castle. It is without any apparent wear, yet even the most upbeat tune sounds somber when it is played.

records.name: Polarity Poison
records.about: A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.

records.name: Sentinel's Sidearm
records.about: Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.

records.name: Primal Arcana
records.about: This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.

records.name: Color Orb Red Projectile
records.said: Color Orb Red Projectile (Primal Arcana Proc)
in: item:Color Orb Red Projectile#Primal Arcana Proc (Rehearsal)
item:Color Orb Red Projectile#Primal Arcana Proc Shiny

records.name: Valor
records.about: Exceedingly large and challenging to handle, this titanic blade embodies the stoic might of its true owner.

records.name: Dusky Catalyst
records.about: An untempered casting wand brought forth to tap into distant powers, but an imbalance rendered it too unreliable for most to dare use.

records.name: Warmonger
records.about: Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.

records.name: Mantle of the Monarchy
records.about: The lavish robes of the kingdom's royalty, outfitted with pauldrons on both shoulders for a more distinguished appearance. A sinister presence remains channeled through the draping fabric.

records.name: Vest of Abandoned Shadows
records.about: Formerly a nobleman's uniform, now workshopped by the court magician into a gloomy coat befitting of his accursed company.
in: item:Vest of Abandoned Shadows#Vest of Abandoned Shadows Shiny

records.name: Royal Guard's Cuirass
records.about: Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.
in: item:Royal Guard's Cuirass#Royal Guard's Cuirass Shiny

records.name: Herbal Tincture
records.about: A small dose of a bitter-tasting remedy from the Shattered Kingdom. In a strange sense, it feels older than the kingdom itself.

records.name: The Forgotten Ring
records.about: Part of a sacramental rite, the memory of which has faded with those who observed its divine grace.
in: item:The Forgotten Ring#The Forgotten Ring Shiny

records.name: Gift of the Void
records.about: An ill-gained boon. Open it to reach into the Void.

records.name: Gift of the Daeva
records.about: A blessing not given freely. Open it to reach into the heavens.

records.name: Antinomy Artifact
records.about: True power is only available to those that have accepted all of its manifestations. To wield force that could affect the cosmic balance, one needs to forge their own equilibrium, tempered in the flames of strife.

records.name: Autumn Gift
records.about: The acorn is the squirrel's favorite snack! Dig into with this delightful treat.\n\nItems contained in Autumn Treasure can only be redeemed until the 16th of November 2021.

records.name: Secret Hoard
records.about: A secret stash of 100 000 gold. Contact support to claim it, as they are the only ones to know its location.\n\nCan only be redeemed until the 22nd of January 2024..

records.name: Backup Stash
records.about: A secret stash of 15 000 gold. Contact support to claim it, as they are the only ones to know its location.\n\nCan only be redeemed until the 22nd of January 2024.

records.name: Key to Oryx's Armory
records.about: You only have time to grab an ST set before Beisa himself barges in! Contact support to claim it and escape the armory.\n\nCan only be redeemed until the 22nd of January 2024.

records.name: Mirror of Vanity
records.about: Said to be a wish-granting mirror, but likely to be cursed. Contact support to claim three skins of choice, and be careful of your wishes.\n\nCan only be redeemed until the 22nd of January 2024.

records.name: Autumn Treasure
records.about: You are the luckiest squirrel in the Realm! Not many have been able to ever set eyes in this golden acorn.\n\nItems contained in Autumn Treasure can only be redeemed until the 16th of November 2021.

records.name: Latte
records.about: A cozy yet refreshing beverage.

records.name: Jack-o-Lantern
records.about: While the wax from the candle inside might be considered unhealthy (nevermind the flame), Realm pets seem to love it unconditionally.

records.name: Pumpkin Spice Latte
records.about: An autumn cafe-goer's best friend.

records.name: Bloody Ambrosia
records.about: A traditional fare at the Manor of the Immortals, this modified Ambrosia contains a healthy amount of iron.

records.name: Droplet of Bloody Ambrosia
records.about: A mosquito's fare.

records.name: Vial of Bloody Ambrosia
records.about: Just a sample of an exquisite cocktail. If you're a vampire.

records.name: Chalice of Bloody Ambrosia
records.about: But really, it's mostly made of fruits. Mostly.

records.name: Haunted Tombstone
records.about: A very eerie looking tombstone. Decipher it to find a Halloween Wizard or Necromancer ST item hidden behind it.

records.name: Moon Rage Proc
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Savage Claws
records.about: The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!

records.name: Beastly Mane
records.about: The Lycanthrope, with beastly mane!

records.name: Ragetorn Armor
records.about: Beware the Lycanthrope, my son!

records.name: Moonstone Ring
records.about: And shun the frumious Man-Wolf-Beast!

records.name: Tormented Shriek
records.about: When the curious Summoner first laid hands upon this artifact, it emitted a haunting shriek. The terror it stirred within her was enough to predict her demise.

records.name: Ghastly Mace
records.about: Now fated to perpetuate the Banshee's curse, the Summoner wielded power over lesser spirits.

records.name: Lacerated Gown
records.about: Her robe, once boldly red, was reduced to ghostly tatters.

records.name: Unresolved Grudge
records.about: She would always carry an overpowering desire of revenge upon those that set her on this cursed path. She would pursue them for eternity.

records.name: Holy Artifact
records.about: When he heard about the horrifying Banshee at Septavius' side, the Archexorcist set out on his holiest quest yet, wielding an artifact wrested from the very hands of a God.

records.name: Tome of Exorcism
records.about: It takes zealotry bordering on madness to even dare utter the scathing words within this Tome. Its very contents blurred his vision and set his head to spinning. But he would dare.

records.name: Garb of the Ordained
records.about: He would face this threat wearing his most ceremonial garments.

records.name: Pontifex Ring
records.about: The origin of the stone in this ring, and its connection to the staff that bore the Banshee's curse: a secret he would carry to his grave.

records.name: Silver Revolvers
records.about: Lord Ruthven had acquired a veritable monster from who-knows-where. Luckily, her bullets cured lycanthropy.

records.name: Consecrated Trap
records.about: She had the Archexorcist himself bless this trap. She hoped it would be enough to help catch a miscreation of this size.

records.name: Metal-plated Corset
records.about: Of course, a quirk of her... condition was the overwhelming desire to look great.

records.name: Vial of Sustenance
records.about: And still, she would not let the Vampire's curse she carried define her. Just as she would go on to rid others of their own curses. With violence, if needed.

records.name: Cloak of Eerie Trepidation
records.about: A cloak that makes one's skin crawl with the dread of its short-lived former owner.

records.name: Hailstorm
records.about: Tugging the bowstring fiber disrupts a delicate balance between the limbs of this bow, rapidly crystallizing the surrounding frost into a serrated bolt of hail.

records.name: Thundering Chorus
records.about: Baneful beats of this waist-worn instrument rile the skies, invoking the occluded power of the storm.

records.name: Wind Dancer Robe
records.about: Hardly attire of any sort, but rather a sustained cone of latent energy called forth by unseen wind spirits. Stray gusts glide beneath each step, affording both impressive speed and a thrilling lighter-than-air sensation.

records.name: Augur of the Tempest
records.about: A breathtaking amulet believed to portend the will of the storm. The large stone within faintly swirls, as though an entire cyclone were somehow petrified by force of the earth.

records.name: Earthen Ward
records.about: Strictly speaking, this is no wand at all, and rather blunt even for a channeling device. Yet its crude appearance belies a sophisticated tool of deterrence, a contrast very much in character for the spirits of the earth.

records.name: Stonemould Mace
records.about: To fabricate colossi from within the earth is a rare and enviable practice, often deemed sacred. The creations of this club-like mace are too brittle for the interest of certain parties, but the proven potential is a precious thing indeed.

records.name: Rocky Robe
records.about: The practices of the earth mages died out with their bloodline, a consequence of notoriously being rather secretive types. But the traits of this garb, hardy and unyielding, tell much of their ways.

records.name: Steadfast Glyph
records.about: When etched into stone, this mark greatly amplifies one's resilience, as though it echoes the earth's power. Hollow relics like these are an oddity, as earth shamans regarded the designed permission of flowing air as a sign of severe fault.

records.name: Slashing Sheath
records.about: A standard, lightweight sheath fit for enabling quick draws in a forward dash.

records.name: Timber Sheath
records.about: A dependable sheath carved of petrified wood, with a finely curved slot to optimize draw force.

records.name: Vineland Sheath
records.about: A meticulously crafted sheath built of stretched vines and parallel blades of grass for a smoother blade release.

records.name: Haze Sheath
records.about: A curious sheath designed to evoke the effortless flow of clouds and fog.

records.name: Ichor Sheath
records.about: A fierce sheath made to spill the blood of gods, briefly filling the wielder with a beastly aggression when a blade is drawn.

records.name: Serpentine Sheath
records.about: An elegant teal sheath with masterful snake etchings both inside and out, amplifying the momentum of a swift strike from the hip.

records.name: Great Shinobi Sheath
records.about: An extravagant gilded sheath which was once the heirloom of a distant clan, a now extinct bloodline whose intricate weapon arts remain in practice.

records.name: Sonic Wave Sheath
records.about: A marvelous sheath of inimitably brilliant constitution. Drawing one's blade from within emits a furious sonic wave, propelling the weapon beyond its known limits.

records.name: Asura Sheath
records.about: A detestably vengeful sheath consumed in the violet flames of Asura, a hateful deity scorned since the time of the ancients.

records.name: Volcanic Sheath
records.about: Archdemon Malphas took a conspicuous liking to this outsider's sheath, smuggled in by a newly demonic soul. Perhaps its design reminded him of something?

records.name: Kaiken
records.about: Still believing himself a monk, Daichi knew an open blade contrasts his superficial rank. Yet he could not bear to abandon his wicked material weapon, and so he forever concealed it with this sheath.

records.name: Labyrinth Dweller's Sheath
records.about: The Woodland Labyrinth is a lamentable example of mortal meddling in the ways of nature, a harsh reality its occupants are keenly aware of. A sheath like this, fully embracing their own ways of life, is no doubt a bitter expression of dissent.
in: item:Labyrinth Dweller's Sheath#Labyrinth Dweller's Sheath Shiny

records.name: Quartermaster Scabbard
records.about: A foreign sheath stolen from unknown lands by the crew of Davy Jones. Now phantoms, the headstrong ghost pirates have misused this delicate instrument as a rapier holder, twisting its effects with their chaotic ways.

records.name: Irradiance Sheath
records.about: Believed to be some kind of artificial organ, this sheath embeds the weapon in a solid crystal coating before violently fracturing into shrapnel when drawn.

records.name: Blitz Sheath
records.about: Swift, ruthless, and a perfect encapsulation of Oryx's militia. Vicious aggression to overwhelm one's enemies has been the Mad God's tactic of choice since the day he earned his title.

records.name: Snowman's Sheath
records.about: A glacial seal consumes any weapon held within, solidifying a layer of permafrost to enable smoother draws with the elegance of falling snow.

records.name: Saif of the Deep
records.about: In the right hands, this fluid blade lashes out with stinging water whips. Such adept control over the wild waters is thought to be a sign of great achievement for any swordsman.

records.name: Loch Sheath
records.about: Masters of swordsmanship recognize how much can be learned from the flow of the ocean's waves.

records.name: Barrier Reef
records.about: Reinforced coral creates a form of shock absorbing plates, a crucial trait for surviving the high pressure of the ocean floor.

records.name: Alexander's Band
records.about: A keepsake held closely by Thessal, clinging to the unlikely chance of her king's continued wellbeing. Any sailor knows this slim hope is all that contains the true beast of the seas.

records.name: Cornbread
records.about: It's tasty and it will not ruin your pet's diet!

records.name: Pecan Pie
records.about: Some pets go nuts for it.

records.name: Apple Pie
records.about: We have no idea what sort of apples were used to bake this pie, but all the pets seem to love it.

records.name: Mashed Potatoes
records.about: Ah yes, some people just like their solar potatoes mashed.

records.name: Turkey Cake
records.about: No actual turkeys were harmed during the making of this cake, they were only used as consultants.

records.name: Mystery Summoner ST Crate
records.about:
A crate with earthly strength, solid enough to seemingly bend the space around it. Open it to get one of the following:

*Earthen Ward
*Stonemould Mace
*Rocky Robe
*Steadfast Glyph
*Mini Earthen Bulwark Summoner Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover

records.name: Mystery Bard ST Crate
records.about:
A crate crackling with the untamed power of the storm. Open it to get one of the following:

*Hailstorm
*Thundering Chorus
*Wind Dancer Robe
*Augur of the Tempest
*Mini Storm Caller Bard Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover

records.about: A skin from Basic to Exalted that might suit one of your heroes from any class.

records.about: Grants a random Skin for this class when used!

records.about: Grants a random Skin for this class when used!

records.about: Grants a random Skin for this class when used!

records.about: A skin from the Basic Rank that might suit one of your heroes from any class.

records.name: Greater Mystery Skin
records.about: A skin from the Greater Rank that might suit one of your heroes from any class.

records.name: Superior Mystery Skin
records.about: A skin from the Superior Rank that might suit one of your heroes from any class.

records.name: Paramount Mystery Skin
records.about: A skin from the Paramount Rank that might suit one of your heroes from any class.

records.name: Exalted Mystery Skin
records.about: A skin from the Exalted Rank that might suit one of your heroes from any class.

records.about: Grants a random Pet Skin from the Basic Rank when used!

records.name: Greater Mystery Pet Skin
records.about: Grants a random Pet Skin from the Greater Rank when used!

records.about: Grants a random Pet Skin from the Superior Rank when used!

records.about: Grants a random Pet Skin from the Paramount Rank when used!

records.about: Grants a random Pet Skin from the Exalted Rank when used!

records.about: Grants a random Valentine Skin when used!

records.name: Mystery Pet Skin
records.about: Grants a random Pet Skin from Basic to Exalted when used!

records.name: Spring Gift
records.about: As the plentiful bounty of a flourishing Spring is bestowed upon the Realm, see what her gift to you may be.\n\nItems contained in Spring Treasure can only be redeemed until the 14th of May 2022.

records.name: Spring Treasure
records.about: A rare and exquisite flower, found in the wildest reaches of a Realm in the height of Spring.\n\nItems contained in Spring Treasure can only be redeemed until the 14th of May 2022.

records.name: Mystery Kensei ST Crate
records.about:
Flames dance upon the molten surface of this crate. Open it to get one of the following:

*Fiery Katana
*Pyro Sheath
*Flame Guard
*Firelight Necklace
*Mini Fiery Kensei Skin
*Char Slot Unlocker
*Vault Chest Unlocker
*Ambrosia
*Mystery ST Shard x5
*Golden Clover

records.name: Fiery Katana
records.about: A light powerful blade, capable of burning even the toughest opponents.

records.name: Pyro Sheath
records.about: This sheath can be a great tool in the hands of an experienced Kensei.

records.name: Flame Guard
records.about: Made of refractory material, this heavy armor is capable of summoning a powerful creature for extra defense.

records.name: Firelight Necklace
records.about: A beautiful accessory which burns constantly to guide you through battle.

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Fire
records.about: ...a driving force, indeed the driving force of nature and of civilization, would drive us once again to...

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Air
records.about: We sought to ape its astonishing force, to reproduce it in our environment...

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Water
records.about: ...the principle of things that are, Water could take all forms that make up our world, and we harnessed it...

records.name: Amulet of Elemental Earth
records.about: ...our Mother and our Essence and our livelihood... we would now seek its full potential.

records.name: Elemental Equilibrium
records.about: Within this relic all elements swirl in perfect equilibrium. What would otherwise unleash cataclysmic disaster holds together in immaculate arcane homeostasis. We would surpass it.

records.name: Tsunami
records.about: And the Great Wave bore upon our dwellings, flushing us and our beasts and our tools... but one remained, and he held aloft his blade, and summoned to himself the powers that still haunted this place.

records.name: Arashi
records.about: Our elder would look upon the storms and pondered on how a thing with no substance could leave but desolation in its wake.

records.name: Ignis
records.about: What force would do but the very force behind life and movement? No other. This weapon would prove it.

records.name: Tectonus
records.about: She had read the tomes of other races, and she had the wisdom of the Earth. She saw how we must proceed.

records.name: Book of Water
records.about: Its pages are slightly damp and little of the ink remains readable after apparent water damage. It was a treatise on Water by an eminent sage, but someone has been scribbling in the margins.

records.name: Book of Air
records.about: Not many pages remain of this tome. It was a treatise on Air by a famous philosopher, but someone has been using it to seemingly keep records.

records.name: Book of Fire
records.about: Most of this book has burned away. It was a treatise on Fire by an ancient scholar, but some of the text differs.

records.name: Book of Earth
records.about: Most of its pages have been damaged or torn away. It was a treatise on Earth by a learned one, but it has been written on again at a later time.

records.name: Bolt Thrower
records.about: This experimental device harnesses the power of lightning, allowing you to science your enemies senseless with raw energy.

records.name: Lightning Rod
records.about: Slamming this charred iron rod into the ground will summon elemental energies to blast anyone who comes close.

records.name: Wedding Dress
records.about: You can barely tell that this dress was taken from a poor bride who was buried in it.

records.name: Gothic Bouffant
records.about: This gigantic wig contains a lot of electrical energy due to being 90% wire wool.

records.name: Jagged Hatchet
records.about: The edge has been made blunt and ragged from smashing into trees, doors, walls, and pesky hikers.

records.name: Burlap Cowl
records.about: This once held potatoes. Now it can barely hold back his rage.

records.name: Overalls of Endurance
records.about: The cloth does nothing to soften incoming attacks, but the blows only make the wearer angrier.

records.name: Headless Ted
records.about: The teddy's head is down the well with the others.

records.name: Mythical ST Chest
records.about:
Open it to find one of the following:

*Mythical ST Gem
*Mythical ST Shards
*Mystery ST Chest
*Mystery ST Shards

records.name: Helm of minstack
records.about: You can barely tell that this dress was taken from a poor bride who was buried in it.

records.name: Chrysalis of Eternity
records.about: As the nameless monarch sat malcontent upon the throne, his ambitions and impiety became one, and with this came enlightenment. A legacy reduced to less than legend, utterly erased from the nescient minds of the land, with its only epitaph being the sorry remnant of his majesty's dearest. After all, what good are kings in a realm of gods?

records.name: Conqueror's Crown
records.about: The symbol that claims absolute subservience from its beholder.

records.name: Royal Blades
records.about: These intricately crafted blades were originally intended more for ornamental purposes rather than function, but still remain potent for any form of combat.

records.name: Blazing Blades
records.about: A set of knives wrapped in an ever burning flame.

records.name: Garnet Blades
records.about: Razor sharp gemstone blades that emit a faint, magic hum.

records.name: Verdant Blades
records.about: Blades wielded only by those among the strongest of mortals, their green edges gleam in sunlight.

records.name: Occult Blades
records.about: Used primarily in ritual worship, repeated exposure to dark magic has imbued this pair of daggers with sinister powers.

records.name: Bloodshed Blades
records.about: Entire wars have been waged over the bloodstone of which a pair of these blades has been crafted from. A single pair carries the cost of thousands of deaths.

records.name: Moonstone Blades
records.about: These blades are made from a material beyond the reaches of the realm, their origin shrouded in mystery, but their edge undoubtedly sharp.

records.name: Soulforged Blades
records.about: The weight of a single swing carries the vigor of a hundred past heroes, their souls bound together in the shape of blades so they may once again slay evil.

records.name: Cloudstrike Tachi
records.about: A pair of weighty swords that carry with it thunderous strikes from its namesake.

records.name: Devilbane Tachi
records.about: Blades made from the bones of infernal beings, used to fell the same creatures it was forged from.

records.name: Darksteel Tachi
records.about: Tempered blades crafted from enchanted Darksteel and set with a gleaming ruby.

records.name: Dragonbone Tachi
records.about: This dense set of blades has been crafted with the bones of beasts only spoken of through legend.

records.name: Accursed Tachi
records.about: A pair of blades of unknown origin, within their edges a dark power can be felt, threatening to corrupt the user should they not be sated in battle.

records.name: Skyslash Tachi
records.about: Keen blades that never grow dull, their slashes threaten to split the very sky itself.

records.name: Sunset Tachi
records.about: Weapons of striking beauty, their colors displaying all the shades of twilight, each slash like a brushstroke, painting its own landscape.

records.name: Godslayer Tachi
records.about: The culmination of countless generations of swordsmiths, each perfecting their craft and improving these blades gradually. The pinnacle of weapons created by mortals for use in slaying the immortal.

records.name: Gilded Flail
records.about: Commissioned by a particularly gaudy lord for his armies, this flail gleams as brightly as the armor he was once known to wear.

records.name: Champion's Flail
records.about: Often seen used in arenas across the lands, flails like these offer a perfect balance of weight and power.

records.name: Drakerider's Flail
records.about: Once wielded by a band of knights from atop their lightning drake companions, a thunderous roar can be heard with each swing.

records.name: Infernal Flail
records.about: Forged in the fires of the underworld, the mace atop this flail emits a heat reminiscent of its origins.

records.name: Mithril Flail
records.about: A masterpiece of craftsmanship with the strongest and most desirable of all metals, as deadly as it is egregiously expensive.

records.name: Celebrant Flail
records.about: Granted only to heroes who have returned from missions of world saving renown. Those who receive it are cemented in legend.

records.name: Divine Flail
records.about: Gifted from the heavens to the most righteous of mortals, these flails have been imbued with the power of angels to subjugate evil entities.

records.name: Gravelord's Flail
records.about: The primary armament of the gravelords of old, eternally tasked with making sure the dead are forever sealed away from the mortal plane.

records.name: Fractal Blades
records.about: An impossibly intricate pattern belies these blades, carved from a self-perfecting crystalline deity.

records.name: Barnacle Basher
records.about: An extraordinarily dense silversteel anchor attached to a magical kelpwoven chain. Whatever ship it was attached to has long since been dragged to the depths.

records.name: Burial Blades
records.about: Jagged obsidian and smooth malachite blades inscribed with runes and teeming with energy. The runes read as a eulogy for those lost while trying to seal a great evil.

records.name: Mythical ST Crate

records.name: Glacial Cache

records.about: Lost in a battle over the open seas, this magnificent fire opal studded ring that buzzes with an unyielding power.

records.name: Faded Heart Scarab
records.about: A once prized piece of Nefret's collection. Though its beauty has long since faded, it has retained its power.

records.name: Fractured Hannya
records.about: An ancient relic of the Oni Clan, bursting with an energy like none other.

records.name: Huntsman's Volley
records.about: One of the more peculiar pieces of the Wanderer's enchanted arsenal; this quiver has the unique ability to call forth a magical arrow storm, but channeling such power requires the caster's utmost concentration.

records.name: Storm Caller
records.about: A brooding scepter used to protect a recluse tribe of lightning worshipers from outsiders.

records.name: Rusted Barrel
records.about: A rusty barrel once used for transporting a revolting toxin across the seas. One spilled drop is enough to cause a crew to jump ship with no regard for their own lives.

records.name: Wanderer's Cape
records.about: A simple, weather-beaten green cloak. It doesn't endow great powers - it conceals them until the time is right.

records.name: Cuirass of the Black Blade
records.about: A hereditary armor constructed of intricate scales. The crest of the Oni Clans that adorns it can still be identified.

records.name: Pirate Queen's Brigandine
records.about: Stained by sea salt and equipped with bandoliers - the armor of a captain who fights at the forefront of her crew.

records.name: Emblem of the Empire
records.about: Handed down through generations of Pharaohs, it holds power over more than just the wills of Nefret's subjects.

records.name: Amulet of the Great Shaman
records.about: The bearer of this ring is linked with the spirit world, and may channel the power of a deity.

records.name: Interregnum Treasure Chest
records.about: A chest looted from the dingy treasury of the Syndicate. Its unassuming looks hide the secret weapons of their fight.

records.name: Knock-off Black Coin
records.about: The Assassin gains more information using these knock-off Black Coins.

records.name: Knock-off Black Coin
records.about: The Sorcerer gains more information using these knock-off Black Coins.

records.name: Buried Treasure
records.about: Usually pirate treasure is marked with an X on the map but it seems like The Tinkerer already found all of them!

records.name: Peacekeeper (Rehearsal)
records.about: A veritable artifact from the forgotten splendor of a kingdom none wish to remember. No matter the craftsmanship of its gilded design, this unwelcome sight is now only a sobering reminder of a mistake without regret.

records.name: Vanguard's Visage (Rehearsal)
records.about: A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.

records.name: Noble Mandolin (Rehearsal)
records.about: Endless melodies from this fine instrument once filled the halls of the castle. It is without any apparent wear, yet even the most upbeat tune sounds somber when it is played.

records.name: Polarity Poison (Rehearsal)
records.about: A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.

records.name: Sentinel's Sidearm (Rehearsal)
records.about: Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.

records.name: Primal Arcana (Rehearsal)
records.about: This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.

records.id: item:Color Orb Red Projectile#Primal Arcana Proc (Rehearsal)
records.name: Color Orb Red Projectile
records.said: Color Orb Red Projectile (Primal Arcana Proc (Rehearsal))

records.name: Valor (Rehearsal)
records.about: Exceedingly large and challenging to handle, this titanic blade embodies the stoic might of its true owner.

records.name: Dusky Catalyst (Rehearsal)
records.about: An untempered casting wand brought forth to tap into distant powers, but an imbalance rendered it too unreliable for most to dare use.

records.name: Warmonger (Rehearsal)
records.about: Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.

records.name: Mantle of the Monarchy (Rehearsal)
records.about: The lavish robes of the kingdom's royalty, outfitted with pauldrons on both shoulders for a more distinguished appearance. A sinister presence remains channeled through the draping fabric.

records.name: Vest of Abandoned Shadows (Rehearsal)
records.about: Formerly a nobleman's uniform, now workshopped by the court magician into a gloomy coat befitting of his accursed company.

records.name: Royal Guard's Cuirass (Rehearsal)
records.about: Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.

records.name: The Forgotten Crown (Rehearsal)
records.about: An eerie reminder of what lies in the depths of the Shatters.

records.name: The Twilight Gemstone (Rehearsal)
records.about: A peculiar stone, tremendously heavy for its size and seemingly not of this world. Its very presence in the realm raises a great deal more questions than answers, yet the uncanny energy it emanates provides only one haunting clue.

records.name: Bracer of the Guardian (Rehearsal)
records.about: A colossal gauntlet of masterful composition. Its sheer size is disproportionate for most warriors, only able to be worn on one's forearm as a bracer. A once glossy exterior faded from battle long ago, yet the sturdiness of its make is as resolute as it ever was.

records.name: Shaman's Staff
records.about: A staff of grisly, warped wood cradling a luminous green gemstone. It is said to be powered by souls trapped within the gem.

records.name: Ritual Skull
records.about: The skull of an alligator, used to house spirits summoned through wicked rituals.

records.name: Ragged Robes
records.about: Robes pieced together from coarse, ragged cloth, adorned with decorative bones and cursed trinkets.

records.name: Fang Necklace
records.about: A necklace of fangs stolen from vicious swamp creatures. The predatory strength of the beasts empowers the wearer.

records.name: Soul Gem Amulet
records.about: An amulet housing a powerful soul. It calls out and draws wandering spirits towards the wearer.

records.name: Toxic Toad
records.about: It croaks, you croak.

records.name: Makeshift Blowpipe
records.about: Fully functional, but barely keeping itself together, users of this blowpipe benefit greatly from its powerful sting.

records.name: Alchemist's Disheveled Garbs
records.about: This garb is worse for wear, but users have reported a significant decrease in excruciating chemical burns.

records.name: Protective Gloves
records.about: Thick leather gloves allowing the user to handle the most toxic of materials, but harsh words still hurt the same.

records.name: Brambletooth Tachi
records.about: A heavily serrated blade set studded with thorns from the many ravenous plants of the Sulfurous Wetlands. The accursed magic used to mutate the native flora has been likewise imbued to these blades, enabling for a unique yet precise slashing technique.

records.name: Bogwood Crook
records.about: This ornate herding staff composed of an old willow branch has been warped beyond mortal comprehension due to prolonged influence of the twisted beings of the Sulfurous Wetlands.

records.name: Warped Mantle
records.about: A sickly piece of armor, grown from the twisted bark from one of the few remaining Ent Ancients that still populate the Sulfurous Wetlands.

records.name: Thistleleaf Necklace
records.about: This necklace once signified the everlasting bond between two people. As if alive, this necklace carries with it an aura of spite and anguish.

records.name: Sulfuric Stone
records.about: A peculiarly weathered rock with runes burned into it from generations of being submerged in the acidic bog. This makeshift snare is unmatched in power, but it activates on its own terms.

records.name: Seasonal Vault Expansion
records.about: Expands your seasonal vault once. After the season ends, it expands your normal vault once. If you acquire this item with a non-seasonal character, it will expand your non-seasonal item vault.

records.name: Seasonal Potion Rack Expansion
records.about: Expands your seasonal potion rack in 12 slots. Seasonal Potion Rack Slots do not get transferred over to the non-seasonal Potion Rack Slots and if unused, it gets destroyed at the end of the season.

records.name: Seasonal Apple of Extreme Maxening
records.about: It's healthy!\nMaxes any class to 8/8 and adds a Backpack. If unused, or converted to a non-seasonal character it gets destroyed at the end of the season.

records.name: Overclocking Amulet
records.about: Placing this trinket into an appropriate slot found on Steamworks machines activates their overclock drastically increasing output. The increased speed causes a greater amount of wear on the parts of the machine, usage of this item is only authorized to higher ranking Kogbolds.

records.name: Steam Pipe
records.about: Efforts by lower workers of the kogbolds to arm themselves against invaders has resulted in various interesting crudely made armaments. Fashioned from the boiler of a steam generator, this staff projects its scalding vapors towards a target, cooking them alive.

records.name: Kogbold Cower Shield
records.about: A large sheet of plating intended to be used as a blast shield in explosives testing. When confronted with intruders some of the more cowardly Kogbolds choose to use them to protect themselves while fleeing.

records.name: Cower Shield Shots
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Scepter of Rust
records.about: This electrical rod is actually used to remove rust from machine parts through electrolysis. When used on a living or artificial creature however, the shock causes muscles to tense and circuits to go haywire, reducing the assailant's power.
in: item:Scepter of Rust#Scepter of Rust Shiny

records.name: Brain Cube
records.about: The oldest forms of automatic computing built by the Kogbolds were a far cry from the self improving artificial intelligence of the modern Core designs. Though its computation capabilities are lost to time, the matrix remains conveniently effective at distributing powerful surges of energy.

records.name: Chain Dagger
records.about: Of all the tools found on Kogbold excavation bots, none is more versatile than the KI225 Chain Cutter. Useful for cutting through unwanted obstructions ranging anything from stone to flesh.

records.name: Laser Pointer
records.about: Early prototype versions of the KI470 Laser pointing device came with no inbuilt limiter on their power output. First batch testing resulted in many schematics cut clean in half, as well as multiple layers of steel wall.

records.name: Boomerang Blades
records.about: This experimental set of dual blades dared to ask the question – what if both the blades were the big one?  Unfortunately, the curve of the second blade caused it to fly back towards the user.

records.name: Hovering Spellblade
records.about: The projectiles of this spellblade can achieve great speed when fired...after they spend a moment to get warmed up.

records.name: Seismic Flail
records.about: By welding a massive weight to a chain, you can make a flail so heavy barely anyone can use it.  But even if it misses, the impact alone will knock enemies flying.

records.name: Hookblade Tachi
records.about: The unique shape of these Tachi mean that when the blades cross over, they pull back in a sweeping motion, slicing to either side of the user.

records.name: Acidic Aspergillum
records.about: This holy water dispenser has become corroded and rusty, with the only liquid it produces being a concentrated acid.

records.name: Harpoon Longbow
records.about: This bow fires arrows a little too fast, reducing them to ragged splinters in flight.

records.name: Clockwork Repeater
records.about: A bow of unbelievable weight. It requires multiple Kogbold Workers to fire a single arrow.

records.name: Mechanical Kogbold Limb
records.about: An unknown Kogbold appendage, seemingly more machine than flesh.

records.name: Atavistic Soul Sabre
records.about: An unbearably heavy sword said to harness the soul of a Kogboldian master craftsman.

records.name: Socket Blade
records.about: A rather unusual ratcheting blade used by the Kogbolds to tighten the bolts on the Kogbold Steamwalker.

records.name: Kogbold Multitool
records.about: The KI132 Bladed Multitool finds its way into the hands of many Kogbold Engineers sent out on expeditions. It is equipped with blades for any situation, as well as a handy pair of pliers.

records.about: A grand looking chest from the Tinkerer's vault. It contains extraordinary items.

records.name: Shakujo
records.about: A short copper cane adorned with interlocking rings. The jangling of the rings can be heard whenever the Onmyoji approaches.

records.name: Invocation Scroll
records.about: An ancient scroll inscribed with an incantation to summon the wrath of the gods.

records.name: Divination Cloak
records.about: A ritualistic garment worn to protect the wearer from harmful spirits.

records.name: Omamori
records.about: A paper amulet dedicated to the deities. It is said to bring luck and protection to its holder.

records.name: Bloodletting Leeches
records.about: A leech a day keeps the plague at bay.

records.name: Doctor's Overcoat
records.about: The dark black hue hides the various bodily fluids that taint the material.

Heart Jewel Blades
records.about: Jewel Encrusted blades, these weapons hold a special power to those that fight for love.

records.name: Anteros Longbow
records.about: Wielding this bow leads the user to become a defender of love. Helping people that are without love and smiting anyone that seeks to harm where love shines.

records.name: Love Heart Spellblade
records.about: Bestowed to trusted allies of the Love Hearts Guild, this spellblade conquers evil heart-breakers with the power of positive emotions.

records.name: Morning Star Of Sweet Miracles
records.about: Containing the power of pure heart and innocence, this morning star seeks to return compassion to the corrupted.

records.name: Lovestruck Yoyo
records.about: Every swing of this weapon leaves enemies becoming less and less aggressive thanks to this toys magical properties (and being hit in the head multiple times).

records.name: Sweetheart Taichi
records.about: Formerly wielded by lovers, their battle would end defending their home in the far lands of the realms. Both lovers are gone, but their blades remain and will never part.

records.name: Valentine's Goodie Bag
records.about: Open the goodie bag for a lovely reward!

records.name: Valentine's Gift
records.about: As the plentiful bounty of a lovely Valentine is bestowed upon the Realm, see what the gift to you may be.\n\nItems contained in Valentine's Treasure can only be redeemed until the 14th of March 2023.

records.name: Valentine's Treasure
records.about: An extravagant and golden gift, found in the most romantic corners of the Realm.\n\nItems contained in Valentine's Treasure can only be redeemed until the 14th of March 2023.

records.name: Divinity
records.about: The chosen blade of Oryx the Mad God, charged with an unrelenting energy to subdue all that lies before it.

records.name: Lumiaire
records.about: This ceremonial mace controls the forces of light and darkness. Archbishop Leucoryx uses it for distinguished offerings in the name of his god.

records.name: Superior
records.about: This aptly named staff is the manifestation of Chancellor Dammah's assertions of grandeur. Although he seldom uses it for actual combat purposes, it is no less potent as a legitimate weapon.

records.name: Enforcer
records.about: Chief Beisa designed and forged this sawtoothed blade himself to be granted admission as a gladiator. Its shattering strikes are amplified by his own slashing techniques.

records.name: Avarice
records.about: The pride of Treasurer Gemsbok, this gilded knife has backstabbed countless traders in shady dealings.

records.id: item:Bow of the Void#Bow of the Void Shiny
records.name: Bow of the Void
records.about: Every shot that hits a target frees the soul of a forgotten hero. Every shot that misses is trapped for eternity.

records.name: Hivemaster Helm
records.about: A nefarious helm combining pheromones and Killer Honey to captivate Killer Bees into servitude.

records.name: Doom Bow
records.about: No mortal can fire this dreaded bow without resting in between shots. It requires tremendous skill to wield.

records.name: Taiko Drums
records.about: The drum whose every beat carries with it the energy and rhythm of Kaguya. A mortal sounding this mystical instrument bears both order and disarray.

records.name: Elegant Parasol
records.about: The ornate umbrella carried by the gracious Miko. It never goes out of fashion, regardless of the season.

records.name: Flowering Kimono
records.about: A beautiful set of ornate ceremonial robes, filled with the energy of benevolent spirits from long ago.

records.name: Ethereal Happi
records.about: A festival coat woven from thin, spiritual threads. It allows the user to skirt the spirit realm in search of their destination.

records.name: Sage's Wakibiki
records.about: A worn plate from the Sage's armor. Its outwardly poor condition belies a strange, revitalizing effect still flowing within.

records.name: Makakoyumi
records.about: A bow believed to have only been fired in dissent against the heavens. In retribution, the empyrean rulers have cursed this device to tether its wielders in shackles of divine light.

records.name: +Makakoyumi
records.about: Once fired in dissent against the heavens, now an icon of divine judgement. It bears the scar of wrathful light, a permanent reminder of having forever changed the course of the world.

records.name: Tezutsu Hanabi
records.about: These fireworks are a mere fraction of Umi's spectacular stockpile. Locals believed they held the power to ward off evil spirits, whilst bringing peace and prosperity to its celebrants.

records.name: +Tezutsu Hanabi
records.about: A collection of gilded fireworks, personally granted from Umi's showstopping stockpile. Locals believed they held the power to ward off evil spirits, whilst bringing peace and prosperity to its celebrants.

records.name: Rain Maker
records.about: A sodden artifact held by Genji to stir nearby moisture into a torrent of localized rain. Only the Sage can extract its full potential, gracefully guiding the morning dew into a lasting downpour.

records.name: Fortitude
records.about: The wand is able to conjure mighty encircling defenses. Given enough time, it is capable of instantly establishing fortifications.

records.name: Vigor
records.about: The energy that emanates from this staff attracts spirits of all sorts to join in on festivities. A simple wave orchestrates their movement.

records.name: Token of Happiness
records.about: An aged coin of unfamiliar design, gently glowing with the spirits of happiness. This seemingly modest keepsake invigorates your body, readying you for the next move.

records.name: Token of Warmth
records.about: An aged coin of unfamiliar design, gently glowing with the spirits of warmth. This seemingly modest keepsake puts your mind at ease, mending your wounds.

records.name: Mischief
records.about: A whimsical dagger surrounded by a maelstrom of spiritual energy. Its desirability lies in its uniquely chaotic nature.

records.name: Kagenohikari
records.about: An ethereal lantern charged with the hundreds of hopes and memories of bygone souls. Its light seeks to guide and protect those still dwelling within the mortal plane.

records.name: Umi's Blue Parcel
records.about: A special gift from Umi! The box appears to contain a radiant bow.

records.name: Umi's Pink Parcel
records.about: A special gift from Umi! The box appears to contain a bundle of gilded fireworks.

records.name: Umi's Yellow Parcel
records.about: A special gift from Umi! The box appears to contain a golden lantern.

records.name: Umi's Fishy Parcel
records.about: A special gift from Umi! The box appears to contain a unique fishing rod.

records.name: Mysterious Crate
records.about: Contained within the crate is the embodiment of the emotion one experiences when unboxing something exciting.

records.name: Basic Fishing Rod
records.about: A fishing rod fashioned from a tree branch and string. It is suitable for beginners.

records.name: Intermediate Fishing Rod
records.about: A sturdy fishing rod reinforced with metal. It is an adequate tool for any and all fishing activities.

records.name: Expert Fishing Rod
records.about: A fishing rod with a steel alloy frame. Its light weight allows for faster casting.

records.name: Master Fishing Rod
records.about: A fishing rod used by master fishers. It requires skill and precision to use to its full potential.

records.name: Master Fishing Rod
records.about: A fishing rod used by master fishers. It requires skill and precision to use to its full potential.

records.name: Legendary Fishing Rod
records.about: A legendary fishing rod only passed down to those who are worthy. It is unrivalled in effectiveness.

records.name: Drop Boost Accelerator
records.about: You will always get compatible loot for your currently selected class until the end of season.

records.name: Seasonal XP Accelerator
records.about: +20% XP bonus until end of season.

records.name: Beekeeper's Flamethrower
records.about: Equipped with a mechanical combustion technology few may understand, this weapon projects flames boasting temperatures capable of melting their target before they're able to retaliate.

records.id: item:Tome of Holy Protection#Tome of Holy Protection Shiny
records.name: Tome of Holy Protection
records.about: A tome dedicated to the works of a forgotten god. It is written in a strange script that glows with a pure white light.

records.name: Scepter of Devastation
records.about: A loathsome scepter that converges the life energy of parasites into a soul-rotting bolt of destruction.

records.id: item:Penetrating Blast Spell#Penetrating Blast Spell Shiny
records.name: Penetrating Blast Spell
records.about: This spell's destructive power is so notorious that casting it was banned for many generations.

records.name: Amulet of Lightning
records.about: A fine silk necklace with a bolt shaped medallion, channeling energy through it briefly grants the user the speed of lightning itself.

records.name: Experimental Cannon
records.about: This firearm was created as an experiment by welding two double-barrelled cannons together. One of the barrels fell off when it was first fired, but the other three work fine.

records.name: Sentry Turret
records.about: Turretsmiths innovate new automated defence measures to help protect the Steamworks, from rapid firing cannons to multiple flails attached to a spinning post.

records.name: Tinkerers Apron
records.about: This apron has many pockets containing supplies, pencils, blueprints and plenty of reloads. Each of those pockets has its own leather pocket protector.

records.name: Targeting Monocular
records.about: Wearing this brass monocle allows a Turretsmith to see down their turret's sights, granting them greater accuracy at the expense of personal style.

records.name: Rocket Launcher
records.about: Kogbold rockets are highly explosive.  The inaccurate nature of the weapon is made up for by the sheer volume of shots they can launch at once.

records.name: Unstable Firework
records.about: The Pyrotechnicians are supposed to work on things like blasting caps and landmines, but often get distracted by the pretty colours of a violently detonating firework.

records.name: Blast Proof Robes
records.about: You are not a true Pyrotechnician until you can prove your robes can withstand several exploding experiments.

records.name: Lucky Grenade
records.about: This grenade was launched from a firework and failed to explode. It will release deadly sparks when shaken violently enough, but until then it serves as a potent good-luck charm.

records.name: Plague Poison

records.name: Aspirant's Sword
records.about: A steel sword with an aquamarine guard, the blade has been perfectly balanced to allow the user to attack as swiftly as possible. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Bow
records.about: A precisely tuned compound bow with aquamarine filigree, the bow fires arrows tipped with the very same gemstone. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Wand
records.about: A traditional warmages wand with an aquamarine focus, this particular type of gemstone can draw in more energy before discharging. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Dagger
records.about: This dagger is crafted with a sharp aquamarine spike fitted with steel edges to form a blade. Its usage requires additional precision but its sting is heavy. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Staff
records.about: A large oak staff set with an aquamarine gemstone, the focus on top causes it to fire more precisely than traditional staves. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Blade
records.about: The blade of this weapon is made entirely of aquamarine gemstone and sharpened to a lethal edge, the crystal is lighter than traditional metals allowing the user to draw their blade at incredible speed. Those who wish to become heroes will find this weapon grows with them as they continue down their chosen path.

records.name: Aspirant's Plate
records.about: Traditional steel plate mail with inlaid gemstones that boost the wearers endurance. With great use this armor will shape to the user's fighting style.

records.name: Aspirant's Robes
records.about: Reinforced warmages robes, the threads of which have been interwoven with a fine gemstone that boosts the wearer’s endurance. With great use this armor will shape to the user's fighting style.

records.name: Aspirant's Hide
records.about: Mastercrafted hide armor jeweled with many small gemstones that boost the wearer's endurance. With great use this armor will shape to the user's fighting style.

records.name: Ring of the Stalwart
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Stalwart. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will become an insurmountable warrior capable of taking the force of any foe.

records.name: Ring of the Magus
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Magus. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will shape magic to their will and unleash an arcane torrent upon any that oppose them.

records.name: Ring of the Sniper
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Sniper. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will strike true and with a force great enough to topple even the greatest of adversaries.

records.name: Ring of the Swiftblade
records.about: A sigil ring with a carved gemstone signifying the wearer's dedication to the Path of the Swiftblade. An aspiring hero who wears this ring will move faster than their enemies can perceive and strike before they even have a chance to react.

records.name: Hero's Crate
records.about: An enigmatic box filled with the potential for greatness, each opening offers a chance to uncover valuable rewards, empowering adventurers to rise as true heroes of the realm.

records.name: Hero's Dagger
records.about: A finely crafted blade fit for a hero, swift and deadly in the hands of those who seek to strike with precision.

records.name: Hero's Bow
records.about: A balanced bow that embodies the spirit of heroism, empowering bowmen to unleash arrows with unparalleled accuracy and power.

records.name: Hero's Staff
records.about: A majestic staff imbued with ancient knowledge and arcane might, empowering mages to channel devastating spells in the pursuit of heroism.

records.name: Hero's Wand
records.about: A slender wand that crackles with mystical energy, empowering mages to unleash potent magical abilities and shape the destiny of heroes.

records.name: Hero's Sword
records.about: A mighty blade that glimmers with heroic power, striking fear into the hearts of enemies as it cleaves through darkness and evil.

records.name: Hero's Katana
records.about: A masterfully crafted katana, imbued with the essence of heroism, its swift strikes and elegant form instill awe in those who witness its wielder's skill.

records.name: Hero's Blades
records.about: Dual blades, perfect for the dexterous hero, capable of unleashing a whirlwind of lethal attacks in the pursuit of justice.

records.name: Hero's Longbow
records.about: A majestic longbow that resonates with heroism, granting bowmen the ability to rain arrows upon foes with unparalleled range and precision.

records.name: Hero's Spellblade
records.about: This Spellblade allows heroes to channel their inner arcane power and strike down adversaries with enchanted attacks.

records.name: Morning Star of the Hero
records.about: A formidable morning star that radiates with heroic energy, capable of delivering devastating blows to enemies while also inspiring allies.

records.name: Hero's Flail
records.about: A mighty flail that embodies the heroic spirit, its swinging strikes bring justice to the unjust and leave foes in awe of its wielder's strength.

records.name: Hero's Tachi
records.about: Elegant and deadly tachi swords, passed down through generations of heroes, their razor-sharp blades cut through evil with grace and precision.

records.name: Beehemoth Armor

records.name: Glass of Cold Water
records.about: Nice clean cold water, once you drink it you feel refreshed but are left with a lingering feeling of dread, almost as if the silently gaping void in your integrity has grown severely and devoured any satisfaction this cup could have brought.

records.about: As the plentiful bounty of MotMG is bestowed upon the Realm, see what the gift to you may be.\n\nItems contained in MotMG's Treasure can only be redeemed until the 19th of September 2023.

records.about: An extravagant and golden gift, found in the most romantic corners of the Realm.\n\nItems contained in MotMG's Treasure can only be redeemed until the 19th of September 2023.

records.name: Colossal Ring of the Crucible
records.about: A sheet of pure marble was dedicated to the crafting of this ring, bestowed upon the finest warriors who rose past insurmountable challenges.

records.name: Shattered Ring of the Crucible
records.about: The shattered trinket is held together by the force of determination from the finest mages who rose past insurmountable challenges.

records.name: Robotic Ring of the Crucible
records.about: The targeting core continues to adjust and perfect the skills of the finest marksmen who rose past insurmountable challenges.

records.name: Corrupted Ring of the Crucible
records.about: The corrupting presence of the ring is held back only by the finest protectors who rose past insurmountable challenges.

records.name: The Golden Forgotten Crown
records.about: A radiant artifact, bestowed upon those who have proven themselves. It symbolizes not only mastery, but also the unwavering determination of champions in their pursuit of glory.

records.name: Deadly Keg
records.about: A barrel filled to the brim with the cheapest ale money can buy. The cask is highly pressurized and must be handled with care, should it be dropped it is likely to explode violently.

records.name: Tipsy Topper
records.about: This stylish felt cap has found itself at the helm of many tavern brawls, and atop the heads of many poor decision makers.

records.name: Double Vision Darts
records.about: A finely crafted leather bound quiver containing many small darts. The reduced size of the arrows in this quiver allow a specific firing pattern, confusing their target as if they were seeing double.
in: item:Double Vision Darts#Double Vision Darts Shiny

records.name: Cask Corslet
records.about: A cobbled together suit of armor made from a beer barrel, while lacking in real defensive properties, its alcoholic aura numbs the wearer's pain against attacks.

records.name: The Right Hook
records.about: A famous boxer once said the secret to their victory was having a great right hook, this dagger’s craftsman took that literally.
in: item:The Right Hook#The Right Hook Shiny

records.name: Brewer's Bangle
records.about: A small golden band meant to be worn on one’s ear. This mundane looking accessory appears to give the wearer an increased tolerance to intoxicants.

records.id: item:Dirk of Cronus#Dirk of Cronus Shiny
records.name: Dirk of Cronus
records.about: This legendary dagger was commissioned by a band of mad rogues to prove the worth of the Dirk.

records.id: item:Skull of Corrupted Souls#Skull of Corrupted Souls Shiny
records.name: Skull of Corrupted Souls
records.about: The cursed skull of a corrupted mind. Good intentions can go horribly wrong.

records.name: Leaf Bow
records.about: Fashioned from the finest logs found within the Woodland Labyrinths, this bow uses sharp leaves instead of conventional arrows. Such lightweight ammunition allows for quick movement.

records.id: item:Double Vision Darts#Double Vision Darts Shiny
records.name: Double Vision Darts
records.about: A finely crafted leather bound quiver containing many small darts. The reduced size of the arrows in this quiver allow a specific firing pattern, confusing their target as if they were seeing double.

records.id: item:Seal of Cubic Conundra#tD Seal Shiny
records.name: Seal of Cubic Conundra
records.about: A seal granting the user access to other dimensions, though the means by which this is accomplished are unknown.

records.id: item:Jewel Eye Katana#Jewel Eye Katana Shiny
records.name: Jewel Eye Katana
records.about: A mighty katana with a crystal eye embedded in the hilt.

records.id: item:Snake Eye Ring#Snake Eye Ring Shiny
records.name: Snake Eye Ring
records.about: A ring made from the eye of the Snake Queen.

records.name: Candy-Coated Armor
records.about: Reinforced with magical hard candy from the candy forest. Sticky but strong.

records.id: item:Doku No Ken#Doku No Ken Shiny
records.name: Doku No Ken
records.about: Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.

records.id: item:Sword of the Colossus#Sword of the Colossus Shiny
records.name: Sword of the Colossus
records.about: A sword with an impossibly sharp edge. It has been designed with holy magic to slash like no other blade.

records.name: Steamworks Compensation Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random reward.

records.name: Crucible Mystery Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random reward.

records.name: Oryxtober Mystery Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random reward.

records.name: Spooky Smasher
records.about: A candle-filled pumpkin attached to a gnarled stick using a length of vine. Very thematic for a spooky season of ghouls and goblins.\n\nSprite Credits: DynamoX

records.name: Longbow of Spirits and Shadows
records.about: This longbow does not fire normal arrows.  Instead each pull of the string creates an arrow which pierces the spirit of the target, and a sinister shadow which follows this divine projectile.\n\nSprite Credits: DynamoX

records.name: Shield of Jawgmur
records.about: This skull-adorned shield was created to commemorate the Skeleton Kings with the wealth of many spare jaws at their distal phalanges.

records.name: Kagebooshi
records.about: These delightfully social spirits are willing to part for a swift scare, but they won't dare venture too far from their owner!

records.name: Heartbreaker Wand
records.about: This wand can help you fall madly in love, with a heavy emphasis on the mad.

records.name: Lovesick Scepter
records.about: Anyone caught in the blast of this item find themselves longing for a lost love, a yearning which Incubi find delicious.

records.name: Devilish Robes
records.about: Made from the finest materials and tailored to show off the Incubus' physique.

records.name: Devil Horn Headband
records.about: The Incubus has real horns, but wearing these as well somehow makes him even more irresistible.

records.name: Teal Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your HP for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Smells like toothpaste.

records.name: Hazel Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your MP for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Do not eat if allergic to nuts.

records.name: Azure Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your WIS for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Tastes like blueberries.

records.name: Crimson Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your VIT for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Has the strong smell of fresh strawberries.

records.name: Scarlet Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your DEX for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Despite the name, they taste like orange.

records.name: Beryl Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your SPD for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. Has a really sour green apple flavor.

records.name: Onyx Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your DEF for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. The taste is reminiscent of a very sugary fizzy drink.

records.name: Amaranth Treat
records.about: Affects allies around you. Boost your ATT for 5 minutes or until you leave the area. A treat commonly given to young paladins of the Forgotten Era. While it does taste like grapes, no grapes are used when making it.

records.name: Halloween Mystery Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random spooky reward.

records.name: Haunted Halloween Mystery Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random spooky reward of higher value.

records.name: Possessed Halloween Mystery Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random spooky reward of even higher value.

records.name: Fury Flail
records.about: Unleash destruction with this brutal flail. Its massive anvil end shatters armor and crushes foes. Its craftsmanship whispers of an untamed, cataclysmic force.

records.name: Shockwave Shield
records.about: Imbued with the untamed power of the Mighty Minotaur, this shield leaves a feeling of despair and no escape to those unfortunate enough to be in it's presence.

records.name: Cyclone Chestplate
records.about: This mythical Minotaur chest plate infuses your weapon with a speed that mirrors the guardians of ancient labyrinths, making you the calm yet devastating eye of the cyclone in battle.

records.name: Brass Knuckles
records.about: Slip on these savage Knuckles and unleash a whirlwind of swings, each powered by an uncanny dexterity that leaves foes questioning what hit them.

records.name: Lightning Wand
records.about: Unleash the untamed forces of electricity! This rod's damage output is as unpredictable as a storm, striking foes with bolts that range from a spark to a lightning blast.

records.name: Totem Scepter
records.about: Summons static Totems that discharge electrical bolts around it. The totem’s rapid fire makes it a formidable static defense.

records.name: Thunderstorm Tunic
records.about: This mystical armor amplifies your defenses and imbues you with the swiftness needed for rapid totem placement.

records.name: Bolt in a Bottle
records.about: This enchanted pendant heightens your elemental abilities and agility, enabling quick placement of Storm Totems and devastating attacks.

records.name: Mystery Slime Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random reward.

records.name: Slime Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain one of the class skins from the Slime Skins Collection.

records.name: Prismimic Attacker Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random reward.

records.name: Prismimic Defender Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random reward.

records.name: Mad God's Festive Ticket
records.about:
Countdown to Oryxmas with a magical twist! The Mad God's Festive Advent Calendar is your daily dose of festive excitement. From December 1st to the 25th, each day unwraps a new gift in your Gift Chest! Should you get this calendar after the 1st, gifts from previous days will be delivered to you in bulk. You can see the expected rewards in the list below.

*Santa's Bag
*Loot Drop Potion
*Gingerbread House
*Oryxmas Mystery Gift
*Mystery Stat Pot
*Lucky Clover
*Adventurer's Belt
*Green Pulse Style
*Mistletoe
*Oryxmas Mystery Gift
*Santa Workshop Key
*Snow Crystals Emote
*Egg Nog
*Backpack Extender
*Christmas Tree Cupcake
*Oryxmas Mystery Gift
*Potion of Max Level
*Loot Drop Potion
*Mystery Cloth (Large)
*Greater Mystery Pet Skin
*Blue Ice Candy
*Santa’s Sleigh
*Oryxmas Mystery Gift
*Christmas Tree Emote
*Paramount Mystery Skin

records.about: All who stand against the merry melodies of the holiday season will be jingle bell ROCKED.

records.name: Brass Chamberstick
records.about: The hot wax of this candle burns with the judgement of those who lack a giving spirit.

records.name: Cheerful Chipper
records.about: This festive axe is meant to chop wood for a cozy winter fireplace, but it could probably handle your enemies in combat too.

records.name: Candy Katana
records.about: Candy canes, candy canes, lick them in a spear and kill your enemies!

records.name: Garland Bow
records.about: Great for stringing along doors, railings, or the nock of an arrow before releasing.
