records.name: ST Master's Chest
records.about: Use this chest to choose a third generation ST token.

records.name: Frostbite Blades
records.about: Each blade is surrounded by a freezing mist, together they are cold enough to liquify air.

records.name: Longbow of the Great Glacier
records.about: What was once a normal longbow wielded long ago has spent enough time frozen in shuffling layers of ice to become a mythical relic.

records.name: Snowblind Spellblade
records.about: Light refracting through the crystalline tip of this spellblade is amplified to blinding degrees, though this is not the most powerful aspect of the weapon.

records.name: The North Star
records.about: Held aloft, this magical focusing device will become charged with stellar power. It is favored by explorative types as it doubles as a compass.

records.name: Lament of the Frozen Prisoner
records.about: This ball and chain of magical ice was dragged around by a helpless soul as the winter's chill seeped deeper and deeper into their cold, dead heart.

records.name: Aurora Tachi
records.about: The beauty of these blades as they dance together, bathed in radiant light soothes the restless souls that they tear from the bodies of their victims. The joys of winter are many.

records.name: Oryxmas Mystery Loot Chest I
records.about: Open this chest to receive a random reward!

records.name: Oryxmas Mystery Loot Chest II
records.about: Open this chest to receive a random reward of higher value!

records.name: Oryxmas Mystery Loot Chest III
records.about: Open this chest to receive a random reward of the greatest value!

records.name: Oryxmas Gift
records.about: As the plentiful bounty of Oryxmas is bestowed upon the Realm, see what the gift to you may be.\n\nItems contained in Oryxmas' Gift can only be redeemed until the 22nd of January 2024.

records.name: Oryxmas Treasure
records.about: An extravagant and golden gift, found in the most festive corners of the Realm.\n\nItems contained in Oryxmas' Treasure can only be redeemed until the 22nd of January 2024.

records.name: Oryxmas Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain one of the class skins from the Oryxmas Skins Collection.

records.name: Oryxmas Ice Weapons Chest
records.about: Merry Oryxmas! Open the chest to choose an Oryxmas Tier 12 Weapon!

records.name: Oryxmas Armor Chest
records.about: Merry Oryxmas! Open the chest to choose an Oryxmas Tier 12 Armor!

records.name: Oryxmas Ability Chest
records.about: Merry Oryxmas! Open the chest to choose an Oryxmas Tier 6 Ability!

records.name: Forge Chest Unlocker
records.about: Unlocks a forge chest! Once activated, do not change maps before the confirmation message appears or the item might disappear!

records.name: Seasonal Forge Expansion
records.about: Expands your seasonal Forge once. After the season ends, it expands your normal Forge Chest once. If you acquire this item with a non-seasonal character, it will expand your non-seasonal forge.

records.name: Midnight Star
records.about: Legends speak of a star touched by Horizon that pierces through the light of the heavens. As eons passed, the caged tyrant sharpened broken scales like razorblades, imbuing his hatred as inky black darkness to forge a dark myth into reality.

records.name: Wavecrest Concertina
records.about: A rather peculiar instrument played by the sailors of the seven seas. Its music has the unique property of attracting parrots that will obey the musician's every command.

records.id: item:Staff of the Crystal Serpent#Staff of the Crystal Serpent Shiny
records.name: Staff of the Crystal Serpent
records.alias: Staff of the Crystal Serpent Shiny
records.about: An ancient staff used both for sacrifice and communion with the gods.

records.id: item:Coral Silk Armor#Coral Silk Armor Shiny
records.name: Coral Silk Armor
records.about: Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.

records.name: Experimental Ring
records.about: An early prototype ring.

records.id: item:Sword of the Colossus#Sword of the Colossus Shiny New
records.name: Sword of the Colossus
records.alias: Sword of the Colossus Shiny New
records.about: A sword with an impossibly sharp edge. It has been designed with holy magic to slash like no other blade.

records.id: item:Wand of the Fallen#Wand of the Fallen Shiny
records.name: Wand of the Fallen
records.about: Made from a cherry tree branch. This wand was gifted by Xil to Daichi for bringing him into this world.

records.id: item:Resurrected Warrior's Armor#Resurrected Warrior's Armor Shiny
records.name: Resurrected Warrior's Armor
records.about: A worn and battered suit of armor embedded with a mystic gem that flows with magical strength.

records.name: Candy Ring
records.about: A high-fructose ring that will give you pep, but hurt your concentration.

records.name: Crystal Shield
records.about: An ornately decorated buckler made from an array of crystalline stone. It is too frail to swing around, but it can somehow grow and mantle its wielder in a heavy crystal armor that releases shards upon receiving trauma.

records.id: item:Tome of the Mushroom Tribes#Tome of the Mushroom Tribes Shiny
records.name: Tome of the Mushroom Tribes
records.alias: Tome of the Mushroom Tribes Shiny
records.about: A long-lost druid's tome that catalogs medicinal mushrooms. It also has many pocket spaces that contain spore samples, which can be made fully grown through incantations.

records.about: You can use this to add 1 Saddle Bag slot to a pet.

records.name: Pet Saddlebag Extender - 2 Slots
records.about: You can use this to add 2 Saddle Bag slots to a pet.

records.about: You can use this to add 3 Saddle Bag slots to a pet.

records.about: You can use this to add 4 Saddle Bag slots to a pet.

records.about: You can use this to add 5 Saddle Bag slots to a pet.

records.about: You can use this to add 6 Saddle Bag slots to a pet.

records.about: You can use this to add 7 Saddle Bag slots to a pet.

records.name: Wooden Zodiac Mystery Chest
records.about: Open this chest to receive a random reward of the great value!

records.name: Golden Zodiac Mystery Chest
records.about: Open this chest to receive a random reward of the greatest value!

records.name: Joker Timbrel
records.about: A unique and enchanted musical instrument, specifically associated with the playful and mischievous nature of jokers.

records.name: Dragon Mace
records.about: Small particles of fire energy visibly buzz around inside the fiery eyes of this mace.

records.name: Tome of the Dragon
records.about: This tome contains the original ancient dragon archives.

records.name: Dragon Slayer
records.about: As the Dragon Slayer shield is carried into battle, it serves not only as a bulwark against the wrath of dragons but also as a symbol of hope for those who stand against the opposing forces.

records.name: The Heart of the Dragon
records.about: Legend has it that this precious gem is the crystallized essence of a fierce dragon's heart, imbued with the ancient magic that flows through the veins of these titanic creatures.

records.name: Hatchling Blades
records.about: The gooey chocolate pellets attract the Hatchling, which fetches them back to the wielder along with bites taken out of whatever they are attached to.

records.name: Caramel Spellblade
records.about: The projectiles fired from this bio-mechanical weapon are so sticky that they glue themselves to the air for a moment before they start flying.

records.name: Egg Basher
records.about: A solid ball of bio-chocolate on the end of a chain.  It is so heavy and dense that when it lands it can shatter stone.

records.name: Bunny Ear Tachi
records.about: These Tachi are made to mimic the flopped ears of an Easter Bunny, and they fly back towards the thrower in imitation of them too.

records.name: Chocolate Ovipositor
records.about: This severed tail of an Easter Queen can continue to produce molten chocolate at flesh-searing temperatures long after it has been cut free.

records.name: Shard Launcher
records.about: A rapid-firing cannon which hurls handfuls of broken Easter Egg shell at the victim, lacerating them with the sharp edges.

records.name: Common Material Cap Extender
records.about: Adds 200 Common Material to the cap in your forge material storage.

records.name: Rare Material Cap Extender
records.about: Adds 200 Rare Material to the cap in your forge material storage.

records.name: Legendary Material Cap Extender
records.about: Adds 200 Legendary Material to the cap in your forge material storage.

records.name: Mythical Material Cap Extender
records.about: Adds 200 Mythical Material to the cap in your forge material storage.

records.name: Harlequin Armor
records.about: A festive piece of armor, complete with bells. Try not to get too crazy.

records.name: Sentinel's Sidearm
records.about: Use of magical weapons is typically reserved for the king's mage units. For a swordsman to receive such a fine piece of craft was considered a great honor, and perhaps still is.

records.name: S.T.A.F.F.
records.about: Dr. Terrible modeled this staff in the likeness of his creation as an experimental attachment to the M.E.R.V. design. To prevent overheating, the unstable energy discharges require a moment to cool.

records.id: item:Prism of Dire Instability#Prism of Dire Instability Shiny
records.name: Prism of Dire Instability
records.about: Seemingly bleak at first, this prism has erratic magical properties looming inside, which affect the light it scatters in unforeseen ways.

records.name: Deadly Keg
records.about: A barrel filled to the brim with the cheapest ale money can buy. The cask is highly pressurized and must be handled with care, should it be dropped it is likely to explode violently.

records.name: Enchantment Orb
records.about: The crystalline glass in this orb seals away an ancient flora said to rejuvenate the spirit and unleash one's force of will against those who threaten the wild.

records.name: Mystery Ancient Chest
records.about: Open the chest to get a random reward!

records.name: Ancient Chest
records.about: Open the chest and select a reward of your choosing!

records.name: Scarab Projectiles
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Cursed Canopic Jar
records.about: An intricately crafted vessel, usually used to store the preserved internal organs, but this one seems to contain a cursed diety.

records.name: An Ancient's Embrace
records.about: Crafted by a soul newly ensnared in the clutches of darkness, its design invoked memories of the fiery wrath of the god of chaos

records.name: Cobra Serpentis Scroll
records.about: This ancient spell scroll, adorned with intricate hieroglyphs depicting the sinuous forms of cobras, invokes the power of the serpentine deities. Whispering secrets of venomous potency.

records.name: Geb's Lost Hedjet
records.about: Crafted from glistening ivory and adorned with shimmering gold, but seems carry an ancient protection spell coming from the Underworld.

records.name: Crescent Dagger
records.about: This dagger arcs gracefully like the crescent moon.

records.name: Blue Falcon
records.about: Adorned in gold jewels and vibrant Egyptian blue, only the most skilled archers were given the right to wield such a magnificent bow.

records.name: Staff of the Eclipse
records.about: This staff is rumored to have devastating power when under the influence of an eclipse.

records.name: Rod of Radiance
records.about: The power of this rod comes from the glimmering glow of the sun, when shinned on top of the highest pyramid its power will really show.

records.name: Khopesh
records.about: Iconic to ancient Egypt, this curved blade was both used in warfare and ceremonies.

records.name: Shining Blade
records.about: This blade gleams brightly blinding foes with every swing.

records.name: Adventurer's Scarf
records.about: A faithful and comfortable scarf that has witnessed countless journeys. Imbued with a protective enchantment, it allows its wearer to gracefully weave through perilous situations.

records.name: Pirate's Artillery
records.about: Although cannons were once typically associated with naval warfare, many pirates now regard Bilgewater's application of them in land-based combat as revolutionary.

records.name: Celestial Recurve
records.about: A wondrous bow of heavenly origin, harnessing Daevic magic to bend and concentrate light into tangible projectiles. At the point where these beams intersect, a dazzling burst of celestial brilliance radiates.

records.name: Doom's Emblem
records.about: An accursed sigil that beckons to one's inner demons. Unholy paladins can unleash their dormant latent potential by forming a pact with an otherworldly force through a tribute of their own flesh and blood.

records.name: Skull of Restless Souls
records.about: An unnaturally pristine skull adorned with a crown of thorns. Various parts of this once holy figure continue to be worshipped as sacred relics post-mortem as they bestow graces and miracles through the traces of divine power abiding within.
in: item:Skull of Restless Souls#Skull of Restless Souls Shiny

records.name: Torrential Staff
records.about: A majestic trident adorned with enchanted coral formations that enables command of the tides. Once wielded by King Alexander in his conquest of the oceans, its power has since faded with each passing moon from natural weathering.

records.name: Cavalry Lance
records.about: A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.

records.name: Cavalry Lance
records.about: A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.

records.name: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy
records.about: A sinister twist on the scarecrow's intended use. Totalia bewitched these cursed figures with an uncanny allure to enthral victims into their untimely demise.
in: item:Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy#Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny

records.name: Evolutionary Records
records.about: An ancient volume recording ancestral lineages dating as far back as the Primal Era. Infused with the essence of druidic magic, it grants the power to delve into nature's eternal transformation, morphing its caster into formidable creatures.

records.name: Runes of Knowledge
records.about: A stone slab adorned with enigmatic symbols, harkening to an era of ancient technology still shrouded in obscurity. These same inscrutable runes are found etched on surfaces within the Tundra, beckoning those who dare to decipher their secrets.
in: item:Runes of Knowledge#Runes of Knowledge Shiny

records.name: Pollen Incendiary
records.about: A diabolical fusion of magic and chemical warfare engineered by Dr. Terrible in his effort to subjugate the Nest. When unleashed, it triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction between the charged volatile pollen that engulfs the air in a blinding and roaring inferno.

records.name: Bloodbath Blade
records.about: A malevolent katana infested with parasitic organisms. The ravenous symbiotes instills in its user a thirst for blood, which grows as it drinks from the life force of its wielder and their foes alike.

records.name: Cloak of the Deep
records.about: An enchanting cloak that conceals its wearer in a veil of iridescent bubbles. The shimmering cascade of bubbles serves as the only lifeline within the sea's deepest hadal trenches.
in: item:Cloak of the Deep#Cloak of the Deep Shiny

records.name: Quartermaster Scabbard
records.about: A foreign sheath stolen from unknown lands by the crew of Davy Jones. Now phantoms, the headstrong ghost pirates have misused this delicate instrument as a rapier holder, twisting its effects with their chaotic ways.

records.name: Crystal Mace
records.about: Small particles of energy visibly buzz around inside the glistening crystals of this mace.

records.name: Void Blade
records.about: An astronomically heavy katana. It is forged from dark matter.

records.name: E.Y.E.
records.about: The gouged eye of the ferocious F.E.R.A.L. It is no longer potent enough to generate energy beams, but the beast's psychic vision still instinctively lashes back at aggressors.

records.id: item:Esben's Shaman Attire#Esben's Shaman Attire Shiny
records.name: Esben's Shaman Attire
records.about: A glacial robe worn by the witch doctors of a bygone ice tribe during their sacred burial ceremonies. The passage of time has encased the cloth in a layer of permafrost, chilling those who fracture its coat.

records.id: item:Pirate King's Cutlass#Pirate King's Cutlass Shiny
records.name: Pirate King's Cutlass
records.about: Used only by the pirates who would make themselves kings, this cutlass is said to be cursed as each Pirate King seems to be killed rather unexpectedly.

records.name: Sunken Ring
records.about: Coral from the depths of the ocean which has formed into a natural ring. Painful to put on and take off, but very rare and therefore desirable.

records.name: Ghost Ship's Bell
records.about: An ancient ship's bell encrusted with dried deep kelp and bearing obscure sigils of forgotten, underwater gods. Its peals can summon fish to defend the bearer, but at what cost?

records.name: Rusted Mechanism
records.about: A rusted piece of Kogbold machinery recovered from the depths of the ocean. The only question is, how did it get on a thousand-year-old shipwreck?

records.name: Cursed Harpoon
records.about: Ancient legends say that the Phantom Diver never misses when he tosses this terrible harpoon. The fact these legends cannot be traced back to before last week is not important.

records.name: Depth Charge
records.about: A surprisingly modern explosive for breaching boats below the waterline. Don't forget to run when you throw it to avoid the blast!

records.name: Phosphorescent Rags
records.about: The glowing tatters of an old diving suit. The wearer must be a spooky ghost, and not three Kogbolds standing on each other's shoulders.

records.name: Diving Weights
records.about: Thick, lead ingots used to keep a diver's feet on the floor. They are definitely not gold bars being smuggled out of a secret mine.

records.id: item:Staff of Extreme Prejudice#Staff of Extreme Prejudice Shiny
records.name: Staff of Extreme Prejudice
records.about: Once the most powerful staff in existence; a crack in its frame has rendered it incapable of focusing fire. It remains uniquely deadly.

records.id: item:Shield of Flowing Clarity#Shield of Flowing Clarity Shiny
records.name: Shield of Flowing Clarity
records.about: This shimmering shield allows knights to enhance their concentration on targets, giving them more time to think about their next move in battle.

records.id: item:Wakizashi of Eastern Winds#Wakizashi of Eastern Winds Shiny
records.name: Wakizashi of Eastern Winds
records.about: A wakizashi used by a powerful swordsman in ancient times. It seems to dance through the air as you swing it.

records.name: Recurring Terror Spell
records.about: Believed to have been lost in a bygone era, this spell was recovered from ruins infested by horrific creatures of unknown origin. The scroll is still steeped with parasitic organisms.

records.name: Ritual Robe
records.about: A thin hood with a faded golden lace worn for sacrificial ceremonies. It has an aura of evil around it.

records.name: Primal Arcana
records.about: This deeply profaned magitech haunts those who bear it with distant, unending screams. One's conscience must be far beyond all reason to use its tremendous and varied powers without vacillation.

records.id: item:Color Orb Red Projectile#Primal Arcana Proc Shiny
records.name: Color Orb Red Projectile
records.said: Color Orb Red Projectile (Primal Arcana Proc Shiny)

records.name: Seasonal Mystery Ocean Shell I
records.about: Open this shell to receive a random treasure from the ocean. If left unused, it gets destroyed at the end of the season or after the character has been converted to a non-seasonal character.

records.name: Seasonal Mystery Ocean Shell II
records.about: Open this shell to receive a better random treasure from the ocean. If left unused, it gets destroyed at the end of the season or after the character has been converted to a non-seasonal character.

records.name: Seasonal Mystery Ocean Shell III
records.about: Open this shell to receive an even better random treasure from the ocean. If left unused, it gets destroyed at the end of the season or after the character has been converted to a non-seasonal character.

records.name: Mystery Ocean Chest
records.about: Use this chest to receive a random reward.

records.name: The Appetizer's Spicy Superburger
records.about: Made from Superburger and Spice of Life. This ultimate burger, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.

records.name: The Appetizer's Spicy Oryx Cookie
records.about: Made from Oryx Cookie and Spice of Life. This ultimate cookie, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.

records.name: The Appetizer's Spicy Power Pizza
records.about: Made from Power Pizza and Spice of Life. This ultimate slice of pizza, enhanced with the Spice of Life, provides extraordinary nourishment and flavor.

records.name: Class Mystery Skin Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain a class mystery skin of choice!

records.id: item:Helm of the Juggernaut#Helm of the Juggernaut Shiny
records.name: Helm of the Juggernaut
records.about: This helm was forged of metal that fell from the sky.  It is strangely light and emits a faint hum.

records.id: item:Helm of the Juggernaut - Midas#Helm of the Juggernaut Shiny - Midas
records.name: Helm of the Juggernaut - Midas
records.alias: Helm of the Juggernaut Shiny - Midas
records.about: This helm was forged of metal that fell from the sky.  It is strangely light and emits a faint hum.

records.id: item:Skull of Endless Torment#Skull of Endless Torment Shiny
records.name: Skull of Endless Torment
records.about: This skull glows with the stolen soul of a phoenix trapped in the skull many years ago by Shaitan.

records.name: Corruption Cutter
records.about: A fragment of Lord Ruthven's curse manifest itself into this pulsating dagger. Its formless state allows it to cut in ways no other weapon could.

records.name: Warmonger
records.about: Rarely brandished and in pristine condition, the old monarchy deemed this exquisite recurve too dignified for all but royalty to handle. Though it remains unproven in practical combat, this bow's raw potential is unmatched, waiting to be drawn out through pure focus.

records.id: item:Quiver of Shadows#Quiver of the Shadows Shiny
records.name: Quiver of Shadows
records.about: A mysterious quiver formed of corruption and dark matter. Its ethereal existence creates a small implosion of nearby atmosphere when drawn.

records.id: item:Amber Encrusted Helmet#Amber Encrusted Helmet Shiny
records.name: Amber Encrusted Helmet
records.about: Decorated with ancient amber, this helmet's idle solitude over many years have caused its abilities to dwindle.

records.name: Blade of Fates
records.about: Her blade of choice was cursed to be unfit to harm the likes of gods. Through accursed soul binding, she found a means to adapt this curse into a terrifying weapon.

records.name: Accursed Memory
records.about: The death throes of a powerful demigod remain sealed within the crystalline exterior, but are briefly unleashed as the soul desperately attempts to cling onto life, pulling onto the life force of nearby souls only to strengthen its prison further.

records.name: Gravetender's Vest
records.about: A well-worn studded leather that has witnessed many battles and many more losses. It is the common wear of those who must bear the burden of burying those forever lost to the fight against the gods.

records.name: Jewel of Vengeance
records.about: Concentrated within this gemstone are souls of vengeance, burning to serve one final role to smite the oppressors of the living.

records.name: Nebular Rod
records.about: A pristine cloud of nebular stardust gently rests atop a focusing rod in a tranquil stasis, until it is catalyzed into a microscopic genesis of stellar proportions. It is a reminder of the thin divide between uncreation and creation, a transcendental dance of the cosmos.

records.name: Cosmic Astrolabe
records.about: A glassy projection of arcanic lights provide an accurate chart of the stars beyond the Realm. Through a careful process of measurement and divination, one can travel along ley lines of starlight to reach worlds unknown.

records.name: Astronomer's Gown
records.about: What was once the simple vestments of an astronomer have become a curtain of stardust and dreams, a priceless record of countless travel through worlds that may never be visited again.

records.name: Eye of Divination
records.about: A crystalline formation in the shape of an eye remains the sole artifact of the journey’s true purpose- a secret beyond the stars waiting to be discovered. Beyond the dark horizons of the cosmic plane, what else has Cronus left behind for the explorers of the present to discover?

records.name: Monochrome Staff
records.about: A legendary weapon whose attacks are said to be as intense as its red color. Rumor has it that this may not even be the original.

records.name: Treasure Orb
records.about: Another orb in an endless myriad of orbs for heroes to collect. What makes this specific shape so special?

records.name: 1-Bit Robe
records.about: No matter how you look at this garment, it is always distinctly black and red, with no in-between shades.

records.name: Strange Ring
records.about: It is hard to make out what is on top of this ring. Maybe it is an eye or some sort of gem?

records.name: Turncoat Cape
records.about: This covering is assigned to Oryx's negotiators to conceal weaponry and get away with stolen fortunes.

records.name: Diplomatic Robe
records.about: The diplomacy of Chancellor Dammah goes as far as his limited patience. The true purpose of this robe is its deeply woven enchantment to bolster arcane powers.

records.id: item:Vesture of Duality#Vesture of Duality Shiny
records.name: Vesture of Duality
records.about: This cursed robe overwhelms the wearer with conflicting thoughts of good and evil, shattering the will of the weak-minded.

records.name: Centaur's Shielding
records.about: Specially weighted plates layered inside this armor channel greater force into every motion of the body for destructive blows.

records.name: Gladiator Guard
records.about: Although refurbished, this breastplate is the very same Oryx received as a gift from the royal family in celebration of his gladiatorial prowess.

records.name: Spider Shuriken
records.about: An arachnid star which slings silk to tangle predators while granting oneself the speed and stamina of Arachna's most agile young.

records.id: item:Cloak of the Mad God#Cloak of the Mad God Shiny
records.name: Cloak of the Mad God
records.alias: Cloak of the Mad God Shiny
records.about: A pitch black cloak enhanced with the defensive strength of Oryx's own signature armor.

records.name: Cnidaria Rod
records.about: An intricate scepter of unfathomable power containing the electric fluids of a jellyfish behemoth.

records.name: Polarity Poison
records.about: A perfectly concentrated blend of elemental forces, primed to diverge into an explosive result if the seal is ever broken. This flawless balance is believed to be the key to a still greater power.

records.name: Faithful Spatha
records.about: A tried and tested weapon used extensively by Commander-Lord Carosburg's soldiers.  It has a good weight for chopping, and a fine edge which can slice through most armour.

records.name: Temporal Wand
records.about: Cronus made many prototypes for different wands, with this being one of his most popular amongst his students, as the shots can injure a target in the past as well as the present.

records.name: Reliable Pugio
records.about: A swift and deadly dagger used as a backup weapon by soldiers in Commander-Lord Carosburg's armies.  It is also very useful by itself, and has ended many lives on the battlefield.

records.name: Transdimensional Bow
records.about: While it appears to the untrained eye that this bow only fires three arrows, it actually fires hundreds across all dimensions, as Cronus designed it to hit every possible variation of the target.

records.name: Deathmask Staff
records.about: Out of respect for their missing teacher, students of Cronus will mount a stone mask of his face to a staff to use as a focus.  They will often wear these masks or use them as ornaments as well.

records.name: Legions Odachi
records.about: A frighteningly sharp blade from the eastern lands, modified for use in Commander-Lord Carosburg's forces by executioners and elite duellists.

records.name: Temperate Curiass
records.about: Balanced between might and mysticism, the leather and metal of this light armour provides good protection and mobility.

records.name: Glorious Banded Plate
records.about: Polished to a high sheen, these banded plates proudly announce the prowess of the wearer in battle. Only the best of Commander-Lord Carosburg's foot troops are qualified to wear them.

records.name: Insightful Mourning Robe
records.about: Robes which signify the wearer follows the wisdom of the missing magus – Chronus. The small death masks worn as charms are said to symbolise his teachings.

records.id: item:Glory and Insight Skin Collection Chest
records.name: Glory and Insight Skin Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain one of the class skins from the Glory and Insight Skins Collection.

records.id: item:Glory and Insight Engraving Collection Chest
records.name: Glory and Insight Engraving Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain one of the Glory and Insight collection engravings.

records.id: item:Glory and Insight Gear Collection Chest
records.name: Glory and Insight Gear Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain a weapon or an armor piece of the Glory and Insight collection.

records.name: Corsair's Crown Jewel
records.about: This brilliant diamond exhibits a peculiar agitation to exposure beyond the waters. It was plundered by the Pirate Queen herself from depths far deeper than the open seas, as it was believed to be the boon of an ancient oceanic deity.

records.name: Sheath of Thunderous Rites
records.about: This sacred blade may be unsheathed in the blink of an eye to produce a catastrophic blast of lightning. Such a tool is used by Izel to bring fervor and great respect to the many gods of the thicket.

records.name: Forbidden Artifact
records.about: A depraved aura of malignance exudes from this relic. Once protected within the great tombs of the desert, Nefret unearthed this treasure to prevent it and many others from falling into the hands of the Legion.

records.name: Storied Blades
records.about: Once nameless tools of an oni warrior, these blades have witnessed the bloodshed of a thousand lives lost to Oryx. They carry the whispers of a long-sought vengeance against the Exalted One.

records.id: item:The Right Hook#The Right Hook Shiny
records.name: The Right Hook
records.about: A famous boxer once said the secret to their victory was having a great right hook, this dagger’s craftsman took that literally.

records.id: item:Snake Charmer Pungi#Snake Charmer Pungi Shiny
records.name: Snake Charmer Pungi
records.about: A ceremonial pungi that contains the spirits of fifteen snakes, guiding the righteous through their many paths ahead.

records.id: item:Ancient Stone Sword#Ancient Stone Sword Shiny
records.name: Ancient Stone Sword
records.about: A slow but powerful sword that is a relic of a long forgotten age.

records.name: Vanguard's Visage
records.about: A dreadfully heavy barbute, prominently featuring inward curving horns. Such a trait has been considered taboo for eons, further marking the age of this design.

records.id: item:Ring of Decades#Ring of Decades Shiny
records.name: Ring of Decades
records.about: Cut from a fallen star, a deep purple emanating an unearthly glow, hinting at the power fused within.

records.name: Ray Katana
records.about: A great katana charged with the power of the sun itself.

records.name: Ship's Wheel Shield
records.about: How can something with so many holes in it be useful in defence? By spinning it so quickly nobody can strike you through the holes, of course!

records.name: X-Marks-the-Spot Spell
records.about: This ancient, cursed treasure map causes treasure to appear in front of the caster.  As the coins and jewels overlap in physical space this causes a massive explosion.

records.name: Tome of Piracy
records.about: Pirates will not admit it, but they can't recall all the rules and regulations of piracy.  So they write them all down in books like these which become sacred relics of piracy.

records.name: Brine Quiver
records.about: Arrows placed in this quiver become encrusted with a layer of sea salt, and turn into augurs of seawater when fired.

records.name: Crossbones Skull
records.about: Some say this skull is the model used in the original Jolly Roger, but that seems a little unlikely.  It is still super powerful, whatever the truth.

records.name: Parrot Skeleton Scepter
records.about: This parrot was struck by lightning while perched in the crow's nest.  It has remained rigid and crackling with chained power to this very day.

records.name: Mystery Selection Key
records.about: Use this key to obtain one mystery keys of your choice.

records.name: Halloween Mystery Bag
records.about: Use this bag to receive a random spooky reward.

records.name: Wandering Souls Spell
records.about: Shaping raw magic into spirit-like forms, phantasmal projectiles are launched, each one homing in on the target with the precision of a well trained archer.
in: item:Wandering Souls Spell#Wandering Souls Spell Shiny

records.name: Ring of Skeletal Specters
records.about: A ghastly ring that calls upon the eager hands of an impossible undead creature.
in: item:Ring of Skeletal Specters#Ring of Skeletal Specters Shiny

records.name: Red Riding Dress
records.about: A light and breezy costume you can wear to dress up as a hooded treat-seeking Mystic!

records.name: Holy Order's Habit
records.about: A proper habit would be woven in a more durable manner than this, but it works just fine for dressing up as a patient, safety-aware Priestess!

records.name: Bachelor's Tuxedo
records.about: You'll smell more like Halloween spirit than of newfound riches, but it suits just perfectly for dressing up as an enterprising Rogue.

records.name: Haori of the Wind
records.about: These type of coats are more likely to be found at an anime convention with their shoddy quality, but it's just right for cosplaying the beautiful Ninja.

records.name: Platinum Segmentata
records.about: Foam and PVC don't make for as durable armor as Mithril, but it'll do for an accurate lookalike of the steadfast Knight.

records.name: Big Bad Fursuit
records.about: This costume is rather itchy and reeks of a strange glue-like scent, but it's par for the course for dressing as the furry Warrior.

records.name: Jailer's Scythe
records.about: A weapon used by Skuld's soul collectors to absorb and send souls to their final destinations.

records.name: Tools of the Tarnished
records.about: Two of Groundskeeper Gretch's most coveted tools, tainted by a powerful curse that draws out the life essence of its user to maintain their finesse.
in: item:Tools of the Tarnished#Tools of the Tarnished Shiny

records.name: Wretched Rags
records.about: A tattered piece of cloth crudely fashioned into a robe, barely capable of covering its wearer. However, what it lacks in physical durability is made up with a thick barrier of mana.

records.name: Overwhelming Axehead
records.about: An extremely heavy axehead salvaged from Griefkeeper Zole's rather bulky choice of weaponry. Throwing it takes a tremendous amount of effort, but it has the capacity to obliterate everything in its path.

records.name: Motivational Megaphone
records.about: A faintly magical device used by Griefkeeper Zole to amplify his own voice throughout the Penitentiary's cell branch. Peculiarly, speaking into it warps any attempts at encouragement into toxic insults.

records.name: Sinister Syringes
records.about: A chilling metal container filled with miscellaneous medical instruments coated in poison. Its syringes require blood as a catalyst, taking a considerable toll on both victim and user alike.

records.name: Cackling Straitjacket
records.about: A tightly-woven garment used to restrain the mentally insane in the Penitentiary's torture branch. The echoed laughs of its past users can be faintly heard while wearing it, and intensify as its wearer takes damage.

records.name: Command Cornea
records.about: The incredibly thick cornea taken from the eye of Overseer Oculon. It bears an immense hunger for magical energy, and will devour its user's entire mana pool in the blink of an eye.

records.name: Ocular Entrapment
records.about: A questionably sentient artifact smuggled from the Penitentiary's administration branch. Repeatedly irritating the summoned entity causes it to spew corrosive tears in a large area.

records.name: Damnation
records.about: An uncannily heavy iron ball and chain utilized by Murcian himself, burdened by the weight of countless souls that met their fate at the hands of the warden.

records.name: Deliverance
records.about: A much more refined cane than its predecessor, imbued with unwilling spirits that lost their way towards the afterlife.

records.name: Pandemic Poison
records.about: A specially engineered concoction containing a modified plague virus, allowing the direct infection of a victim's soul. Although it can infect over a massive area, the particular lack of lethality makes it seem incomplete.

records.name: Boundless Vessel
records.about: Empowering the mystic gem embedded in this armor caused it to violently disintegrate its former shell. Fitted into a new plating, it now massively increases its wielder's capacity for magical energy.

records.name: Amulet of Restoration
records.about: A nearly restored version of a once historical amulet, with the previous gem resocketed into a new metallic frame. It seems to have regained more of its ancient power.
in: item:Amulet of Restoration#Amulet of Restoration Shiny

records.name: Amulet of Desecration
records.about: Once a mystical artifact that allowed its bearer to escape the grasp of death, this amulet remains as a relic of Murcian's past involvement with Skuld. Wearing this amulet is ill-advised.

records.name: Penitentiary Souvenir
records.about: Summons Murcian and his staff to follow you around the realm! Wait a second, how did they escape...?\n\nRewarded to Marshmalla, TLMaelstrom, Sheepsmall, and Idontgiveawhale for their work on Spectral Penitentiary.

records.name: Spectral Penitentiary Vanity Generator
records.about: An infinite generator for the Spectral Penitentiary contributor reward.

records.name: Spectral Epic Quest Chest
records.about: An ominous looking safe from the Tinkerer's vault. It contains extraordinary items.

records.name: Spectral Prison Ration
records.about: A bowl filled with rewarding soup. You're not quite sure what's inside, but getting it down your stomach makes you feel tough enough to do involuntary labor.

records.name: Tezcacoatl's Tail
records.about: Adult male basilisks are apex predators, and at full maturity their tails gain the unique ability to release piercing acid from the tip.

records.id: item:Scepter of Rust#Scepter of Rust Shiny
records.name: Scepter of Rust
records.about: This electrical rod is actually used to remove rust from machine parts through electrolysis. When used on a living or artificial creature however, the shock causes muscles to tense and circuits to go haywire, reducing the assailant's power.

records.name: Soul's Guidance
records.about: A crude walking stick enchanted by Skuld's distinct style of sorcery, constructed to guide fallen spirits to the afterlife.

records.id: item:Sporous Spray Spell#Sporous Spray Spell Shiny
records.name: Sporous Spray Spell
records.about: An ancient druidic spell that invokes earth spirits into furnishing the soil with a noxious, deadly skullshroom colony.

records.id: item:Seal of Blasphemous Prayer#Seal of Blasphemous Prayer Shiny
records.name: Seal of Blasphemous Prayer
records.about: A seal that is said to briefly borrow the power of the Gods themselves.  Some Paladins shun its dark power, others embrace it.

records.name: Volcanic Sheath
records.about: Archdemon Malphas took a conspicuous liking to this outsider's sheath, smuggled in by a newly demonic soul. Perhaps its design reminded him of something?

records.name: Cursed Grimoire
records.about: Grants one item from the Halloween Priest or Huntress Set when used!

records.name: Silver Urn
records.about: Grants one item from the Halloween Warrior or Summoner Set when used!

records.name: Eerie Music Box
records.about: Grants one item from the Halloween Sorcerer or Ninja Set when used!

records.name: Electric Guitar
records.about: Rumored to be found deep in the aquatic ocean abyss, the fallen souls that reside within this guitar scream to be heard.

records.name: Inferno Pick
records.about: Forged in the hot lavas of the abyss, this pick has a dark influence over the player. The more they play, the stronger the possession becomes.

records.name: Wings of the Fallen
records.about: Torn from a powerful demon, these wings carry a dark energy that grant the wearer flight and confidence.

records.name: Pointy Tail
records.about: The longer you wear it, the more you feel in tune with the darker forces of the realms, rumored to cause red skin.

records.name: Thunder Mallet
records.about: A powerful weapon once wielded by a God of thunder. Striking this legendary weapon allows the wielder to smite opposition with the might of thunderstorms.

records.name: Enchanted Chisel
records.about: Designed for carving and also used to create bolts of thunder, smiting those that oppose justice.

records.name: Daopao
records.about: Traditional garments characterized by flowing robes, wide sleeves, and intricate designs.

records.name: Mala Beads
records.about: A string of prayer beads made from a combination of wood, seeds and gemstones. This ancient relic emboldens the wearer during meditation and spiritual practices.

records.name: Foramite Staff
records.about: A rod composed of solid foramite, the only known material in the galaxy capable of withstanding the corrosive effects of Foraxian acid.

records.name: Blazon Bow
records.about: A stunning bow forged in the heat of a massive star many lightyears beyond the realm.

records.name: Dueling Daggers
records.about: A set of daggers given partial sentience by alien technology. They fiercely compete to claim more kills than the other.

records.name: Fire Blade
records.about: Though rather unremarkable as far as alien weapons go, Malogian clans swear by this weapon as a good luck charm. Some things never change.

records.name: Splatter-proof Apron
records.about: A superior apron crafted from turkey hide, perfect for the culinary warrior who fears no grease splatter!

records.name: Apron of Conjuring
records.about: A dazzling apron woven from the finest metallic threads, perfect for conjuring up enchanted stuffing.

records.name: Reinforced Apron
records.about: This apron may look like standard chef's gear, but it's reinforced with cast-iron pots and enchanted oven mitts. Perfect for those who fear neither battle nor boiling oil!

records.name: Thanksgiving Mystery Chest
records.about: A festive chest filled with the spirit of Thanksgiving, offering a bounty of surprises. What treasures will the harvest reveal?

records.id: item:Crystal Bone Ring#Crystal Bone Ring Shiny
records.name: Crystal Bone Ring
records.about: A ring made from a splinter of crystallized sacrificial bone.

records.id: item:Prism of Dancing Swords#Prism of Dancing Swords Shiny
records.name: Prism of Dancing Swords
records.about: This prism has a deep flaw that causes it to scatter light in two directions.

records.name: Coral Bow
records.about: A bow fashioned from living coral found in only the deepest ocean trenches.  It is the favored weapon of those that inhabit the realms beneath the waves.

records.name: Celestial Blade
records.about: An ancient weapon imbued with the power of the cosmos.

records.id: item:Fire Dragon Battle Armor#Fire Dragon Battle Armor Shiny
records.name: Fire Dragon Battle Armor
records.about: Battle armor made from Fire Dragon scales, one of the strongest substances this world has ever seen.

records.name: Peacekeeper
records.about: A veritable artifact from the forgotten splendor of a kingdom none wish to remember. No matter the craftsmanship of its gilded design, this unwelcome sight is now only a sobering reminder of a mistake without regret.

records.name: Cat Bell (Small)
records.about: A bronze cat bell used by hunters to seek aid in the war against rats.

records.name: Cat Bell (Medium)
records.about: A silver cat bell used by hunters to seek aid in the war against rats.

records.name: Cat Bell (Large)
records.about: A gold cat bell used by hunters to seek aid in the war against rats.

records.name: Giant Pocket Rat
records.about: A massive rodent hiding in your pockets.

records.name: Piper's Pan Flute
records.about: A peculiar instrument used by rat hunters of yore to lure rodents to their demise.

records.name: Mouse Trap
records.about: A conventional tool used by rat hunters to snare rodents. Although simple, it proves to be timelessly effective.

records.name: Ferryman's Scythe
records.about: The swirling swings of this scythe can slice through bone as if it were a feeble stalk.\n\nSprite Credits: TLMaelstrom

records.name: Ferryman's Scythe
records.about: The swirling swings of this scythe can slice through bone as if it were a feeble stalk.\n\nSprite Credits: TLMaelstrom

records.name: Frozen Cache
records.about: Open this cache to get a random reward!

records.name: Oryxmas Gift
records.about: As the plentiful bounty of Oryxmas is bestowed upon the Realm, see what the gift to you may be.\n\nItems contained in Oryxmas' Gift can only be redeemed until the 27th of January 2025.

records.name: Oryxmas Treasure
records.about: An extravagant and golden gift, found in the most festive corners of the Realm.\n\nItems contained in Oryxmas' Treasure can only be redeemed until the 27th of January 2025.

records.name: Coin Purse
records.about: Open this purse to get a random reward!

records.name: Clockwork Repeater Shiny
records.about: A bow of unbelievable weight. It requires multiple Kogbold Workers to fire a single arrow.

records.name: Mechanical Kogbold Limb Shiny
records.about: An unknown Kogbold appendage, seemingly more machine than flesh.

records.name: Atavistic Soul Sabre Shiny
records.about: An unbearably heavy sword said to harness the soul of a Kogboldian master craftsman.

records.name: Socket Blade Shiny
records.about: A rather unusual ratcheting blade used by the Kogbolds to tighten the bolts on the Kogbold Steamwalker.

records.name: Kogbold Multitool
records.about: The KI132 Bladed Multitool finds its way into the hands of many Kogbold Engineers sent out on expeditions. It is equipped with blades for any situation, as well as a handy pair of pliers.

records.id: item:Ring of Skeletal Specters#Ring of Skeletal Specters Shiny
records.name: Ring of Skeletal Specters
records.about: A ghastly ring that calls upon the eager hands of an impossible undead creature.

records.name: Ocular Entrapment
records.about: A questionably sentient artifact smuggled from the Penitentiary's administration branch. Repeatedly irritating the summoned entity causes it to spew corrosive tears in a large area.

records.name: Greaterhosen Shiny
records.about: A necessary component for any beer-drinking or sausage-eating in the month of October.\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron

records.name: Heartsteel Claymore
records.about: The harbinger will tread through the Tundra, uncaring of the life that may have ended at the hands of the deepsteel blade.

records.name: Symbol of the Lost
records.about: To whom this symbol belonged, and what it may have represented, remains a mystery. It serves as a grim reminder of the world unobserved, cloaked in the endless snow.

records.name: Hull of the Tundra
records.about: The armor from the pitiful resistance was absorbed into this endless deepsteel plate. As the blizzard rages on, the plates grow ever more dense.

records.name: Frozen Heart
records.about: In the white wastes, Squall answers no prayers, spares no lives, and grants no solace.

records.name: Iceborn Arsenal
records.about: The Advisor would come to know that power is given to the opportune, and those who would adapt and utilize the Frost would be capable of becoming its master.

records.name: Sublimation Sidearm
records.about: The Harbinger's power was used to sublimate icicles along this blade, sending many sharp projectiles towards potential foes. He would soon learn that this was useful against more than just those who would oppose the Eternal Frost.

records.name: Retainer's Battlesuit
records.about: The suit, capable of withstanding the great cold, represented a pact between a mortal and an ever-living elemental being. Humans however, live too short lives to keep promises.

records.name: Legacy's Pendant
records.about: Perhaps at some point, a man wore this pendant in search of something that humans could possibly offer. As the pendant lost meaning, it became a reminder that what he sought was not of mortal nature.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Archer ST Crate
records.about: A crate filled with spare parts and armaments for the Kogbold Turretsmith.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Wizard ST Crate
records.about: A crate secured with fire suppression locks to hold ammunition for the Kogbold Pyrotechnician.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Priest ST Crate
records.about: A crate with an airtight interior capable of transporting fresh leeches for the Plague Doctor.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Warrior ST Crate
records.about: A crate kept in poor condition, presumably holding the belongings of the Killbilly Warrior.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Knight ST Crate
records.about: A crate engraved with the impression of a labyrinthine structure rumored to be the home of the Mad Minotaur.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Paladin ST Crate
records.about: A crate sealed with a dark crystalline frost akin to ancient tales of the Frost Harbinger.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Assassin ST Crate
records.about: A crate with a suite of rare toxins carefully sealed intact for the Alchemist Assassin.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Necro ST Crate
records.about: A crate of mysterious enchantments, consecrated by the unseen deities of the Shaman Necromancer.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Huntress ST Crate
records.about: A crate sealed with a high-security padlock containing experimental info about the Resurrected Huntress.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Mystic ST Crate
records.about: A crate encased in magical stardust, believed to contain the discoveries of the Astral Arcanist.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Trickster ST Crate
records.about: A crate shrouded in the howls of vengeant souls, believed to be the property of the Spellbound Soulthief.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Sorcerer ST Crate
records.about: A crate surrounded by crackling electricity, holding the artifacts of the Storm Shaman.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Ninja ST Crate
records.about: A crate holding the secret weapons and techniques of the Onmyoji Ninja.

records.name: Gen 3 Mystery Samurai ST Crate
records.about: A crate holding the long sealed arsenal of the Frost Advisor.

records.name: Cozy Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain one of the class skins from the Cozy Skins Collection.

records.name: Spiteful Scutum
records.about: A shield from a place beyond the gates of war and peace.

records.name: Murky Toxin
records.about: A deadly substance concocted with ingredients found in the sewers.

records.name: Warped Mantle
records.about: A sickly piece of armor, grown from the twisted bark from one of the few remaining Ent Ancients that still populate the Sulfurous Wetlands.

records.name: Bogwood Crook
records.about: This ornate herding staff composed of an old willow branch has been warped beyond mortal comprehension due to prolonged influence of the twisted beings of the Sulfurous Wetlands.

records.name: Spirit Dagger
records.about: A dagger that was condemned to Davy Jones' Locker.

records.id: item:Exalted God's Horn#Exalted God's Horn Shiny
records.name: Exalted God's Horn
records.about: A horn claimed from Oryx's iconic helmet. To hold this in one's hand is a monumental insult to the Mad God's ego.

records.name: Battalion Banner
records.about: The battle standard of Beisa's forces, a sign of triumph for Oryx and calamity for those he faces.

records.name: Divine Coronation
records.about: A majestic crown of the venerated, bestowed upon Archbishop Leucoryx to solidify his position in Oryx's legion.

records.name: Collector's Monocle
records.about: Treasurer Gemsbok had this monocle custom made to enhance his perception in stealth strikes.

records.name: Chancellor's Cranium
records.about: The warped mind of Oryx's appointed chancellor. This cursed object thrives in the presence of demented energies.

records.about: This wand is powerful at conducting magical energy into a devastating blast.

records.id: item:Mace of the Depths#Mace of the Depths Shiny
records.name: Mace of the Depths
records.about: This formerly ordinary mace was twisted by Arachna's son after plucking it from a hapless victim. Though he has no reason to use it himself, some believe the Son of Arancha keeps it as reminder to his kin to not cross him as he did his mother.

records.id: item:Vest of Abandoned Shadows#Vest of Abandoned Shadows Shiny
records.name: Vest of Abandoned Shadows
records.about: Formerly a nobleman's uniform, now workshopped by the court magician into a gloomy coat befitting of his accursed company.

records.id: item:Orb of Aether#Orb of Aether Shiny
records.name: Orb of Aether
records.about: This Orb creates a concentrated area of energy. The energy is so dense at its core that foes are paralyzed.

records.name: Dusky Catalyst
records.about: An untempered casting wand brought forth to tap into distant powers, but an imbalance rendered it too unreliable for most to dare use.

records.id: item:Cloak of Cubic Enigma#tD Cloak Shiny
records.name: Cloak of Cubic Enigma
records.about: A bulky cloak ill-suited for stealth, but can provide the wearer with great offensive capabilities.

records.name: Throwing Knives
records.about: A set of finely crafted, balanced throwing knives designed with the precision and flair of circus performers.

records.name: Acrobat's Edge
records.about: A katana of unparalleled grace and agility, the Acrobat's Edge is a weapon crafted for both elegance and performance.

records.name: Lion Tamer
records.about: A fierce yet elegant weapon.Both intimidating and masterfully crafted, the Lion's Tamer is a weapon that commands respect and awe, perfect for those who wield strength with precision and showmanship.

records.name: Dreamcaster
records.about: A staff of mystic allure, a tool for weaving illusions and conjuring wonders straight from the imagination.

records.name: Ringmaster's Bow
records.about: A bow of striking elegance and authority, crafted to captivate both audiences and adversaries.

records.name: Carnival's Conjurer
records.about: A wand brimming with whimsical power, the Carnival's Conjurer is a masterpiece of artistry and magic.

records.name: Serpent Pet Skin Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain one of the Serpent Pet Collection Skins.

records.id: item:Legend of the White Snake Mystery Chest
records.name: Legend of the White Snake Mystery Chest
records.about: A fancy-looking chest with unknown contents. It is said that even Oryx himself wants to take a look inside.

records.name: Igneous Starblossom
records.about: It is believed that astral stardust landed during the Primal Era, giving life to these now-extinct flowers that adapted to any environment they bloomed from. Consecrated by the infernal spirits of old, these artifacts now serve as a token of friendship with the elementals of the deep earth.

records.name: Combcutter Kunai
records.about: Shaped from the stingers of mutant beehemoths, these blades are sealed away until the very moment of combat and brandished by the finest of shinobee.

records.name: Rose Thorns Engraving Projectiles
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Blooming Bud Mystery Chest
records.about: This tightly closed flower bud, holds many secrets. As it unfurls, it reveals hidden treasures within, each as unique and enchanting as the petals of a rare bloom. \n\nOpen this chest for a mystery reward!

records.name: Heartseeker Katana
records.about: A lovely katana made for those who fight with passion and seek true love.

records.name: Eternal Star
records.about: A delicately engraved gem that captures the light of timeless love.

records.name: Chocolate Armor
records.about: A sweet and protective armor, crafted from rich chocolate, made for those who cherish the spirit of Valentine's Day.

records.name: Sweetener Ring
records.about: A beautifully crafted ring shaped like a heart, symbolizing the sweetness of love.

records.name: Sweetcut Wakizashi
records.about: A wakizashi with a unique edge, crafted to release a burst of sugary energy. Perfect for those who wield both sweetness and strength.

records.name: Lovebite Armor
records.about: A strong armor made from layers of rich cake and cream, offering both protection and a tasty, comforting spirit.

records.name: Excubicur
records.about: The Legendary Sword of the Cube God, is a blade of unparalleled power, forged from the essence of the almighty Cube God itself.

records.name: Eternal Echo
records.about: While the majority of the Disciples of Cronus generally favored lighter weaponry, a scant few could be found wielding massive blades of immense weight and equal power.

records.name: Twisted Fates Mystery Chest
records.about: A golden treasure chest guarding some of the most coveted relics in the realm. Legends speak of their power to twist and reshape the wearer's fate.

records.name: Divine Snake Oil
records.about: Consecrating the divine energies of Primal Snakes into a blend of juniper and mugwort creates a regenerative infusion far more potent than medicine known to the current world.

records.name: Salve of Eden
records.about: To create this sacred extract, Eden harvested hundreds of species of medicinal flora, all of which have thought to have been long extinct from the Primal Era.

records.name: Eden's Embrace
records.about: The empyreans thought otherwise, but I would not remain sealed. For my embrace reaches the whole Realm, and my will is eternity.

records.name: Cask Corslet
records.about: A cobbled together suit of armor made from a beer barrel, while lacking in real defensive properties, its alcoholic aura numbs the wearer's pain against attacks.

records.name: Motivational Megaphone
records.about: A faintly magical device used by Griefkeeper Zole to amplify his own voice throughout the Penitentiary's cell branch. Peculiarly, speaking into it warps any attempts at encouragement into toxic insults.

records.name: Arcane Rapier
records.about: This sword's blade is infused with magical essence, causing it to fire out violently upon lunging. That same magical force pulls the blade back to its hilt after striking.

records.name: Ghostly Prism
records.about: A cursed piece of Davy Jones' treasure. Using it leaves behind a deadly spirit bomb.

records.id: item:Bracer of the Guardian#Bracer of the Guardian Shiny
records.name: Bracer of the Guardian
records.about: A colossal gauntlet of masterful composition. Its sheer size is disproportionate for most warriors, only able to be worn on one's forearm as a bracer. A once glossy exterior faded from battle long ago, yet the sturdiness of its make is as resolute as it ever was.

records.name: Perennial Cranium
records.about: A flora-infested skull from one of Belladonna's victims. It exchanges the life force it steals into plant life, blooming powerful vegetation.\n\nSprite Credits: TLMaelstrom

records.name: Drowned Shamrock
records.about: A mystical clover infused with a golden brew.

records.name: Superior Mask of Anubis
records.about: An even more ancient relic of the Tomb of the Ancients, once used by holy worshippers in ceremonies. It turns your character into the Pharaoh Necromancer upon equip!

records.name: Superior Mask of Lightning
records.about: A very gilded artifact discovered in the temple of El Dorado, presumably belonging to none other than Xolotl himself. It turns your character into the Dark Master Wizard upon equip!

records.name: Superior Mask of Cnidaria
records.about: A not so uncomfortably squishy piece of headgear that the Royal Cnidarian probably wants back. It turns your character into the Dark Knight Trickster upon equip!

records.name: Superior Mask of Mucus
records.about: A not so ordinary mask covered in copious amounts of sludge from the Toxic Sewers. It turns your character into the Slurp King Knight upon equip!

records.name: Thousand Shot
records.about: A deadly repeater crossbow and a marvel of craftsmanship. This mechanical weapon is efficient, but carries additional weight.

records.name: Stat Potion Choice Chest
records.about: A stat potion chest filled with high-quality potions, each with a different fruit flavor.

records.name: Q.U.I.V.E.R.
records.about: Firing from this quiver uniquely applies the force of the bowstring as potential energy, which is then overcharged and converted to kinetic energy for a delayed, yet intensely powerful release.

records.name: Kaiken
records.about: Still believing himself a monk, Daichi knew an open blade contrasts his superficial rank. Yet he could not bear to abandon his wicked material weapon, and so he forever concealed it with this sheath.

records.name: Trap of the Vile Spirit

records.id: item:Queen's Stinger#Shiny EH Queen's Stinger Dagger
records.name: Queen's Stinger
records.about: The blade of this dagger was once the enormous Killer Bee Queen's stinger. It remains exceptionally sharp, and could easily cut through even the heaviest of armor in a single strike.

records.name: Makakoyumi
records.about: A bow believed to have only been fired in dissent against the heavens. In retribution, the empyrean rulers have cursed this device to tether its wielders in shackles of divine light.

records.name: Seasonal Jumpstart Gift
records.about:
Get a kickstart to the season in style!
Instantly grants level 20. Permanently increases attack, defense, speed, dexterity, vitality and wisdom by 5. Health and Magic by 25.

Unlocks a T9 weapon, T3 Ability, T9 Armor, and Ring of Superior Health for the class in use!

records.name: Biff's Extra
records.about: It is little known that Biff used to have an extra head. It holds secrets of untold treasures. \n\nItems contained in Biff’s Secrets can only be redeemed until the 20th of May 2025.

records.name: K.I.D.D. Force 2.0
records.about: After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the K.I.D.D. Force to create the K.I.D.D. Force 2.0. Upgraded with even less shades, this staff has really come around.

records.name: FFabulous FFlail
records.about: After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the MMace MMurderer to create the FFabulous FFlail. A MMace that can be MMasterfully FFlung, FFrequently FFlying FFabulously albeit with slight miscalculations.

records.name: Groovy Mango
records.about: After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of Mister Mango to create the Groovy Mango. This jamming mango was given the time to sweeten and ripen into a groovy party rocking entity.

records.name: Baked Bow
records.about: After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Butter Bow to create the Baked Bow. This bow showcases the power of butter, enjoy these tasty baked treats.

records.name: Caduceus Of Enlightened Chaos
records.about: After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Caduceus of Current Craziness to create the Caduceus Of Enlightened Chaos. Using this wand allows the user to reach their full chaotic potential and understand their role in battle; be unpredictable and let someone else deal with it.

records.name: Blade of Blooming
records.about: After years of tinkering with the algorithms, Null created a deadlier replica of the Blade of Ages to create the Blade of Blooming. Nature would slowly takeover this blade blooming with beautiful roses.

records.name: Fool's Prism
records.about: All that glitters is not gold. Beware, tricksters who choose this dastardly prism must be committed to their cruel prank.

records.name: Eggshell Carapace
records.about: Exceptional leather armor crafted from the hardened shell of an ancient, mythical egg-bearing creature.

records.name: Carrotroot Vestments

records.name: Fudgeclad Armor
records.about: Resilient enchanted chainmail forged from the finest molten chocolate, crafted for the legendary confectioner knights of the Sweetforge Dominion.

records.name: Bow of Fey Magic (SB)
records.about: A powerful bow crafted by dryads and blessed by the spirits of the woodlands.

records.name: Bow of Innocent Blood (SB)
records.about: A runed bow steeped in the dark power of ancient injustice.

records.name: Bow of Covert Havens (SB)
records.about: A diamondwire bow used by guardians of the unseen ethereal shrines.

records.name: Bow of Mystical Energy (SB)
records.about: A superlative bow of sunsteel and diamondwire, created by a secretive race of star-dwelling entities.

records.name: Staff of Necrotic Arcana (SB)
records.about: A golden staff imbued with the powers of death magic.

records.name: Staff of Diabolic Secrets (SB)
records.about: An imposing golden staff of tremendous otherworldly power.

records.name: Staff of Astral Knowledge (SB)
records.about: A splendid golden staff of astonishing power, bathed in light and brimming with magical energy.

records.name: Staff of the Cosmic Whole (SB)
records.about: A golden staff of transcendent understanding, made from crystals present at the formation of the universe.

records.name: Staff of the Vital Unity (SB)
records.about: A golden staff of elysian consciousness, shining with the base power of empyrean truths.

records.name: Wand of Deep Sorcery (SB)
records.about: A mysterious wand of otherworldly origin, imbued with the purest of arcane energies.

records.name: Wand of Shadow (SB)
records.about: A wand of demonic enigmas, cloaked in darkness and crackling with dark enchantments.

records.name: Wand of Ancient Warning (SB)
records.about: A centuries-old wand of great power, heralding long-destined destruction.

records.name: Wand of Recompense (SB)
records.about: A great golden wand of the heavens, created by angels to wreak justice on the slayers of the innocent.

records.name: Wand of Evocation (SB)
records.about: A shining gold wand of force, built by a diabolic archmagus to channel vast corrupting energies into the material plane.

records.name: Dragonsoul Sword (SB)
records.about: A sword forged in a great volcano and consecrated with dragon magic.

records.name: Archon Sword (SB)
records.about: A sword pulsing with the powerful magic of ancient beings.

records.name: Skysplitter Sword (SB)

records.name: Sword of Acclaim (SB)

records.name: Sword of Splendor (SB)

records.name: Ichimonji (SB)

records.name: Muramasa (SB)
records.about: An evil blade that hungers for blood.

records.name: Masamune (SB)
records.about: A magnificent legendary blade which only cuts those who deserve death.

records.name: Sadamune (SB)
records.about: A formidable blade that was meticulously crafted over the course of several centuries by the most renowned masters in history.

records.name: Cloak of the Night Thief (SB)

records.name: Cloak of the Red Agent (SB)

records.name: Cloak of Endless Twilight (SB)

records.name: Cloak of Ghostly Concealment (SB)

records.name: Magesteel Quiver (SB)
records.about: A superior enchanting quiver made of high quality magesteel.

records.name: Golden Quiver (SB)
records.about: A quiver that shines with gold and pulses with the power of elvish archer spirits.

records.name: Quiver of Elvish Mastery (SB)
records.about: A forestcloth quiver of highest quality, exhibiting exceptional magic powers and used by the foremost masters of Elven archery.

records.name: Scorching Blast Spell (SB)
records.about: A formidable fire spell used by dwarven magi in their war against the trolls.

records.name: Destruction Sphere Spell (SB)
records.about: An immensely powerful spell created by the wizard lords of the underworld to harness dark energies.

records.name: Magic Nova Spell (SB)
records.about: An unimaginably destructive spell, devised by the great mountain thaumaturgists to battle against demonic giants.

records.name: Elemental Detonation Spell (SB)
records.about: A horrifically dangerous spell, formulated in the elemental planes during the great astral wars.

records.name: Tome of Rejuvenation (SB)
records.about: A sacred tome, consecrated by the spirits of the upright and the supplications of the pure.

records.name: Tome of Renewing (SB)
records.about: An angelic tome, empowered by divine might and justified by the souls of the righteous.

records.name: Tome of Divine Favor (SB)
records.about: A sanctified tome, blessed by the heavens and purified by ancient rites, trembling with unseen divine power.

records.name: Tome of Holy Guidance (SB)
records.about: A tome of blessing, gifted by the gods for the benefit of all good mortals.

records.name: Red Iron Helm (SB)

records.name: Scepter of Storms (SB)

records.name: Skyward Lute (SB)

records.name: Chocolate Bunny Ears

records.id: item:Fractured Gemstone Wakizashi#Fractured Gemstone Wakizashi Shiny
records.name: Fractured Gemstone Wakizashi
records.about: Carved from the unblemished minerals deep beneath the realm, this unconventional wakizashi fractures itself when swung to release a strange supernatural energy.

records.name: Poison Fang Dagger
records.about: A dagger fashioned from the fang of an enormous spider.

records.about: An eerie reminder of what lies in the depths of the Shatters.

records.name: Brambletooth Tachi
records.about: A heavily serrated blade set studded with thorns from the many ravenous plants of the Sulfurous Wetlands. The accursed magic used to mutate the native flora has been likewise imbued to these blades, enabling for a unique yet precise slashing technique.

records.name: Oryx's Escutcheon
records.about: An enormous shield decorated with the crest of Oryx, an infamous symbol of oppression dreaded across the realm.

records.name: Chaotic Scripture
records.about: The sacred writings of Leucoryx and his disciples, compiled as a tribute to Oryx to lend false credence to the teachings of his twisted followers.

records.name: Gambler's Fate
records.about: A coin pilfered from the endless vault of Gemsbok's hoarded wealth. Only the most daring would stake their lives on the equal odds of a coin flip.

records.name: Genesis Spell
records.about: Dammah's powers of summoning portals stem from this profane spell. Most may use it to call attacks from primitive dimensions of untapped energy, but Oryx's greatest thaumaturges can create stable gateways to the realm and beyond.

records.name: StarTest Shiny
hidden: an effect, not a thing worn

records.name: Ballistic Star

records.name: Orb of Sweet Demise
records.about: A magical honeycomb that was once crucial in repelling an assault from the Hornet Rebellion.

records.name: Incubation Mace
records.about: Easter celebrations call for eggs, but Oryx's strict regulations on anything that might be a chicken makes eggs risky. This mace mimics the functions of an egg to summon pre-grown rabbits, with exactly the personality you'd expect from an animal raised by a weapon.

records.id: item:Scepter of Fulmination#Scepter of Fulmination Shiny
records.name: Scepter of Fulmination
records.about: This scepter's blast is so powerful it will slow opponents.

records.about: This strange weapon was used by ancient battle mages to deter invaders. The secret to its construction has long been lost.

records.name: Cloak of Refraction
records.about: This heavy cloak cleverly conceals its user not by magic, but by channeling the light around them as camouflage. Tampering with this light briefly projects a false mirror image of oneself.

records.name: Steam Pipe
records.about: Efforts by lower workers of the kogbolds to arm themselves against invaders has resulted in various interesting crudely made armaments. Fashioned from the boiler of a steam generator, this staff projects its scalding vapors towards a target, cooking them alive.

records.name: Mighty Stein
records.about: A mighty mug for a mighty drink! Be merry!\n\nSprite Credits: Dappertron

records.id: item:Ring of the Pyramid#Ring of the Pyramid Shiny
records.name: Ring of the Pyramid
records.about: The dolomite stone makes you feel able to stand against anything.

records.name: Corsair Ring
records.about: A lavish golden ring adorned with a prized ruby from Dreadstump's spoils.

records.name: Spider Shuriken

records.name: Tarot Card Pack

in: item:Maw of Malignance#Maw of Malignance Shiny

records.name: Bubblegum Bucket
records.about: No one would dare question your dominance of the Hunting Grounds while wearing the remains of a decapitated gumball machine.

records.name: Vision of Draconis
records.about: As the heavens decreed, the age of dragons came swiftly to an end. Yet the gaze of the mighty watch intensely over the world, waiting for the power of Draconis to rise once again.

records.name: Rosebite Dagger

records.name: Leaf Woven Robe

records.name: Ring Of Radiant Petals

Though its computation capabilities are lost to time, the matrix remains conveniently effective at distributing powerful surges of energy.

records.about: It smells of nothing, but it looks like death.

records.name: Esben's Twisted Heart

records.about: A powerful gun that blasts refreshing water! Perfect for cooling off and fighting enemies. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

records.name: Beach Umbrella
records.about: Protect yourself from the sun and heat with this umbrella, or use it to defeat some enemies that want to steal your place at the Realm's beach. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

records.name: Flip-Flops
records.about: These aren't just for walking on burning sand, they also deliver surprisingly splashy attacks to enemies. While firing, every 3 seconds a burst of water appears, damaging nearby enemies and extinguishing fires caused by heat waves.

records.name: Life Jacket
records.about: A bright orange vest designed to keep you afloat in deep water or on the battlefield.

records.name: Summer Dress
records.about: A lightweight, bright outfit perfect for warm weather. It allows great freedom of movement and keeps you cool during intense battles.

records.name: Swim Tube
records.about: A colorful inflatable made for floating, surprisingly useful in battle. Designed for summer rest, but it also offers just enough support to survive intense encounters in the Realm.

records.name: Sun Hat
records.about: A hat that shields you from the blazing sun and heat, perfect for staying cool in the Realm.

records.name: Coral Soda
records.about: A fizzy drink not just for beating the heat, use it to blast enemies with carbonated shots!

records.name: Chocsicle
records.about: A chocolate popsicle not just for beating the heat, wield it in the Realm to deliver frosty pain!

records.name: Bottled Lemonade
records.about: A sour drink not just for refreshment, splash your enemies with citrus power straight from the bottle!

records.name: Spirit's Bane
records.about: A strange ectoplasmic concoction that can inflict its blight on living and ethereal alike.

records.name: Adamantine Helm
records.about: A masterpiece of craftsmanship, this full helm was forged in the fires of the volcanic abyss infusing its metal with a regenerative ability.

records.name: Berserker's Breastplate
records.about: This armor is donned by the Brutes of the Abyss, focusing narrowly on pure offensive power with little regard to the wellbeing of its wearer.

records.name: Honey Scepter
records.about: Stolen from the Queen Bee herself, this scepter possesses the power to destroy evil.
