records.name: Cracked Crystal Skull
records.about: A relic uncovered from the depths of the jungle. It exudes a deep darkness.

records.name: Marble Seal
records.about: A seal made from the Marble Colossus' head. The power of a pure and mighty paladin still remains within.

records.id: item:Amulet of Dispersion#Amulet of Resurrection Shiny
records.name: Amulet of Dispersion
records.about: A historical amulet that has been passed down for generations. Although once cursed in the past, it still holds a hint of its ancient power.

records.name: Marionette Ravager
records.about: The perfect tool for dismembering theatre equipment.

records.name: Jailer's Scythe
records.about: A weapon used by Skuld's soul collectors to absorb and send souls to their final destinations.

records.name: Legion Elite Robe
records.about: Woven from the shrouds of fallen warlocks and bound with arcane sigils, this robe pulses with ancient power.

records.name: Legion Elite Leather Armor
records.about: Crafted from shadow-infused hide and reinforced with silent steel, this armor grants uncanny agility and resilience to those who strike from the darkness.

records.name: Legion Elite Plate Armor
records.about: Forged in the heart of a cursed forge, this blackened plate bears the scars of countless battles.

records.name: Legion Elite Dagger
records.about: A razor-thin blade forged from obsidian and voidsteel, this dagger strikes faster than a shadow's blink. Its edge is in a constant thrist for blood.

records.name: Legion Elite Bow
records.about: Constructed from legendary blackwood and bone, this bow fires arrows that whisper through the air like wailing spirits. It is said each shot carries the wrath of a fallen legionnaire.

records.name: Legion Elite Staff
records.about: This gnarled staff hums with dark energy, its crystal core bound to the souls of ancient battlemages. Spells cast through it erupt with volatile force.

records.name: Legion Elite Wand
records.about: A wand carved from the heartwood of a cursed tree and tipped with an eternal ember.

records.name: Legion Elite Sword
records.about: This massive blade radiates dread with every swing. Enchanted to rend armor and bone alike.

records.name: Legion Elite Katana
records.about: Tempered in cursed flame and etched with forgotten runes, this katana channels the fury of the Legion's eastern assassins. Every slash cleaves both flesh and spirit.

records.name: Sprite Wand
records.about: A wand created from the wood of Sprite trees. Seems to be poorly calibrated, though.

records.name: Snakeskin Armor
records.about: A tight fitting garment of snake skin that is both functional and stylish.

records.name: Bottled Medusozoan
records.about: A youthful jellyfish taken from the reefs of the ocean realms, residing within a coralglass jar.

records.name: Brewer's Bangle
records.about: A small golden band meant to be worn on one’s ear. This mundane looking accessory appears to give the wearer an increased tolerance to intoxicants.

records.name: Burial Blades
records.about: Jagged obsidian and smooth malachite blades inscribed with runes and teeming with energy. The runes read as a eulogy for those lost while trying to seal a great evil.

records.id: item:Royal Guard's Cuirass#Royal Guard's Cuirass Shiny
records.name: Royal Guard's Cuirass
records.about: Armor of the bridge sentinel, adorned with honors which now serve only as a bitter reminder of what once was.

records.name: Legion Elite Cloak
records.about: Grants stealth and deadly ambush power, favored by legion rogues.

records.name: Legion Elite Quiver

records.name: Legion Elite Spell
records.about: Unleashes powerful dark magic, overwhelming foes with ordered chaos.

records.name: Legion Elite Tome
records.about: A corrupted tome pulsing with dark power, used by the Legion Elite to sustain their twisted forces and prolong their ruthless crusade.

records.name: Legion Elite Helm
records.about: A steel and obsidian helm of grim design, only worn by high commanders of the Shadow Legion.

records.name: Legion Elite Shield
records.about: A fortified shield forged in the abyssal forges of the Shadow Legion, built to withstand the fury of rebellion and enforce the will of their dark empire.

records.name: Legion Elite Seal
records.about: A seal of iron command, forged by the Shadow Legion to impose unwavering discipline and bolster their ranks with oppressive might.

records.name: Legion Elite Poison
records.about: Precision-crafted toxin designed for silent elimination behind enemy lines.

records.name: Legion Elite Skull
records.about: A cursed artifact channeling disciplined death magic to drain and heal.

records.name: Legion Elite Scepter
records.about: Strikes with targeted lightning, controlling the battlefield with calculated force.

records.name: Legion Elite Star
records.about: A deadly projectile of concentrated chi, launched with elite discipline.

records.name: Legion Elite Wakizashi
records.about: A wicked wakizashi forged from shadowsteel, granted to Shadow Legion warlords as a reward for their ruthless conquest.

records.name: Legion Elite Sheath
records.about: A darkly ornate sheath, relic of a fallen clan extinguished by the Shadow Legion, preserving deadly secrets of forgotten martial rites.

records.name: Legion Elite Trap
records.about: Mechanized snares designed for strategic area denial and rapid ambush.

records.name: Legion Elite Drums
records.about: Beats of war that rally allies and demoralize the unprepared.

records.name: Legion Elite Orb
records.about: Manipulates reality with disciplined chaos, disrupting the rebellion's formations.

records.name: Legion Elite Prism
records.about: Projects disciplined illusions, confounding enemies with strategic misdirection.

records.name: Legion Elite Mace
records.about: A brutal mace forged from cursed darksteel, imbued with the Shadow Legion's relentless fury and the unyielding force of their shadowed dominion.

records.name: Legion of Oryx Collection Chest
records.about: Use this chest to obtain one of the class skins from the Legion of Oryx Skins Collection.

records.name: Legion Treasure
records.about: A sealed cache of spoils seized by Oryx's most elite forces during one of their campaigns.

records.name: Nightmatter Circlet
records.about: An immaculate Nightmatter Core set in a housing that acts as a conduit granting power to its wearer, the power grows even stronger in the presence of additional nightmatter.

records.name: Rice Bowl
records.about: A bowl of steamed perfection. Simple yet satisfying, it's rumored to restore energy faster than you can say sushi!

records.name: Dumplings
records.about: Each dumpling is packed with mystery meat and magic. Who knows what spell you'll cast with a belly full of these!

records.name: Bagel Sandwich
records.about: Circular, chewy, and slightly magical.

records.name: Baguette
records.about: Wield it like a sword or devour it like a hero. This crusty loaf has seen more battles than you can chew.

records.name: Chocolate Cake
records.about: Dark, rich, and full of forbidden coco magic!

records.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
records.about: Each grain of rice is infused with the essence of the ocean, and every shrimp tells tales of the deep sea. A dish that's truly out of this realm!

records.name: Beef Burger
records.about: Stacked with a patty as mighty as a minotaur and sauces as mysterious as the dark woods, this burger is a feast fit for a champion.

records.name: Veggie Burger
records.about: Crafted from the finest greens in the realm!

records.name: Shards of Destiny
records.about: A chest containing fragments of lost relics. Though aged, with some polishing and careful assembly they could form a relic that looks as good as new. What could possibly go wrong?

records.name: Pet Takeout

records.name: Lost Treasures

records.about: Placing this trinket into an appropriate slot found on Steamworks machines activates their overclock drastically increasing output. The increased speed causes a greater amount of wear on the parts of the machine, usage of this item is only authorized to higher ranking Kogbolds.

records.name: The Crimson Blade
records.about: This heavy blade is an unnatural channel for raw, condensed life-force.

records.name: Ceremonial Wand

records.name: Blood Siphoning Katana

records.about: Two of Groundskeeper Gretch's most coveted tools, tainted by a powerful curse that draws out the life essence of its user to maintain their finesse.

records.id: item:Cloak of Bloody Surprises#Cloak of Bloody Surprises Shiny

records.name: Phantom Sickle
records.about: A crescent of weightless shadow that glimmers like frost on midnight air, the Phantom Sickle cuts through illusions and unravels the echoes clinging to wandering spirits. Its spectral edge parts unseen veils with each sweep, revealing hidden truths that linger just beyond mortal sight.

records.name: Spectre Cloak
records.about: The Spectre Cloak shrouds the user in a wavering veil of spirit-light that blurs their outline and mutes their presence. While enveloped in this ghostly mantle, they slip through hostile gazes and glide between moments as if half-forgotten by the living world.

records.name: Reaper's Shroud
records.about: The Reaper’s Shroud envelops the user in a cold mantle of deathly stillness that dims their life-essence to a fading whisper. Within this chilling veil, they move with grim purpose as nearby foes feel their strength falter under the weight of an unseen harvest.

records.name: Soul Necklace
records.about: The Soul Necklace radiates a faint inner glow as it binds to the wearer’s spirit, heightening their intuition and granting whispers of guidance from lingering echoes of the past. When its power stirs, it steadies the heart and sharpens the senses as if unseen guardians watch from just beyond the veil.

records.name: Tlatoani's Shroud
records.about: The Tlatoani used this robe to aid them in casting their most powerful magic spells. Like their other ceremonial garbs, it rarely saw much combat application.

records.name: Gloves of Love
records.about: Gloves sewn by a witch and enchanted by a succubus, only the most mentally strong can wield such gloves without becoming love obsessed.

records.name: Mask of Passion
records.about: This mask belongs to a cult of love worshippers, they believed that bringing everyone together in sync as one would open up new heights of strength through the power of love.

records.name: Boudoir Robe
records.about: This soft robe will help calm the mind and relax any hero from stress during battle, it even works on enemies too.

records.name: Essence of Love
records.about: Cultivated from the slain friends and foes lies the very essence of love both the good and bad, any hero who dares to wield such a thing will drive its user mad.

records.name: Essence of Enlightened Love
records.about: Wielded by those who’s hearts faced difficulties yet continued on, representing both the good and bad and continued strength love can bring.

records.name: Spring Rose
records.about: The first roses to shine in the spring are given the most attention and treatment, thanks to this they’re gifted with magical properties causing them to grow even stronger, many seek out these early blooming roses for their power.

records.name: Ever Green Skull
records.about: This skull was left behind, infused within the bed of flowers in the floral realms. Now fully bloomed and ready for battle, capable of aiding it’s flower friends.

records.name: Floral Corset
records.about: Weaved together by strong petals, it’s able to hold together tight due to the petals age thanks to Belladonna’s extensive care for flowers.

records.name: Rose Brooch
records.about: Beautiful yet dangerous, only those who value the lives of flowers can carry such a rose. This rose retaliates back with sharp thorns to anyone that seeks to harm this rose or its user.

records.about: Select Love Witch Necromancer ST equipment of choice with minimum Uncommon Rarity.

records.name: Solar Flare Igniter
records.about: An ancient focus used to channel the raw intensity of a solar flare. It emits a concentrated beam of heat so pure it can slice through steel plates as if they were cooling embers.

records.name: Crest of the Rising Sun
records.about: A recurve bow carved from the golden feathers of a fledgling phoenix. Its potential for destruction is vast, though it demands the steady focus of a heart in perfect harmony with the sun.

records.name: Bloom-Fire Scepter
records.about: A staff adorned with enchanted petals that never wilt. Once used by the Solar Monarch to command the waves of heat during the Great Bloom, its brilliance has softened into a gentle, rhythmic glow.

records.name: Ashen Talon
records.about: Forged from the razor-sharp talon of a Great Phoenix, this blade retains the bird's legendary heat. It strikes with such blistering intensity that it ignores the thickest armor, leaving only ash behind.

records.name: Sovereign Cinder-Blade
records.about: A massive, heavy blade forged in the heart of a dying star. It embodies the stoic might of the phoenix's rebirth, though its immense weight and heat tax the physical strength of any who swing it.

records.name: Blade of Eternal Rebirth
records.about: Infused with holy solar magic, this sword's edge vibrates with the energy of a thousand dawnings. It is designed to slash with a purifying flame that no worldly shield can hope to withstand.

records.name: Heart of the Eternal Pyre
records.about: A pulsating ruby encased in a band of white gold that grows warm when danger nears. It grants the wearer the resilience of the phoenix, allowing their spirit to flicker but never truly go out as long as the sun continues to rise.

records.name: Pyre-Forged Arsenal
records.about: A blazing chest filled with valuable rewards for clever adventurers.

records.name: Phoenix Blaze
records.about: A phoenix-feather treasure chest said to contain useful items that aid Realm adventurers on their journey.

records.name: Phoenix Embers
records.about: A darkened ember shard that still holds enough magic to produce a valuable reward.

records.name: Necronomicon
records.about: A tattered tome possessing the forbidden knowledge of pagan priests of old. It speaks of casting terrible curses upon opponents, but such impure power comes at a cost.

records.name: Bone Dagger
records.about: A dagger made of razor-sharp bone.

records.name: Coral Ring

records.id: item:Armor of Nil#Armor of Nil Shiny
records.name: Armor of Nil
records.about: This armor does not deflect projectiles like most materials known to man. It absorbs and engulfs them, sending them to a new plane of reality.

records.name: Sigil of the Chicken
records.about: A basic pendant used by novice druids.

records.name: Sigil of the Bunny
records.about: A pendant with a carved turquoise stone resembling the form of a bunny.

records.name: Sigil of the Skunk
records.about: A bronze pendant symbolising the skunk whose form is deceptively powerful to a druid’s foes.

records.name: Sigil of the Fox
records.about: A pendant bearing the form of a fox which is reserved only for more advanced druids. The speed and cunning provided by the transformation is a powerful tool for druids.

records.name: Sigil of the Wolf
records.about: A silver pendant representing the wolf, this form is similar to the fox but provides additional strength for combat druids to leverage over their enemies.

records.name: Sigil of the Boar
records.about: A boar shaped pendant, its form radiates strength and tenacity. Druids capable of sustaining this form are among the strongest the druidic orders have to offer.

records.name: Sigil of the Horse
records.about: A golden sigil set with sapphire gemstones, druids call upon the form of the horse for its high strength and unparalleled stamina.

records.name: Sigil of the Rhino
records.about: A gilded sigil with ruby gemstones, delicately shaped into the form of the Rhino. This form represents the pinnacle of normal druids, only surpassed by druids choosing to specialize in more mythical creatures.

records.name: Sharktooth Sigil
records.about: This necklace is adorned with the tooth of a great white shark. Druids who familiarize themselves with this item may take on its form becoming the apex of the seas.

records.name: Silken Sigil
records.about: A live spiderling with a string formed of its own silk, a druid may befriend it to gain increased familiarity with the form of a spider, a traditionally hard form to undertake.

records.name: Draconic Insignia
records.about: This relic was once used by a secluded cult of dragon worshippers. A druid may tap into its arcane power to embrace the form of a dragon.

records.name: Swarmlord's Sigil
records.about: Fashioned by the Beekeeper, this pendant allows the wearer to command the forces of the nest directing swarms of bees to attack the wearer's enemies.

records.name: Crystalline Sigil
records.about: An incredibly complex and durable crystalline structure appears on this pendant where a druid might expect the representation of an animal. Familiarising oneself with its forms is incredibly difficult but druids who succeed find themselves to be unbreakable walls against all forms of threat.

records.name: Mechraptor Sigil
records.about: This device was forged by an engineer attempting to artificially recreate the ways of the druid. Using it allows for not only summoning robotic raptor companions, but to form a suit of armor that might be piloted to lead them.

records.name: Hawkmaster Sigil
records.about: Similar to the falconers in the ranks of Chief Beisa, the agents of oryx employed hawks to do their bidding. Their speed and hunting acumen allow them to be incredible inspiration for druids among the agent’s ranks.

records.name: Sigil of the Rubber Duck
records.about: A powerful sigil displaying the form of the most menacing creature of the realm. Acts as a flotation device in a pinch.

records.name: Xeno Heart
records.about: The pulsating heart of an alien being, said to bestow incredible vitality.

records.name: Astral Jelly
records.about: A shimmering jelly harvested from the rifts between stars.

records.name: Asteralis Root
records.about: A rare root that thrives in the soil of distant asteroids.

records.name: Cosmic Spice
records.about: A blend of spices collected from across the galaxy. Adds a celestial kick to any dish.

records.name: Space Ration
records.about: Standard issue rations from a long forgotten space fleet.

records.name: Mystery Emote Chest
records.about: Consume the chest to get a random Emote.

records.id: item:Hama Yumi#Longbow of the Guardian Shiny
records.name: Hama Yumi
records.about: This longbow has protected the mountain shrines for centuries in the hands of countless legendary archers. The hail of arrows it fires is said to purify wretched spirits of corruption.
records.said: Hama Yumi (Longbow of the Guardian Shiny)

records.name: Crystalline Sigil
records.about: An incredibly complex and durable crystalline structure appears on this pendant where a druid might expect the representation of an animal. Familiarising oneself with its forms is incredibly difficult but druids who succeed find themselves to be unbreakable walls against all forms of threat.

records.name: Esben's Vows
records.about: A hardy slab of ice wounded with crude markings on its surface. Passionate wedding vows are faintly readable.

records.id: item:Crystallized Worm Spellblade#Crystallized Worm Spellblade Shiny
records.name: Crystallized Worm Spellblade
records.about: The worms of the Crystal Caverns are capable of surviving indefinitely so long as their heads remain intact. The affixation of this particular worm's head onto a quarterstaff prevents it from regenerating the rest of its body and causes it to angrily lash out, biting anything brought near it.

records.name: Elder Heartwood Staff
records.about: Carved from the heartwood of an ancient tree and imbued with the whispering spirits of the forest, this staff channels centuries of wisdom.

records.id: item:The Forgotten Ring#The Forgotten Ring Shiny
records.name: The Forgotten Ring
records.about: Part of a sacramental rite, the memory of which has faded with those who observed its divine grace.

records.name: Venerable Doom Bow
records.about: No mortal can fire this dreaded bow without resting in between shots. It requires tremendous skill to wield.

records.name: Venerable Ancient Stone Sword
records.about: A slow but powerful sword that is a relic of a long forgotten age.

records.id: item:Venerable Staff of the Crystal Serpent
records.name: Venerable Staff of the Crystal Serpent
records.about: An ancient staff used both for sacrifice and communion with the gods.

records.name: Venerable Spirit Dagger
records.about: A dagger that was condemned to Davy Jones' Locker.

records.name: Venerable Crystal Wand
records.about: A sound almost like a wind chime emanates softly from this wand.

records.name: Venerable Doku No Ken
records.about: Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.

records.name: Venerable Resurrected Warrior's Armor
records.about: A worn and battered suit of armor embedded with a mystic gem that flows with magical strength.

records.id: item:Venerable Robe of the Mad Scientist
records.name: Venerable Robe of the Mad Scientist
records.about: A well-worn robe used for Science!

records.name: Venerable Coral Silk Armor
records.about: Mermaid-made armor woven from unbreakable coral threads.

records.name: Venerable Ring of the Sphinx
records.about: The malachite stone makes you feel at peace with the land.

records.name: Venerable Ring of the Nile
records.about: The azure stone makes you feel ready for any situation.

records.name: Venerable Ring of the Pyramid
records.about: The dolomite stone makes you feel able to stand against anything.

records.name: Decades Chronicle
records.about: An etched starmatter gem atop a gilded band, commemorating the past 10 years of the Heroes of the Nexus' fight against the forces of Oryx.

records.name: Retrowinds Dagger
records.about: A sleek blade tempered in the restless currents of RetroWinds, made for swift and silent strikes.

records.name: Retrowinds Bow
records.about: A finely strung bow that carries the song of RetroWinds with every arrow fired.

records.name: Retrowinds Staff
records.about: An ancient staff humming with the energy of RetroWinds, guiding its wielder's magic along winding paths.

records.name: Retrowinds Wand
records.about: A slender wand marked with flowing lines, drawing the strange power of RetroWinds into every spell.

records.name: Retrowinds Sword
records.about: A gleaming sword forged where the winds turn back on themselves, its edge shining with old power.

records.name: Retrowinds Katana
records.about: A graceful katana whose flowing edge echoes the swift winds of RetroWinds.

records.name: Retrowinds Robe
records.about: A flowing robe woven from iridescent threads that ripple like the unseen currents of RetroWinds.

records.name: Retrowinds Leather Armor
records.about: Supple armor layered with wind-worn scales, granting its wearer the nimble grace of RetroWinds.

records.name: Retrowinds Heavy Armor
records.about: Heavy armor shaped by relentless gales, bearing the enduring strength of RetroWinds.

records.id: item:Snake Eye Ring#Retro Snake Eye Ring
records.name: Snake Eye Ring
records.about: A ring made from the eye of the Snake Queen.

records.id: item:Spider's Eye Ring#Retro Spider's Eye Ring
records.name: Spider's Eye Ring
records.about: A ring crafted from the faceted eye of an enormous spider.

records.id: item:Poison Fang Dagger#Retro Poison Fang Dagger
records.name: Poison Fang Dagger
records.about: A dagger fashioned from the fang of an enormous spider.

records.name: Doom Bow
records.about: No mortal can fire this dreaded bow without resting in between shots. It requires tremendous skill to wield.

records.id: item:Staff of Extreme Prejudice#Retro Staff of Extreme Prejudice
records.name: Staff of Extreme Prejudice
records.about: Once the most powerful staff in existence; a crack in its frame has rendered it incapable of focusing fire. It remains uniquely deadly.

records.id: item:Cloak of the Planewalker#Retro Cloak of the Planewalker
records.name: Cloak of the Planewalker
records.about: An enchanted cloak crafted by an ancient guild of timeshifter thieves.

records.id: item:Pirate King's Cutlass#Retro Pirate King's Cutlass
records.name: Pirate King's Cutlass
records.about: Used only by the pirates who would make themselves kings, this cutlass is said to be cursed as each Pirate King seems to be killed rather unexpectedly.

records.id: item:Doku No Ken#Retro Doku No Ken
records.name: Doku No Ken
records.about: Stuck in the maw of the Son of Arachna, this Katana is coated in the creature's poisonous venom. In the hands of the right person, this is a truly deadly weapon.

records.name: Leaf Bow
records.about: Fashioned from the finest logs found within the Woodland Labyrinths, this bow uses sharp leaves instead of conventional arrows. Such lightweight ammunition allows for quick movement.

records.id: item:Skull of Endless Torment#Retro Skull of Endless Torment
records.name: Skull of Endless Torment
records.about: This skull glows with the stolen soul of a phoenix trapped in the skull many years ago by Shaitan.

records.name: Leaf Draon Hide Armor
records.about: Light armor crafted from the hard-as-steel leafy scales of a Leaf Dragon.

records.id: item:Water Dragon Silk Robe#Retro Water Dragon Silk Robe
records.name: Water Dragon Silk Robe
records.about: A magic robe woven from enchanted threads of water harvested from a great Water Dragon's body.

records.id: item:Fire Dragon Battle Armor#Retro Fire Dragon Battle Armor
records.name: Fire Dragon Battle Armor
records.about: Battle armor made from Fire Dragon scales, one of the strongest substances this world has ever seen.

records.name: Sullen Blade
records.about: An ancient weapon imbued with the power of the cosmos.

records.id: item:The Forgotten Crown#Retro The Forgotten Crown
records.name: The Forgotten Crown
records.about: An eerie reminder of what lays in the depths of the Shatters.

records.id: item:The Twilight Gemstone#Retro The Twilight Gemstone
records.name: The Twilight Gemstone
records.about: An odd stone, emanating a dark and mysterious energy.

records.id: item:Bracer of the Guardian#Retro Bracer of the Guardian
records.name: Bracer of the Guardian
records.about: Wearing it makes you feel particularly strong.

records.name: Demon Blade
records.about: A swift and hungry blade that is never satisfied with just one kill.

records.name: Adventurer's Scarf
records.about: A faithful and comfortable scarf that has witnessed countless journeys. Imbued with a protective enchantment, it allows its wearer to gracefully weave through perilous situations.

records.name: Torrential Staff
records.about: A majestic trident adorned with enchanted coral formations that enables command of the tides. Once wielded by King Alexander in his conquest of the oceans, its power has since faded with each passing moon from natural weathering.

records.name: Celestial Recurve
records.about: A wondrous bow of heavenly origin, harnessing Daevic magic to bend and concentrate light into tangible projectiles. At the point where these beams intersect, a dazzling burst of celestial brilliance radiates.

records.id: item:Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy#Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny
records.name: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy
records.alias: Mace of the Pumpkin Effigy Shiny
records.about: A sinister twist on the scarecrow's intended use. Totalia bewitched these cursed figures with an uncanny allure to enthral victims into their untimely demise.

records.name: Pirate's Artillery
records.about: Although cannons were once typically associated with naval warfare, many pirates now regard Bilgewater's application of them in land-based combat as revolutionary.

records.id: item:Skull of Restless Souls#Skull of Restless Souls Shiny
records.name: Skull of Restless Souls
records.about: An unnaturally pristine skull adorned with a crown of thorns. Various parts of this once holy figure continue to be worshipped as sacred relics post-mortem as they bestow graces and miracles through the traces of divine power abiding within.

records.name: Doom's Emblem
records.about: An accursed sigil that beckons to one's inner demons. Unholy paladins can unleash their dormant latent potential by forming a pact with an otherworldly force through a tribute of their own flesh and blood.

records.name: Cavalry Lance
records.about: A resplendent, gilded lance once wielded by a legendary horseback rider of yore during the great Draconic Cataclysm. Its formidable reach could slay monstrous dragons with seemingly impenetrable bodies by impaling their deeply buried hearts.

records.id: item:Cloak of the Deep#Cloak of the Deep Shiny
records.name: Cloak of the Deep
records.about: An enchanting cloak that conceals its wearer in a veil of iridescent bubbles. The shimmering cascade of bubbles serves as the only lifeline within the sea's deepest hadal trenches.

records.name: Evolutionary Records
records.about: An ancient volume recording ancestral lineages dating as far back as the Primal Era. Infused with the essence of druidic magic, it grants the power to delve into nature's eternal transformation, morphing its caster into formidable creatures.

records.name: Pollen Incendiary
records.about: A diabolical fusion of magic and chemical warfare engineered by Dr. Terrible in his effort to subjugate the Nest. When unleashed, it triggers a cataclysmic chain reaction between the charged volatile pollen that engulfs the air in a blinding and roaring inferno.

records.name: Bloodbath Blade
records.about: A malevolent katana infested with parasitic organisms. The ravenous symbiotes instills in its user a thirst for blood, which grows as it drinks from the life force of its wielder and their foes alike.

records.id: item:Runes of Knowledge#Runes of Knowledge Shiny
records.name: Runes of Knowledge
records.about: A stone slab adorned with enigmatic symbols, harkening to an era of ancient technology still shrouded in obscurity. These same inscrutable runes are found etched on surfaces within the Tundra, beckoning those who dare to decipher their secrets.

records.name: Electrical Interference
records.about: Flip a TM Generic Bit's state on use. Range: 1.5
